text_mt: As soon as he saw her, the king was pierced by the arrows of love; / and she, as soon as she looked upon him, became afflicted by the arrows of love.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau tau pīḍitau mohaṃ jagmatuḥ kāmamārgaṇaiḥ /
rājā calāsano bhūmyāṃ nipapāta turaṅgamāt //
meaning:
उभौ तौ पीडितौ मोहं जग्मतुः काममार्गणैः /
राजा चलासनो भूम्यां निपपात तुरङ्गमात् //
text_mt: Both of them, struck by the arrows of love, swooned; / the king, his seat unsteady, fell from his horse to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tamabhyetya mahātmāno gandharvāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ /
siṣicurvāriṇābhyetya labdhasaṃjño 'bhavat kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
तमभ्येत्य महात्मानो गन्धर्वाः कामरूपिणः /
सिषिचुर्वारिणाभ्येत्य लब्धसंज्ञो ऽभवत् क्षणात् //
text_mt: Approaching him, the noble gandharvas, capable of changing shape at will, / came up and sprinkled him with water; in an instant he regained consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
sā cāpsarobhirutpātya nītā pitṛkulaṃ nijam /
tābhirāśvāsitā cāpi madhurairvacanāmbubhiḥ //
meaning:
सा चाप्सरोभिरुत्पात्य नीता पितृकुलं निजम् /
ताभिराश्वासिता चापि मधुरैर्वचनाम्बुभिः //
text_mt: And she was lifted up by the apsarases and carried to her father's abode, / and consoled by them with sweet waters of words.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpyaruhya turagaṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ purottamam /
gatastu meruśikharaṃ kāmacārī yathāmaraḥ //
meaning:
स चाप्यरुह्य तुरगं प्रतिष्ठानं पुरोत्तमम् /
गतस्तु मेरुशिखरं कामचारी यथामरः //
text_mt: And he, having mounted his horse, went to the supreme city of Pratiṣṭhāna, / just as a god wandering at will goes to the peak of Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāprabhṛti sā dṛṣṭā ārkṣiṇā tapatī girau /
tadāprabhṛti nāśnāti divā svapiti no niśi //
meaning:
यदाप्रभृति सा दृष्टा आर्क्षिणा तपती गिरौ /
तदाप्रभृति नाश्नाति दिवा स्वपिति नो निशि //
text_mt: From the time Tapatī was seen on the mountain by the son of Ṛkṣa, / from that time on he ate not by day, nor slept at night.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarvavidavyagroviditvā varuṇātmajaḥ /
tapatītāpitaṃ vīraṃ pārthivaṃ tapasāṃ nidhiḥ //
meaning:
ततः सर्वविदव्यग्रोविदित्वा वरुणात्मजः /
तपतीतापितं वीरं पार्थिवं तपसां निधिः //
text_mt: Then the son of Varuṇa, knowing all things, untroubled, that treasury of austerities, / realized that the heroic king was tormented by Tapatī.

sanskrit_iast:
samutpatya mahāyogī gaganaṃ ravimaṇḍalam /
viveśa devaṃ tigmāṃśu dadarśa syandane sthitam //
meaning:
समुत्पत्य महायोगी गगनं रविमण्डलम् /
विवेश देवं तिग्मांशु ददर्श स्यन्दने स्थितम् //
text_mt: Flying up into the sky, the great yogin / entered the solar orb and saw the fierce-rayed god standing in his chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāskaraṃ devaṃ praṇamad dvijasattamaḥ /
pratipraṇamitaścāsau bhāskareṇāviśad rathe //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा भास्करं देवं प्रणमद् द्विजसत्तमः /
प्रतिप्रणमितश्चासौ भास्करेणाविशद् रथे //
text_mt: Seeing that Sun god, the best of the twice-born bowed down; / and having been bowed to in return by the Sun, he stepped into the chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalajjaṭākalāpo 'sau divākarasamīpagaḥ /
śobhate vāruṇiḥ śrīmān dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
ज्वलज्जटाकलापो ऽसौ दिवाकरसमीपगः /
शोभते वारुणिः श्रीमान् द्वितीय इव भास्करः //
text_mt: With his blazing mass of matted hair, approaching close to the Sun, / the glorious son of Varuṇa shone like a second sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃpūjitor'ghārbhāskareṇa tapodhanaḥ /
pṛṣṭaścāgamane hetuṃ pratyuvāca divākaram //
meaning:
ततः संपूजितोर्ऽघार्भास्करेण तपोधनः /
पृष्टश्चागमने हेतुं प्रत्युवाच दिवाकरम् //
text_mt: Then, honored with water for the guest by the Sun / and questioned as to the reason for his coming, the ascetic replied to the Sun:

sanskrit_iast:
samāyāto 'smi deveśa yācituṃ tvāṃ mahādyute /
sutāṃ saṃvaraṇasyārthe tasya tvaṃ dātumarhasi //
meaning:
समायातो ऽस्मि देवेश याचितुं त्वां महाद्युते /
सुतां संवरणस्यार्थे तस्य त्वं दातुमर्हसि //
text_mt: "I have come, O Lord of Gods, to ask of you, O one of great splendor, / your daughter for the sake of Saṃvaraṇa; you ought to grant her to him."

sanskrit_iast:
tato vasiṣṭhāya divākareṇa niveditā sā tapatī tanūjā /
gṛhāgatāya dvijapuṅgavāya rājñor'thataḥ saṃvaraṇasya devāḥ //
meaning:
ततो वसिष्ठाय दिवाकरेण निवेदिता सा तपती तनूजा /
गृहागताय द्विजपुङ्गवाय राज्ञोर्ऽथतः संवरणस्य देवाः //
text_mt: Then, O gods, that daughter Tapatī was granted by the Sun to Vasiṣṭha, / the bull among the twice-born who had come to his abode, for the sake of King Saṃvaraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrimādāya tato vasiṣṭhaḥ svamāśramaṃ puṇyamupājagāma /
sā cāpi saṃsmṛtya nṛpātmajaṃ taṃ kṛtāñjalirvāruṇimāha devī //
meaning:
सावित्रिमादाय ततो वसिष्ठः स्वमाश्रमं पुण्यमुपाजगाम /
सा चापि संस्मृत्य नृपात्मजं तं कृताञ्जलिर्वारुणिमाह देवी //
text_mt: Taking the daughter of Savitṛ, Vasiṣṭha then went to his sacred hermitage; / and remembering that prince, the lady said to the son of Varuṇa with cupped hands:

sanskrit_iast:
tapatyuvāca /
brahman mayā khedamupetya yo hi sahāpsarobhiḥ paricārikābhiḥ /
dṛṣṭo hyaraṇye 'maragarbhatulyo nṛpātmajo lakṣaṇato 'bhijāne //
meaning:
तपत्युवाच /
ब्रह्मन् मया खेदमुपेत्य यो हि सहाप्सरोभिः परिचारिकाभिः /
दृष्टो ह्यरण्ये ऽमरगर्भतुल्यो नृपात्मजो लक्षणतो ऽभिजाने //
text_mt: Tapatī said: / "O Brahmin, by the marks I recognize that prince whom I, distressed, / beheld in the forest accompanied by my apsaras attendants, resembling an immortal offspring:

sanskrit_iast:
pādau śubhau cakragadāsicihnau jaṅghe tathorū karihastatulyau /
kaṭistathā siṃhakaṭiryathaiva kṣāmaṃ ca madhyaṃ tribalīnibaddham //
meaning:
पादौ शुभौ चक्रगदासिचिह्नौ जङ्घे तथोरू करिहस्ततुल्यौ /
कटिस्तथा सिंहकटिर्यथैव क्षामं च मध्यं त्रिबलीनिबद्धम् //
text_mt: His two auspicious feet bear the marks of the discus, mace, and sword; his shanks and thighs are like an elephant's trunk; / his waist is like a lion's waist; his middle is slender and bound with three folds;

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāsya śaṅkhākṛtimādadhāti bhujau ca pīnau kaṭhanausudīrghau /
hastau tathā padmadalodbhavāṅkau chatrākṛtistasya śiro vibhāti //
meaning:
ग्रीवास्य शङ्खाकृतिमादधाति भुजौ च पीनौ कठनौसुदीर्घौ /
हस्तौ तथा पद्मदलोद्भवाङ्कौ छत्राकृतिस्तस्य शिरो विभाति //
text_mt: His neck bears the shape of a conch; his two arms are plump, firm, and very long; / his two hands are marked with lotus petals; his head shines in the shape of an umbrella;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāśca keśāḥ kuṭilāśca tasya karṇau samāṃsau susamā ca nāsā /
dīrghāśca tasyāṅgulayaḥ suparvāḥ padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ daśanāśca subhrāḥ //
meaning:
नीलाश्च केशाः कुटिलाश्च तस्य कर्णौ समांसौ सुसमा च नासा /
दीर्घाश्च तस्याङ्गुलयः सुपर्वाः पद्भ्यां कराभ्यां दशनाश्च सुभ्राः //
text_mt: His hair is dark and curly; his ears are fleshy; his nose is perfectly even; / his fingers and toes are long and well-jointed; and his teeth are bright white;

sanskrit_iast:
samunnataḥ ṣaḍbhirudāravīryastribhirgabhīrastripu ca pralambaḥ /
raktastathā pañcasu rājaputraḥ kṛṣṇaścaturbhistribhirānato 'pi //
meaning:
समुन्नतः षड्भिरुदारवीर्यस्त्रिभिर्गभीरस्त्रिपु च प्रलम्बः /
रक्तस्तथा पञ्चसु राजपुत्रः कृष्णश्चतुर्भिस्त्रिभिरानतो ऽपि //
text_mt: He is elevated in six, of noble valor; deep in three, and long in three; / the prince is red in five, dark in four, and bent in three;

sanskrit_iast:
dvābhyāṃ ca śuklaḥ surābhiścaturbhiḥ dṛśyanti padmāni daśaiva cāsya /
vṛtaḥ sa bhartā bhagavān hi pūrvaṃ taṃ rājaputraṃ bhuvi saṃvicintya //
meaning:
द्वाभ्यां च शुक्लः सुराभिश्चतुर्भिः दृश्यन्ति पद्मानि दशैव चास्य /
वृतः स भर्ता भगवान् हि पूर्वं तं राजपुत्रं भुवि संविचिन्त्य //
text_mt: He is white in two, fragrant in four, and ten lotuses are visible on him. / Considering that prince on earth, he was indeed previously chosen by me as my husband, O venerable one!

sanskrit_iast:
dadasva māṃ nātha tapasvine 'smai guṇopapannāya samīhitāya /
nehānyakāmāṃ pravadanti santo dātuṃ tathānyasya vibho kṣamasva //
meaning:
ददस्व मां नाथ तपस्विने ऽस्मै गुणोपपन्नाय समीहिताय /
नेहान्यकामां प्रवदन्ति सन्तो दातुं तथान्यस्य विभो क्षमस्व //
text_mt: Give me, O lord, to this ascetic, endowed with virtues, whom I have desired! / For the virtuous do not advocate giving a woman who desires another to someone else; forgive me, O lord!"

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva uvāca /
ityevamuktaḥ savituśca putryā ṛṣistadā dhyānaparo babhūva /
jñātvā ca tatrārkasutāṃ sakāmāṃ mudā yuto vākyamidaṃ jagāda //
meaning:
देवदेव उवाच /
इत्येवमुक्तः सवितुश्च पुत्र्या ऋषिस्तदा ध्यानपरो बभूव /
ज्ञात्वा च तत्रार्कसुतां सकामां मुदा युतो वाक्यमिदं जगाद //
text_mt: The God of Gods said: / Addressed thus by the daughter of Savitṛ, the sage then became absorbed in meditation; / and knowing that the daughter of the Sun was desirous of him, he spoke these words with joy:

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva putri nṛpatestanūjo dṛṣṭaḥ purā kāmayase yamadya /
sa eva cāyāti mamāśramaṃ vai ṛkṣātmajaḥ saṃvaraṇo hi nāmnā //
meaning:
स एव पुत्रि नृपतेस्तनूजो दृष्टः पुरा कामयसे यमद्य /
स एव चायाति ममाश्रमं वै ऋक्षात्मजः संवरणो हि नाम्ना //
text_mt: "O daughter, he whom you desire today is the very same king's son seen previously; / and it is he who comes to my hermitage, the son of Ṛkṣa named Saṃvaraṇa."

sanskrit_iast:
athājagāma sa nṛpasya putrastamāśramaṃ brāhmaṇapuṅkavasya /
dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā sthitastvapaśyat tapatīṃ narendraḥ //
meaning:
अथाजगाम स नृपस्य पुत्रस्तमाश्रमं ब्राह्मणपुङ्कवस्य /
दृष्ट्वा वसिष्ठं प्रणिपत्य मूर्ध्ना स्थितस्त्वपश्यत् तपतीं नरेन्द्रः //
text_mt: Then that king's son arrived at the hermitage of the bull among Brahmins; / seeing Vasiṣṭha, the lord of men bowed his head and stood, and then saw Tapatī.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā ca tāṃ padmaviśālanetrāṃ tāṃ pūrvadṛṣṭāmiti cintayitvā /
papraccha keyaṃ lalanā dvijendra sa vāruṇiḥ prāha narādhipendram //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा च तां पद्मविशालनेत्रां तां पूर्वदृष्टामिति चिन्तयित्वा /
पप्रच्छ केयं ललना द्विजेन्द्र स वारुणिः प्राह नराधिपेन्द्रम् //
text_mt: Seeing her of large lotus eyes and thinking, 'This is she who was seen before,' / he asked, 'Who is this maiden, O best of the twice-born?' That son of Varuṇa spoke to the king of men:

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ vivasvadduhitā narendra nāmnā prasiddhā tapatī pṛthivyām /
mayā tavārthāya divākaro 'rthitaḥ prādānmayā tvāśramamānininye //
meaning:
इयं विवस्वद्दुहिता नरेन्द्र नाम्ना प्रसिद्धा तपती पृथिव्याम् /
मया तवार्थाय दिवाकरो ऽर्थितः प्रादान्मया त्वाश्रममानिनिन्ये //
text_mt: "This is the daughter of Vivasvat, O lord of men, known on earth by the name Tapatī. / For your sake I petitioned the Sun; he gave her, and I brought her to my hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt masuttiṣcha narendra devyāḥ pāṇiṃ tapatyā vidhivad gṛhāṇa /
ityevamukto nṛpatiḥ prahṛṣṭo jagrāha pāṇiṃ vidhivat tapatyāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् मसुत्तिष्छ नरेन्द्र देव्याः पाणिं तपत्या विधिवद् गृहाण /
इत्येवमुक्तो नृपतिः प्रहृष्टो जग्राह पाणिं विधिवत् तपत्याः //
text_mt: Therefore stand up, O lord of men! Take the hand of the lady Tapatī according to the ritual." / Addressed thus, the king, exceedingly delighted, took the hand of Tapatī according to the ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
sā taṃ patiṃ prāpya mano 'bhirāmaṃ sūryāmajā śakrasamāprabhāvam /
rarāma tanvī bhavanottameṣu yatā mahaindraṃ divi daityakanyā //
meaning:
सा तं पतिं प्राप्य मनो ऽभिरामं सूर्यामजा शक्रसमाप्रभावम् /
रराम तन्वी भवनोत्तमेषु यता महैन्द्रं दिवि दैत्यकन्या //
text_mt: Having obtained that husband who delighted her heart, endowed with glory equal to Indra's, / the slender daughter of the Sun took delight in supreme mansions, as a Daitya maiden [delights] in Indra's supreme heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva uvāca /
tasyāṃ tapatyāṃ narasattamena jātaḥ sutaḥ pārthivalakṣaṇastu /
sa jātakarmādibhireva saṃskṛto vivarddhatājyena huto yathāgniḥ //
meaning:
देवदेव उवाच /
तस्यां तपत्यां नरसत्तमेन जातः सुतः पार्थिवलक्षणस्तु /
स जातकर्मादिभिरेव संस्कृतो विवर्द्धताज्येन हुतो यथाग्निः //
text_mt: The god of gods said: / On that Tapatī, a son endowed with the marks of kingship was born to that best of men; / consecrated with the birth rites and the rest, he grew like fire fed with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛto 'sya cūḍākaraṇaśca devā vipraṇa mitrāvaruṇātmajena /
navābdikasya vratabandhanaṃ ca vede ca śāstre vidhipārago 'būt //
meaning:
कृतो ऽस्य चूडाकरणश्च देवा विप्रण मित्रावरुणात्मजेन /
नवाब्दिकस्य व्रतबन्धनं च वेदे च शास्त्रे विधिपारगो ऽबूत् //
text_mt: His tonsure rite was performed, O gods, by the Brahmin son of Mitra and Varuṇa; / and when he was nine years old, [his] investiture with the sacred girdle [took place], and he mastered the rules of both the Veda and the Śāstra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścatuḥpaḍbhirapīha varṣaiḥ sarvajñatāmabhyagamata tato 'sau /
khyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puruṣottamo 'sau nāmnā kuruḥ saṃvaraṇasya putraḥ //
meaning:
ततश्चतुःपड्भिरपीह वर्षैः सर्वज्ञतामभ्यगमत ततो ऽसौ /
ख्यातः पृथिव्यां पुरुषोत्तमो ऽसौ नाम्ना कुरुः संवरणस्य पुत्रः //
text_mt: Then, when he was twice twelve years of age, he attained omniscience in this world; / renowned upon earth as the best of men was he, Kuru by name, the son of Saṃvaraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tato narapatirdṛṣṭvā dharmikaṃ tanayaṃ śubham /
dārakriyārthamakarod yatnaṃ śubhakule tataḥ //
meaning:
ततो नरपतिर्दृष्ट्वा धर्मिकं तनयं शुभम् /
दारक्रियार्थमकरोद् यत्नं शुभकुले ततः //
text_mt: Then the king, seeing his virtuous and auspicious son, / made an effort to arrange his marriage into an auspicious family.

sanskrit_iast:
sodāminīṃ sudāmnastu sutāṃ rūpādhikāṃ napaḥ /
kurorarthāya vatavān sa prādāt kurave 'pi tām //
meaning:
सोदामिनीं सुदाम्नस्तु सुतां रूपाधिकां नपः /
कुरोरर्थाय वतवान् स प्रादात् कुरवे ऽपि ताम् //
text_mt: The king spoke for Kuru's sake [regarding] Saudāminī, the daughter of Sudāman, / possessed of surpassing beauty, and [Sudāman] gave her to Kuru.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāṃ nṛpasutāṃ labdhvā dharmārthāvavirodhayan /
reme tanvyā saha tayā paulomyā maghavāniva //
meaning:
स तां नृपसुतां लब्ध्वा धर्मार्थावविरोधयन् /
रेमे तन्व्या सह तया पौलोम्या मघवानिव //
text_mt: Having obtained that royal maiden, without coming into conflict with righteousness and wealth, / he took delight with that slender woman, like Indra with Paulomī.

sanskrit_iast:
tato narapatiḥ putraṃ rājyabhārakṣamaṃ balī /
viditvā yovarājyāya vidhānenābhyaṣecayat //
meaning:
ततो नरपतिः पुत्रं राज्यभारक्षमं बली /
विदित्वा योवराज्याय विधानेनाभ्यषेचयत् //
text_mt: Then the powerful king, knowing his son to be capable of bearing the burden of the kingdom, / consecrated him as heir apparent according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rājye 'bhiṣiktastu kuruḥ pitrā nije pade /
pālayāmāsa sa mahīṃ putravacca svayaṃ prajāḥ //
meaning:
ततो राज्ये ऽभिषिक्तस्तु कुरुः पित्रा निजे पदे /
पालयामास स महीं पुत्रवच्च स्वयं प्रजाः //
text_mt: Then, once Kuru was consecrated to kingship in his own place by his father, / he himself protected the earth and the subjects like sons.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva kṣetrapālo 'bhūt paśupālaḥ sa eva hi /
sa sarvapālakaścāsīt prajāpālo mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
स एव क्षेत्रपालो ऽभूत् पशुपालः स एव हि /
स सर्वपालकश्चासीत् प्रजापालो महाबलः //
text_mt: He alone was the guardian of the field, he alone the guardian of cattle; / he was the protector of all, a protector of subjects of great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'sya buddhirupannā kīrtirloke garīyasī /
yāvatkīrtiḥ susaṃsthā hi tāvadvāsaḥ suraiḥ saha //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्य बुद्धिरुपन्ना कीर्तिर्लोके गरीयसी /
यावत्कीर्तिः सुसंस्था हि तावद्वासः सुरैः सह //
text_mt: Then this thought arose in him: 'Fame is supreme in the world; / for as long as fame remains well established, so long is one's dwelling with the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvevaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭho yāthātathyamavekṣya ca /
vicacāra mahīṃ sarvāṃ kīrtyarthaṃ tu narādhipaḥ //
meaning:
स त्वेवं नृपतिश्रेष्ठो याथातथ्यमवेक्ष्य च /
विचचार महीं सर्वां कीर्त्यर्थं तु नराधिपः //
text_mt: Thus reflecting on truth, that best of kings, / the ruler of men, traversed the whole earth for the sake of fame.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvaitavanaṃ nāma puṇyaṃ lokeśvaro balī/ /
tadāsādya susaṃtuṣṭo viveśābhyāntaraṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
ततो द्वैतवनं नाम पुण्यं लोकेश्वरो बली/ /
तदासाद्य सुसंतुष्टो विवेशाभ्यान्तरं ततः //
text_mt: Then the powerful ruler of the world reached the holy [forest] named Dvaitavana; / well satisfied, he thereupon entered within.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devīṃ dadarśātha puṇyāṃ pāpavimocanīm /
plakṣajāṃ brahmaṇaḥ putrīṃ harijihvāṃ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
तत्र देवीं ददर्शाथ पुण्यां पापविमोचनीम् /
प्लक्षजां ब्रह्मणः पुत्रीं हरिजिह्वां सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt: There he then beheld the holy goddess who frees from sin, / the Sarasvatī, born from the Plakṣa tree, daughter of Brahmā, the tongue of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanasya jananīṃ hvandaṃ kṛtvā suvistaram /
sthitāṃ bhagavatīṃ kūle tīrthakoṭibhirāplutām //
meaning:
सुदर्शनस्य जननीं ह्वन्दं कृत्वा सुविस्तरम् /
स्थितां भगवतीं कूले तीर्थकोटिभिराप्लुताम् //
text_mt: the mother of Sudarśana, having formed a very vast lake, / the divine lady staying upon the bank, bathed in by crores of tīrthas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstajjalamīkṣyaiva snātvā prīto 'bhavannṛpaḥ /
samājagāma ca punaḥ brahmaṇo vedimuttarām //
meaning:
तस्यास्तज्जलमीक्ष्यैव स्नात्वा प्रीतो ऽभवन्नृपः /
समाजगाम च पुनः ब्रह्मणो वेदिमुत्तराम् //
text_mt: Seeing that water of hers and bathing, the king became delighted; / and he proceeded further to the northern altar of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
samantapañcakaṃ nāma dharmasthānamanuttamam /
ākamantād yojanāni pañca ca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
समन्तपञ्चकं नाम धर्मस्थानमनुत्तमम् /
आकमन्ताद् योजनानि पञ्च च सर्वतः //
text_mt: named Samantapañcaka, the unexcelled abode of righteousness, / extending five yojanas around in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ /
kiyantyo vedayaḥ santi brahmaṇaḥ puruṣottama /
yenottaratayā vedirgāditā sarvapañcakā //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः /
कियन्त्यो वेदयः सन्ति ब्रह्मणः पुरुषोत्तम /
येनोत्तरतया वेदिर्गादिता सर्वपञ्चका //
text_mt: The gods said: / How many altars of Brahmā are there, O Supreme Being, / because of which [Samantapañcaka] is spoken of as the northern altar?

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva uvāca/ /
vedayo lokanāthasya pañca dharmasya setavaḥ /
yāsu yaṣṭaṃ sureśena lokanāthena śaṃbhunā //
meaning:
देवदेव उवाच/ /
वेदयो लोकनाथस्य पञ्च धर्मस्य सेतवः /
यासु यष्टं सुरेशेन लोकनाथेन शंभुना //
text_mt: The god of gods said: / The altars of the Lord of the World are five, damming [and preserving] righteousness, / upon which sacrifices were performed by the lord of the gods, the lord of the world, Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgo madhyamā vediḥ pūrvā vedirgayāśiraḥ /
virajā dakṣiṇā vediranantaphaladāyinī //
meaning:
प्रयागो मध्यमा वेदिः पूर्वा वेदिर्गयाशिरः /
विरजा दक्षिणा वेदिरनन्तफलदायिनी //
text_mt: Prayāga is the middle altar; the eastern altar is Gayāśiras; / Virajā is the southern altar, bestowing boundless fruit;

sanskrit_iast:
pratīcī puṣkarā vedistribhiḥ kuṇḍairalaṅkṛtā /
samantapañcakā coktā vedirevottarāvyayā //
meaning:
प्रतीची पुष्करा वेदिस्त्रिभिः कुण्डैरलङ्कृता /
समन्तपञ्चका चोक्ता वेदिरेवोत्तराव्यया //
text_mt: the western altar is Puṣkara, adorned with three pools; / and the imperishable northern altar is said to be Samantapañcaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tamamanyata rājarṣiridaṃ kṣetraṃ mahāphalam /
kariṣyāmi kṛṣiṣyāmi sarvān kāmān yathepsitān //
meaning:
तममन्यत राजर्षिरिदं क्षेत्रं महाफलम् /
करिष्यामि कृषिष्यामि सर्वान् कामान् यथेप्सितान् //
text_mt: The royal sage considered: 'This is a field of great fruit. / I shall cultivate it; I shall plow all desires as wished.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃcintya manasā tyaktvā syantanamuttamam /
cakre kīrtyarthamatulaṃ saṃsthānaṃ pārthivarṣabhaḥ //
kṛtvā sīraṃ sa sauvarṇaṃ gahya rudravṛṣaṃ prabhuḥ /
pauṇḍrakaṃ yāmyamahiṣaṃ svayaṃ karṣitumudyataḥ //
meaning:
इति संचिन्त्य मनसा त्यक्त्वा स्यन्तनमुत्तमम् /
चक्रे कीर्त्यर्थमतुलं संस्थानं पार्थिवर्षभः //
कृत्वा सीरं स सौवर्णं गह्य रुद्रवृषं प्रभुः /
पौण्ड्रकं याम्यमहिषं स्वयं कर्षितुमुद्यतः //
text_mt: Reflecting thus in his mind, abandoning his excellent chariot, / that bull among kings made an incomparable preparation for the sake of fame: / having fashioned a golden plow, and having seized Rudra's bull / and Pauṇḍraka, the buffalo of Yama, the lord set out himself to plow.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ karṣantaṃ naravaraṃ samabhyetya takratuḥ /
provāca rājan kimidaṃ bhavān kartumihodyataḥ //
meaning:
तं कर्षन्तं नरवरं समभ्येत्य तक्रतुः /
प्रोवाच राजन् किमिदं भवान् कर्तुमिहोद्यतः //
text_mt: Approaching that best of men as he plowed, Indra / said: 'O king, what is this that you have set out to do here?'

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ karṣantaṃ naravaraṃ samabhyetya śatakratuḥ /
provāca rājan kimidaṃ bhavān kartumihodyataḥ //
meaning:
तं कर्षन्तं नरवरं समभ्येत्य शतक्रतुः /
प्रोवाच राजन् किमिदं भवान् कर्तुमिहोद्यतः //
text_mt: Approaching that best of men as he plowed, Indra / said: 'O king, what is this that you have set out to do here?'

sanskrit_iast:
rājābravīt suravaraṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamāṃ dayām /
kṛṣāmi śaucaṃ dānaṃ ca yogaṃ ca brahmacāritām //
meaning:
राजाब्रवीत् सुरवरं तपः सत्यं क्षमां दयाम् /
कृषामि शौचं दानं च योगं च ब्रह्मचारिताम् //
text_mt: The king said to the best of gods: 'Austerity, truth, forbearance, compassion, / purity, charity, yoga, and celibacy—[these] I am plowing.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasyovāca harirdevaḥ kasmādbījo nareśvara /
labdho 'ṣṭāṅgeti sahasā avahasya gatastataḥ //
meaning:
तस्योवाच हरिर्देवः कस्माद्बीजो नरेश्वर /
लब्धो ऽष्टाङ्गेति सहसा अवहस्य गतस्ततः //
text_mt: The divine Hari said to him: 'O lord of men, from where / will the eightfold seed be obtained?' Laughing aloud, he then departed.

sanskrit_iast:
gate 'pi śakra rājarṣirahanyahani sīradhṛk /
kṛṣate 'nyān samantācca saptakrośān mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
गते ऽपि शक्र राजर्षिरहन्यहनि सीरधृक् /
कृषते ऽन्यान् समन्ताच्च सप्तक्रोशान् महीपतिः //
text_mt: Even when Indra had gone, the royal sage, holding the plow day by day, / the king plowed seven krośas further all around.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'hamabruvaṃ gatvā kuro kimidamityatha /
tadāṣṭāṅgaṃ mahādharmaṃ samākhyātaṃ nṛpeṇa hi //
meaning:
ततो ऽहमब्रुवं गत्वा कुरो किमिदमित्यथ /
तदाष्टाङ्गं महाधर्मं समाख्यातं नृपेण हि //
text_mt: Then I approached and said: 'O Kuru, what is this?' / Thereupon that eightfold great righteousness was declared by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mayāsya gaditaṃ nṛpa bījaṃ kva tiṣṭhati /
sa cāha mama dehasthaṃ bījaṃ tamahamabruvam /
dehyahaṃ vāpayiṣyāmi sīraṃ kṛṣatu vai bhavān //
meaning:
ततो मयास्य गदितं नृप बीजं क्व तिष्ठति /
स चाह मम देहस्थं बीजं तमहमब्रुवम् /
देह्यहं वापयिष्यामि सीरं कृषतु वै भवान् //
text_mt: Then I said to him: 'O king, where does the seed abide?' / And he said: 'The seed resides in my body.' I said to him: / 'Give it, and I will sow it; do you plow with the plow.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato nṛpatinā bāhurdakṣiṇaḥ prasṛtaḥ kataḥ /
prasṛtaṃ taṃ bhujaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā cakreṇa vegataḥ //
meaning:
ततो नृपतिना बाहुर्दक्षिणः प्रसृतः कतः /
प्रसृतं तं भुजं दृष्ट्वा मया चक्रेण वेगतः //
text_mt: Then the right arm was stretched out by the king; / seeing that arm stretched out, swiftly with my discus

sanskrit_iast:
sahasradhā tataśchidya datto yuṣmākameva hi /
tataḥ savyo bhujo rājñā dattaś chinno 'pyasau mayā //
meaning:
सहस्रधा ततश्छिद्य दत्तो युष्माकमेव हि /
ततः सव्यो भुजो राज्ञा दत्तश् छिन्नो ऽप्यसौ मया //
text_mt: cutting it into a thousand pieces, it was given to you [gods]. / Then the left arm was offered by the king, and that too was cut by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivoruyugaṃ prādānmayā chinnau ca tāvubhau /
tataḥ sa me śiraḥ prādāt tena prīte 'smi tasya ca /
varado 'smītyathetyukte kururvaramayācata //
meaning:
तथैवोरुयुगं प्रादान्मया छिन्नौ च तावुभौ /
ततः स मे शिरः प्रादात् तेन प्रीते ऽस्मि तस्य च /
वरदो ऽस्मीत्यथेत्युक्ते कुरुर्वरमयाचत //
text_mt: In the same way he offered his two thighs, and both were cut by me; / then he offered me his head. With that I was pleased with him; / and when I said, 'I am a giver of boons,' Kuru asked for a boon:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadetanmayā kṛṣṭaṃ dharmakṣetraṃ tadastu ca /
snātānāṃ ca mṛtānāṃ ca mahāpuṇyaphalaṃ tviha //
meaning:
यावदेतन्मया कृष्टं धर्मक्षेत्रं तदस्तु च /
स्नातानां च मृतानां च महापुण्यफलं त्विह //
text_mt: 'As far as this has been plowed by me, let that be a field of righteousness; / and let there be the fruit of great merit here for those who bathe and those who die.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaṃ ca dānaṃ ca snānaṃ japyaṃ ca mādhava /
homayajñādikaṃ cānyacchubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vibho //
meaning:
उपवासं च दानं च स्नानं जप्यं च माधव /
होमयज्ञादिकं चान्यच्छुभं वाप्यशुभं विभो //
text_mt: Fasting, giving, bathing, chanting, O Mādhava, / oblations, sacrifices, and anything else, whether auspicious or inauspicious, O omnipresent Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
tvatprasāddhṛṣīkeśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara /
akṣayaṃ pravare kṣetre bhavatvatra mahāphalam //
meaning:
त्वत्प्रसाद्धृषीकेश शङ्खचक्रगदाधर /
अक्षयं प्रवरे क्षेत्रे भवत्वत्र महाफलम् //
text_mt: by your grace, O Hṛṣīkeśa, wielder of the conch, discus, and mace, / let it become imperishable, yielding great fruit in this excellent field.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā bhavān suraiḥ sārdhaṃ samaṃ devena śalinā /
vasa tvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa mannāmavyañjake 'cyuta /
ityevamuktastenāhaṃ rājñā bāḍhamuvāca tam //
meaning:
तथा भवान् सुरैः सार्धं समं देवेन शलिना /
वस त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष मन्नामव्यञ्जके ऽच्युत /
इत्येवमुक्तस्तेनाहं राज्ञा बाढमुवाच तम् //
text_mt: Likewise, may you dwell together with the gods and together with the trident-bearing god, / O lotus-eyed one, O Acyuta, in this [field] that reveals my name.' / Addressed in this way by the king, I said to him, 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca tvaṃ divyavapurbhava bhūyo mahīpate /
tathāntakāle māmeva layaṭameṣyasi suvrata //
meaning:
तथा च त्वं दिव्यवपुर्भव भूयो महीपते /
तथान्तकाले मामेव लयटमेष्यसि सुव्रत //
text_mt: 'And likewise may you have a divine body once more, O lord of earth; / and at the time of death, O you of virtuous vows, you shall attain dissolution into me alone.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtiśca śāśvatī tubhyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ /
tatraiva yājakā yajñān yajiṣyanti sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
कीर्तिश्च शाश्वती तुभ्यं भविष्यति न संशयः /
तत्रैव याजका यज्ञान् यजिष्यन्ति सहस्रशः //
text_mt: And there shall be everlasting fame for you, without a doubt; / right here sacrificers shall offer sacrifices by the thousands.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ dadau sa puruṣottamaḥ /
yakṣaṃ ca candranāmānaṃ vāsukiṃ cāpi pannagam //
meaning:
तस्य क्षेत्रस्य रक्षार्थं ददौ स पुरुषोत्तमः /
यक्षं च चन्द्रनामानं वासुकिं चापि पन्नगम् //
text_mt: For the protection of that field, that Supreme Being gave / a Yakṣa named Candra, and the serpent Vāsuki,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādharaṃ śaṅkukarṇaṃ sukeśiṃ rākṣaseśvaram /
ajāvanaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ mahodevaṃ ca pāvakam //
meaning:
विद्याधरं शङ्कुकर्णं सुकेशिं राक्षसेश्वरम् /
अजावनं च नृपतिं महोदेवं च पावकम् //
text_mt: the Vidyādhara Śaṅkukarṇa, Sukeśin the lord of Rākṣasas, / King Ajāvana, and the fire named Mahodeva.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni sarvato 'bhyetya rakṣanti kurujāṅgalam /
amīṣāṃ balino 'nye ca bhṛtyāścaivānuyāyinaḥ //
meaning:
एतानि सर्वतो ऽभ्येत्य रक्षन्ति कुरुजाङ्गलम् /
अमीषां बलिनो ऽन्ये च भृत्याश्चैवानुयायिनः //
text_mt: These gather from all sides and protect Kurujāṅgala; / and there are other powerful servants and followers of theirs,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau sahasrāṇi dharanurdharāṇāṃ ye vārayantīha suduṣkṛtān vai /
snātuṃ na yacchanti mahograrūpāstavanyasya bhūtāḥ sacarācarāṇām //
meaning:
अष्टौ सहस्राणि धरनुर्धराणां ये वारयन्तीह सुदुष्कृतान् वै /
स्नातुं न यच्छन्ति महोग्ररूपास्तवन्यस्य भूताः सचराचराणाम् //
text_mt: eight thousand bowmen who ward off the deeply sinful here; / exceedingly fierce in form, they do not allow other living beings among the moving and unmoving to bathe.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva madhye bahupuṇya uktaḥ pṛthūdakaḥ pāpaharaḥ śivaśca /
puṇyā nadī prāṅmukhatāṃ prayātā yatraughayuktasya śubhā jatāḍhyā //
meaning:
तस्यैव मध्ये बहुपुण्य उक्तः पृथूदकः पापहरः शिवश्च /
पुण्या नदी प्राङ्मुखतां प्रयाता यत्रौघयुक्तस्य शुभा जताढ्या //
text_mt: In the very middle of it is spoken of the highly meritorious Pṛthūdaka, which removes sins and is auspicious, / where the holy, auspicious river flowing eastward is rich in water and full of rushes.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ prajeyaṃ prapitāmahena sṛṣṭā samaṃ bhūtagaṇaiḥ samastaiḥ /
mahī jalaṃ vahnisamīrameva khaṃ tvevamādau vibabhau pṛthūdakaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वं प्रजेयं प्रपितामहेन सृष्टा समं भूतगणैः समस्तैः /
मही जलं वह्निसमीरमेव खं त्वेवमादौ विबभौ पृथूदकः //
text_mt: Formerly this creation was made by the great-grandfather together with all the hosts of beings— / earth, water, fire, wind, and sky; thus in the beginning shone Pṛthūdaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca sarvāṇā mahārṇavāni tīrthāni nadyaḥ stravaṇāḥ sarāṃsi /
saṃnirmitānīha mahābhujena taccaikyamāgāt salilaṃ mahīṣu //
meaning:
तथा च सर्वाणा महार्णवानि तीर्थानि नद्यः स्त्रवणाः सरांसि /
संनिर्मितानीह महाभुजेन तच्चैक्यमागात् सलिलं महीषु //
text_mt: And likewise all the great oceans, tīrthas, rivers, streams, and lakes / were created here by the mighty-armed one, and that water became one upon the lands.

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva uvāca /
evaṃ pṛthūdako devāḥ puṇyaḥ pāpabhayāpahaḥ /
taṃ gacchadhvaṃ mahātīrthaṃ yāvat saṃnidhivodhitam //
meaning:
देवदेव उवाच /
एवं पृथूदको देवाः पुण्यः पापभयापहः /
तं गच्छध्वं महातीर्थं यावत् संनिधिवोधितम् //
text_mt: The god of gods said: / 'Thus, O gods, Pṛthūdaka is holy and removes the fear of sin; / go to that great tīrtha, known as Saṃnihitā.'

sanskrit_iast:
yadā mṛgaśiroṛkṣe śaśisūryau bṛhaspatiḥ /
tiṣṭhanti sā tithiḥ puṇyā tvakṣayā parigīyate //
meaning:
यदा मृगशिरोऋक्षे शशिसूर्यौ बृहस्पतिः /
तिष्ठन्ति सा तिथिः पुण्या त्वक्षया परिगीयते //
text_mt: 'When the moon, the sun, and Bṛhaspati stand in the asterism Mṛgaśiras, / that lunar day is celebrated as holy and imperishable.'

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ gacchadhvaṃ suraśreṣṭhā yatra prācī sarasvatī /
pitṝn ārādhayadhvaṃ hi tatra śrāddhena bhaktitataḥ //
meaning:
तं गच्छध्वं सुरश्रेष्ठा यत्र प्राची सरस्वती /
पितॄन् आराधयध्वं हि तत्र श्राद्धेन भक्तिततः //
text_mt: 'Go thither, O best of gods, where the Sarasvatī flows eastward; / worship the ancestors there indeed with devotion through a śrāddha.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato murārivacanaṃ śrutvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ /
samājagmuḥ kurukṣetre puṇyatīrthaṃ pṛthūdakam //
meaning:
ततो मुरारिवचनं श्रुत्वा देवाः सवासवाः /
समाजग्मुः कुरुक्षेत्रे पुण्यतीर्थं पृथूदकम् //
text_mt: Then, having heard the words of Murāri, the gods together with Indra / came to the holy tīrtha Pṛthūdaka in Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā surāḥ sarve bṛhaspatimacodayan /
viśasva bhagavan ṛkṣamimaṃ mṛśiraṃ kuru /
puṇyāṃ tithiṃ pāpaharāṃ tava kālo 'yamāgataḥ //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा सुराः सर्वे बृहस्पतिमचोदयन् /
विशस्व भगवन् ऋक्षमिमं मृशिरं कुरु /
पुण्यां तिथिं पापहरां तव कालो ऽयमागतः //
text_mt: Having bathed there, all the gods urged Bṛhaspati: / 'Enter this asterism Mṛgaśiras, O venerable one; / make the lunar day holy and sin-removing; this time of yours has arrived!'

sanskrit_iast:
pravartate ravistatra candramāpi viśatyasau /
tvadāyattaṃ guro kāryaṃ surāṇāṃ tat kuruṣva ca //
meaning:
प्रवर्तते रविस्तत्र चन्द्रमापि विशत्यसौ /
त्वदायत्तं गुरो कार्यं सुराणां तत् कुरुष्व च //
text_mt: 'The sun advances thither, and this moon also enters; / the task of the gods depends on you, O Guru; therefore accomplish it!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukto devaistu devācāryo 'bravīdidam /
yadi varṣādhipo 'haṃ syāṃ tato yāsyāmi devatāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तो देवैस्तु देवाचार्यो ऽब्रवीदिदम् /
यदि वर्षाधिपो ऽहं स्यां ततो यास्यामि देवताः //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the gods, the preceptor of the gods said this: / 'If I become the lord of the year, then, O deities, I will go.'

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhe māsi mārgarkṣe candrakṣayatithirhi yā /
tasyāṃ purandaraḥ prītaḥ piṇḍaṃ pitṛṣu bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
आषाढे मासि मार्गर्क्षे चन्द्रक्षयतिथिर्हि या /
तस्यां पुरन्दरः प्रीतः पिण्डं पितृषु भक्तितः //
text_mt: On the lunar day of the moon's waning in the month of Āṣāḍha under the asterism Mṛgaśiras, / Indra, pleased, offered with devotion a rice-ball to the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
prādāt tilamadhūnmiśraṃ haviṣyānnaṃ kuruṣvatha /
tataḥ prītāstu pitarastāṃ prāhustanayāṃ nijāma //
meaning:
प्रादात् तिलमधून्मिश्रं हविष्यान्नं कुरुष्वथ /
ततः प्रीतास्तु पितरस्तां प्राहुस्तनयां निजाम //
text_mt: mixed with sesame seeds and honey, as sacrificial food. / Thereupon, well pleased, the ancestors addressed their own daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
menāṃ devāśca śailāya himayuktāya vai daduḥ /
tāṃ menāṃ himavāṃllabdhvā prasādād daivateṣvatha /
prītimānabhavaccāsau rarāma ca yathecchayā //
meaning:
मेनां देवाश्च शैलाय हिमयुक्ताय वै ददुः /
तां मेनां हिमवांल्लब्ध्वा प्रसादाद् दैवतेष्वथ /
प्रीतिमानभवच्चासौ रराम च यथेच्छया //
text_mt: The gods gave Menā to the snow-covered mountain. / Having obtained that Menā by the grace of the gods, / Himavat became full of love and sported according to his desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tato himādriḥ pitṛkanyayā samaṃ samarpayan vai viṣayān yathaiṣṭam /
ajījanat sā tanayāśca tisro rūpātiyuktāḥ surayoṣitopamāḥ //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
ततो हिमाद्रिः पितृकन्यया समं समर्पयन् वै विषयान् यथैष्टम् /
अजीजनत् सा तनयाश्च तिस्रो रूपातियुक्ताः सुरयोषितोपमाः //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे चतुर्विंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Then the snow-mountain, enjoying pleasures at will together with the daughter of the ancestors, / engendered three daughters endowed with supreme beauty, resembling celestial damsels.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter in the glorious Vāmanapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
menāyāḥ kanyakāstisro jātā rūpaguṇānvitāḥ /
sunābha iti ca khyātaścaturthastanayo 'bhavat //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
मेनायाः कन्यकास्तिस्रो जाता रूपगुणान्विताः /
सुनाभ इति च ख्यातश्चतुर्थस्तनयो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Three daughters endowed with beauty and good qualities were born to Menā, / and a fourth child, a son renowned as Sunābha, was born.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāṅgī raktanetrā ca raktāmbaravibhūṣitā /
rāgiṇi nāma saṃjātā jyeṣṭhā menāsutā mune //
meaning:
रक्ताङ्गी रक्तनेत्रा च रक्ताम्बरविभूषिता /
रागिणि नाम संजाता ज्येष्ठा मेनासुता मुने //
text_mt: Having red limbs, red eyes, and adorned in red garments, / she who was born by the name Rāgiṇī was the eldest daughter of Menā, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāṅgī padmapatrākṣī nīlakuñcitamūrdhajā /
śvetamālyāmbaradharā kuṭilā nāma cāparā //
meaning:
शुभाङ्गी पद्मपत्राक्षी नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजा /
श्वेतमाल्याम्बरधरा कुटिला नाम चापरा //
text_mt: Having auspicious limbs, eyes like lotus petals, and dark curled hair, / wearing white garlands and clothes, the other was named Kuṭilā.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāñcanacayaprakhyā nīlendīvaralocanā /
rūpeṇānupamā kālī jaghanyā menakāsutā //
meaning:
नीलाञ्चनचयप्रख्या नीलेन्दीवरलोचना /
रूपेणानुपमा काली जघन्या मेनकासुता //
text_mt: Resembling a heap of black collyrium, with eyes like blue lotuses, / peerless in beauty, Kālī was the youngest daughter of Menakā.

sanskrit_iast:
jātāstāḥ kanyakāstisraḥ ṣaḍabdāt parato mune /
kartuṃ tapaḥ prayātāstā devāstā dadṛśuḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
जातास्ताः कन्यकास्तिस्रः षडब्दात् परतो मुने /
कर्तुं तपः प्रयातास्ता देवास्ता ददृशुः शुभाः //
text_mt: After six years from their birth, O sage, those three daughters / went to perform ascetic austerities; the gods beheld those auspicious ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tato divākaraiḥ sarvairvasubhiśca tapasvinī /
kuṭilā ba3hmalokaṃ tu nītā śaśikaraprabhā //
meaning:
ततो दिवाकरैः सर्वैर्वसुभिश्च तपस्विनी /
कुटिला ब3ह्मलोकं तु नीता शशिकरप्रभा //
text_mt: Then the ascetic Kuṭilā, having the radiance of moonbeams, / was taken to the world of Brahmā by all the Ādityas and the Vasus.

sanskrit_iast:
athocurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ kiṃ tviyaṃ janayiṣyati /
putraṃ mahiṣahantāraṃ brahman vyākhyātumarhasi //
meaning:
अथोचुर्देवताः सर्वाः किं त्वियं जनयिष्यति /
पुत्रं महिषहन्तारं ब्रह्मन् व्याख्यातुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Then all the deities said: 'Will this one give birth / to a son who will slay Mahiṣa? O Brahmā, you ought to explain!'

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bravīt surapatirneyaṃ śaktā tapasvinī /
śārvaṃ dhārayituṃ tejo varākī mucyātāṃ tviyam //
meaning:
ततो ऽब्रवीत् सुरपतिर्नेयं शक्ता तपस्विनी /
शार्वं धारयितुं तेजो वराकी मुच्यातां त्वियम् //
text_mt: Then the lord of the gods said: 'This poor ascetic girl is not capable / of bearing the fiery energy of Śarva; let her be released.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu kuṭulā ṛddhā brahmāṇaṃ prāha nārada /
tathā yatiṣye bhagavan yatā śārvaṃ sudurddharam //
meaning:
ततस्तु कुटुला ऋद्धा ब्रह्माणं प्राह नारद /
तथा यतिष्ये भगवन् यता शार्वं सुदुर्द्धरम् //
text_mt: Then Kuṭilā, enraged, said to Brahmā, O Nārada: / 'I shall make such an effort, O lord, that the exceedingly hard-to-bear fiery energy of Śarva'

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ tejastathaiva śruṇu sattama /
tapasāhaṃ sutaptena samārādhya janārdanam //
meaning:
धारयिष्याम्यहं तेजस्तथैव श्रुणु सत्तम /
तपसाहं सुतप्तेन समाराध्य जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: 'I will indeed bear; hear thus, O best of beings! / By well-performed austerity, having propitiated Janārdana,'

sanskrit_iast:
yathā harasya mūrdhānaṃ namayithye pitāmaha /
tathā deva kariṣyāmi satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam //
meaning:
यथा हरस्य मूर्धानं नमयिथ्ये पितामह /
तथा देव करिष्यामि सत्यं सत्यं मयोदितम् //
text_mt: 'I shall cause Hara's head to bend down, O grandfather; / thus, O god, shall I act; what I have spoken is true, truly true!'

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
tataḥ pitāmahaḥ kruddhaḥ kuṭilāṃ prāha dāruṇām /
bhagavānādikṛd brahmā sarveśo 'pi mahāmun //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
ततः पितामहः क्रुद्धः कुटिलां प्राह दारुणाम् /
भगवानादिकृद् ब्रह्मा सर्वेशो ऽपि महामुन् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Then the grandfather, the venerable creator Brahmā, the lord of all, / became angry and said to harsh Kuṭilā, O great sage:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca /
yasmānmadvacanaṃ pāpe na kṣāntaṃ kuṭile tvayā /
tasmānmacchāpanirdagdhā sarvā āpo bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच /
यस्मान्मद्वचनं पापे न क्षान्तं कुटिले त्वया /
तस्मान्मच्छापनिर्दग्धा सर्वा आपो भविष्यसि //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'Since my word was not tolerated by you, O wicked Kuṭilā, / therefore, consumed by my curse, you shall become all water!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ brahmaṇā śaptā himavad duhitā mune /
āpomayī brahmalokaṃ plāvayāmāsa veginī //
meaning:
इत्येवं ब्रह्मणा शप्ता हिमवद् दुहिता मुने /
आपोमयी ब्रह्मलोकं प्लावयामास वेगिनी //
text_mt: Thus cursed by Brahmā, the daughter of Himavat, O sage, / turned into water and swift-flowing flooded the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmudvṛttajalāṃ dṛṣṭvā prababandha pitāmahaḥ /
ṛksāmātharvayajubhirvāṅmayairbandhanairdṛḍham //
meaning:
तामुद्वृत्तजलां दृष्ट्वा प्रबबन्ध पितामहः /
ऋक्सामाथर्वयजुभिर्वाङ्मयैर्बन्धनैर्दृढम् //
text_mt: Seeing her waters overflowing, the grandfather bound her firmly / with verbal bonds consisting of the Ṛg, Sāman, Atharvan, and Yajus [verses].

sanskrit_iast:
sā baddhā sisthitā brahman tatraiva girikanyakā /
āpomayī plāvayantī brahmaṇo vimalā jaṭāḥ //
meaning:
सा बद्धा सिस्थिता ब्रह्मन् तत्रैव गिरिकन्यका /
आपोमयी प्लावयन्ती ब्रह्मणो विमला जटाः //
text_mt: Bound there, O sage, that daughter of the mountain remained, / turned into water, washing the pure matted locks of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
yā sā rāgavatī nāma sāpi nītā surairdivam /
brahmaṇe tāṃ nivedyaivaṃ tāmapyāha prajāpatiḥ //
sāpi kruddhābravīnnūnaṃ tathā tapsye mahattapaḥ /
yathā mannāmasaṃyukto mahiṣaghno bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
या सा रागवती नाम सापि नीता सुरैर्दिवम् /
ब्रह्मणे तां निवेद्यैवं तामप्याह प्रजापतिः //
सापि क्रुद्धाब्रवीन्नूनं तथा तप्स्ये महत्तपः /
यथा मन्नामसंयुक्तो महिषघ्नो भविष्यति //
text_mt: She who was named Rāgavatī was also led to heaven by the gods. / Having presented her thus to Brahmā, Prajāpati also spoke to her. / She too, enraged, said: 'Indeed, I will perform such great austerity / that the slayer of Mahiṣa will be linked with my name!'

sanskrit_iast:
tāmapyathāśapad brahma sandhyā pāpe bhaviṣyasi /
yā madvākyamalaṅghyaṃ vai surairlaṅghayase balāt //
meaning:
तामप्यथाशपद् ब्रह्म सन्ध्या पापे भविष्यसि /
या मद्वाक्यमलङ्घ्यं वै सुरैर्लङ्घयसे बलात् //
text_mt: Then Brahmā cursed her also: 'You shall become twilight, O wicked one, / who forcibly transgress through the gods my command that must not be transgressed!'

sanskrit_iast:
tāmapyathāśapad brahma sandhyā pāpe bhaviṣyasi /
yā madvākyamalaṅghyaṃ vai surairlaṅghayase balāt //
meaning:
तामप्यथाशपद् ब्रह्म सन्ध्या पापे भविष्यसि /
या मद्वाक्यमलङ्घ्यं वै सुरैर्लङ्घयसे बलात् //
text_mt: Then Brahmā cursed her also: 'You shall become twilight, O wicked one, / who forcibly transgress through the gods my command that must not be transgressed!'

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi jātā muniśreṣṭha sandhyā rāgavatī tataḥ /
pratīcchat kṛttikāyogaṃ śaileyā vigrahaṃ dṛḍham //
meaning:
सापि जाता मुनिश्रेष्ठ सन्ध्या रागवती ततः /
प्रतीच्छत् कृत्तिकायोगं शैलेया विग्रहं दृढम् //
text_mt: She too, O best of sages, then became twilight full of passion; / the daughter of the mountain, assuming a firm form, awaited conjunction with the Kṛttikās.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gate kanyake dve jñātvā menā tapasvinī /
tapaso vārayamāsa umetyevābravīcca sā //
meaning:
ततो गते कन्यके द्वे ज्ञात्वा मेना तपस्विनी /
तपसो वारयमास उमेत्येवाब्रवीच्च सा //
text_mt: When the two daughters had thus departed, the ascetic Menā, having learned of it, / restrained [the third] from austerity and said to her: 'U mā' ('O, do not!').

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva mātā nāmāsyāścakre pitṛsutā śubhā /
umetyeva hi kanyāyāḥ sā jagāma tapovanam //
meaning:
तदेव माता नामास्याश्चक्रे पितृसुता शुभा /
उमेत्येव हि कन्यायाः सा जगाम तपोवनम् //
text_mt: The mother, the auspicious daughter of the ancestors, gave that very name to her— / indeed, 'Umā' to the maiden; [yet] she went to the penance grove.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā manasā devaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ vṛṣadhvajam /
rudraṃ cetasi saṃdhāya tapastepe suduṣkaram //
meaning:
ततः सा मनसा देवं शूलपाणिं वृषध्वजम् /
रुद्रं चेतसि संधाय तपस्तेपे सुदुष्करम् //
text_mt: Then, meditating in her mind on Rudra, the god who holds the trident in his hand / and has the bull on his banner, she performed exceedingly difficult austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmābravīd devān gacchadhvaṃ himavatsutām /
ihānayadhvaṃ tāṃ kālīṃ tapasyantīṃ himālaye //
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्माब्रवीद् देवान् गच्छध्वं हिमवत्सुताम् /
इहानयध्वं तां कालीं तपस्यन्तीं हिमालये //
text_mt: Then Brahmā said to the gods: 'Go to the daughter of Himavat; / bring here that Kālī who is performing penance on the Himālaya.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato devāḥ samājagmurdadṛśupaḥ śailanandinīm /
tejasā vijitāstasyā na śekurupasarpitum //
meaning:
ततो देवाः समाजग्मुर्ददृशुपः शैलनन्दिनीम् /
तेजसा विजितास्तस्या न शेकुरुपसर्पितुम् //
text_mt: Then the gods came and beheld the daughter of the mountain; / overcome by her fiery radiance, they were unable to approach.

sanskrit_iast:
indro 'maragaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ nirddhūtastejasā tayā /
brahmaṇo 'dhikatejo 'syā vinivedya pratiṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रो ऽमरगणैः सार्द्धं निर्द्धूतस्तेजसा तया /
ब्रह्मणो ऽधिकतेजो ऽस्या विनिवेद्य प्रतिष्ठितः //
text_mt: Indra along with the hosts of immortals was repelled by her radiance; / having reported her surpassing splendor to Brahmā, he stood firm.

sanskrit_iast:
tato brahmābravīt sā di dhravaṃ śaṅkaravallabhā /
yūyaṃ yattejasā nūnaṃ vikṣiptāstu hataprabhāḥ //
meaning:
ततो ब्रह्माब्रवीत् सा दि ध्रवं शङ्करवल्लभा /
यूयं यत्तेजसा नूनं विक्षिप्तास्तु हतप्रभाः //
text_mt: Then Brahmā said: 'She is certainly the beloved of Śaṅkara, / since you indeed, having lost your luster, were hurled back by her fiery splendor.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād bhajadhvaṃ sva svaṃ hi sthānaṃ bho vigatajvarāḥ /
satārakaṃ hi mahiṣaṃ vidadhvaṃ nihataṃ raṇe //
meaning:
तस्माद् भजध्वं स्व स्वं हि स्थानं भो विगतज्वराः /
सतारकं हि महिषं विदध्वं निहतं रणे //
text_mt: 'Therefore, O ones freed from anxiety, repair each to your own abode; / consider Mahiṣa along with Tāraka already slain in battle.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktā devena brahmaṇā sendrakāḥ surāḥ /
jagmuḥ svānyeva dhiṣṇyāni sadyo vai vigatajvarāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ता देवेन ब्रह्मणा सेन्द्रकाः सुराः /
जग्मुः स्वान्येव धिष्ण्यानि सद्यो वै विगतज्वराः //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the god Brahmā, the gods with Indra at their head / immediately went to their own abodes, freed from distress.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmapi tapasyantīṃ himavān parvateśvaraḥ /
nivartya tapasastasmāt sadāro hyanayadgṛhān //
meaning:
उमामपि तपस्यन्तीं हिमवान् पर्वतेश्वरः /
निवर्त्य तपसस्तस्मात् सदारो ह्यनयद्गृहान् //
text_mt: And Himavat, the lord of mountains, turned Umā away from that asceticism as she was practicing austerities, / and accompanied by his wife, he brought her home.

sanskrit_iast:
devo 'pyāśritya tadraudraṃ vrataṃ nāmnā nirāśrayam /
vicacāra mahāśailān seruprāgryān mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
देवो ऽप्याश्रित्य तद्रौद्रं व्रतं नाम्ना निराश्रयम् /
विचचार महाशैलान् सेरुप्राग्र्यान् महामतिः //
text_mt: The god too, taking recourse to that fierce observance known as Nirāśraya, / wandered over great mountains, the foremost of peaks, being great in intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmahāśailaṃ himavantaṃ samāgataḥ /
tenārcitaḥ śraddhayāsau tāṃ rātrimavasaddharaḥ //
meaning:
स कदाचिन्महाशैलं हिमवन्तं समागतः /
तेनार्चितः श्रद्धयासौ तां रात्रिमवसद्धरः //
text_mt: Once he arrived at the great mountain Himavat; / worshiped by him with devotion, Hara dwelt there for that night.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye 'hni girīśena mahādevo namantritaḥ /
ihaiva tiṣṭhasva vibho tapaḥsādhanākāraṇāt //
meaning:
द्वितीये ऽह्नि गिरीशेन महादेवो नमन्त्रितः /
इहैव तिष्ठस्व विभो तपःसाधनाकारणात् //
text_mt: On the second day, Mahādeva was invited by the lord of the mountains: / 'Remain right here, O Lord, for the sake of accomplishing your austerities.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukto giriṇā haraścakre matiṃ ca tām /
tasthāvāśramamāśritya tyaktvā vāsaṃ nirāśrayam //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तो गिरिणा हरश्चक्रे मतिं च ताम् /
तस्थावाश्रममाश्रित्य त्यक्त्वा वासं निराश्रयम् //
text_mt: Being addressed thus by the mountain, Hara set his mind on it; / abandoning his homeless wandering, he stayed, taking shelter in a hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
vasato 'pyāśrame tasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ /
taṃ deśamagamat kālī girirājasutā śubhā //
meaning:
वसतो ऽप्याश्रमे तस्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः /
तं देशमगमत् काली गिरिराजसुता शुभा //
text_mt: While that god of gods, the trident-wielder, was residing in the hermitage, / auspicious Kālī, the daughter of the king of mountains, went to that place.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmāgatāṃ haro dṛṣṭvā bhūyo jātāṃ priyāṃ satīm /
svāgatenābhisaṃpūjya tasthau yogarato haraḥ //
meaning:
तामागतां हरो दृष्ट्वा भूयो जातां प्रियां सतीम् /
स्वागतेनाभिसंपूज्य तस्थौ योगरतो हरः //
text_mt: Seeing her arrived—his beloved Satī born once again— / Hara welcomed and honored her, and remained engrossed in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
sā cābhyetya varārohā kṛtāñjaparigrahā /
vavande caraṇau śauvau sakhībhiḥ saha bhāminī //
meaning:
सा चाभ्येत्य वरारोहा कृताञ्जपरिग्रहा /
ववन्दे चरणौ शौवौ सखीभिः सह भामिनी //
text_mt: And she, having lovely hips, folded her hands, / and accompanied by her female companions, the radiant woman bowed at Śiva’s feet.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu sucirāccharvaḥ samīkṣya girikanyakām /
na yuktaṃ caivamuktvātha sagaṇo 'ntardadhe tataḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु सुचिराच्छर्वः समीक्ष्य गिरिकन्यकाम् /
न युक्तं चैवमुक्त्वाथ सगणो ऽन्तर्दधे ततः //
text_mt: Then, after a long time, Śarva looked upon the mountain's daughter, / said, 'This is not proper,' and vanished from there along with his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi śarvavaco raudraṃ śrutvā jñānasamanvitā /
antarduḥkhena dahyantī pitaraṃ prāha pārvatī //
meaning:
सापि शर्ववचो रौद्रं श्रुत्वा ज्ञानसमन्विता /
अन्तर्दुःखेन दह्यन्ती पितरं प्राह पार्वती //
text_mt: Hearing Śarva's fierce words, endowed with knowledge, / and burning with inner sorrow, Pārvatī said to her father:

sanskrit_iast:
tāta yāsye mahāraṇye taptuṃ ghoraṃ mahattapaḥ /
ārādhanāya devasya śaṅkarasya pinākinaḥ //
meaning:
तात यास्ये महारण्ये तप्तुं घोरं महत्तपः /
आराधनाय देवस्य शङ्करस्य पिनाकिनः //
text_mt: “Father, I shall go into the great forest to perform severe and great austerities / to propitiate the god Śaṅkara, the bearer of the Pināka bow.”

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktaṃ vacaḥ pitrā pāde tasyaiva vistṛte /
lalitākhyā tapastepe harārādhanākāmyayā //
meaning:
तथेत्युक्तं वचः पित्रा पादे तस्यैव विस्तृते /
ललिताख्या तपस्तेपे हराराधनाकाम्यया //
text_mt: When her father said, “So be it,” on the extensive slope of that very [mountain], / she, named Lalitā, practiced austerities with the desire to propitiate Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ sakhyastadā devyāḥ paricaryā tu kurvate /
samitkuśaphalaṃ cāpi mūlāharaṇamāditaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याः सख्यस्तदा देव्याः परिचर्या तु कुर्वते /
समित्कुशफलं चापि मूलाहरणमादितः //
text_mt: Then the goddess’s female companions rendered her service, / continually gathering sacrificial firewood, kuśa grass, fruits, and roots.

sanskrit_iast:
vinodanārthaṃ pārvatyā mṛnmayaḥ śūladhṛg haraḥ /
kṛtastu tejasā yukto bhadramastviti sābravīt //
meaning:
विनोदनार्थं पार्वत्या मृन्मयः शूलधृग् हरः /
कृतस्तु तेजसा युक्तो भद्रमस्त्विति साब्रवीत् //
text_mt: For recreation, Pārvatī fashioned an earthen trident-bearing Hara, / endowed with splendor, and she said, “May there be auspiciousness!”

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ karoti tasyaiva taṃ paśyati muhurmuhuḥ /
tato 'syāstuṣṭimagamacchraddhayā tripurāntakṛt //
meaning:
पूजां करोति तस्यैव तं पश्यति मुहुर्मुहुः /
ततो ऽस्यास्तुष्टिमगमच्छ्रद्धया त्रिपुरान्तकृत् //
text_mt: She worshiped him and looked upon him again and again; / then the destroyer of Tripura was pleased with her devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
baṭurūpaṃ samādhāya āṣāḍhī muñjamekhalī /
yajñopavītī chatrī ca mṛgājinadharastathā //
meaning:
बटुरूपं समाधाय आषाढी मुञ्जमेखली /
यज्ञोपवीती छत्री च मृगाजिनधरस्तथा //
text_mt: Assuming the form of a celibate student, holding a palāśa staff, wearing a girdle of muñja grass, / wearing a sacred thread, carrying an umbrella, and clad in a deer skin,

sanskrit_iast:
kamaṇḍaluvyagrakaro bhasmāruṇitavigrahaḥ /
pratyāśramaṃ paryaṭan sa taṃ kālyāśramamāgataḥ //
meaning:
कमण्डलुव्यग्रकरो भस्मारुणितविग्रहः /
प्रत्याश्रमं पर्यटन् स तं काल्याश्रममागतः //
text_mt: his hand occupied with a water pot, his body reddish-grey with ashes, / wandering from hermitage to hermitage, he arrived at Kālī’s hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
tamutthāya tadā kālī sakhībhiḥ saha nārada /
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ paryapṛcchadidaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
तमुत्थाय तदा काली सखीभिः सह नारद /
पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं पर्यपृच्छदिदं ततः //
text_mt: Rising then with her female companions, O Nārada, / Kālī worshiped him according to rule and then inquired of him this:

sanskrit_iast:
umovāca /
kasmādāgamyate bhikṣo kutra sthāne tavāśramaḥ /
kva ca tvaṃ pratigantāsi mama śīghraṃ nivedaya //
meaning:
उमोवाच /
कस्मादागम्यते भिक्षो कुत्र स्थाने तवाश्रमः /
क्व च त्वं प्रतिगन्तासि मम शीघ्रं निवेदय //
text_mt:
Umā said:
“Where do you come from, O mendicant? Where is your hermitage located?
And where will you go? Tell me quickly.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuruvāca/ /
mamāśramapadaṃ bāle vārāṇasyāṃ śucivrate /
athātastīrthayātrāyāṃ gamiṣyāmi pṛthūdakam //
meaning:
भिक्षुरुवाच/ /
ममाश्रमपदं बाले वाराणस्यां शुचिव्रते /
अथातस्तीर्थयात्रायां गमिष्यामि पृथूदकम् //

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca /
kiṃ puṇyaṃ tatra viprendra labdhāsi tvaṃ pṛthūdake /
pathi snānena ca phalaṃ keṣu kiṃ labdavānasi //
meaning:
देव्युवाच /
किं पुण्यं तत्र विप्रेन्द्र लब्धासि त्वं पृथूदके /
पथि स्नानेन च फलं केषु किं लब्दवानसि //
text_mt:
The goddess said:
“What merit will you obtain there at Pṛthūdaka, O best of Brahmins?
And what fruit have you obtained on the way, by bathing in which [waters]?”

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuruvāca /
mayā snānaṃ prayāge tu kṛtaṃ prathamameva hi /
tato 'tha tīrthe kubjāmre jayante caṇḍikeśvare //
meaning:
भिक्षुरुवाच /
मया स्नानं प्रयागे तु कृतं प्रथममेव हि /
ततो ऽथ तीर्थे कुब्जाम्रे जयन्ते चण्डिकेश्वरे //

sanskrit_iast:
bandhuvṛnde ca karkandhe tīrthe kanakhale tathā /
sarasvatyāmagnikuṇḍe bhadrāyāṃ tu triviṣṭape //
meaning:
बन्धुवृन्दे च कर्कन्धे तीर्थे कनखले तथा /
सरस्वत्यामग्निकुण्डे भद्रायां तु त्रिविष्टपे //
text_mt:
at Bandhuvṛnda, at Karkandha, and likewise at the tīrtha Kanakhala;
in the Sarasvatī, at Agnikuṇḍa, at Bhadrā, and at Triviṣṭapa;

sanskrit_iast:
konaṭe koṭitīrthe ca kubjake ca kṛsodari /
nithkāmena kṛtaṃ snānaṃ tato 'bhyāgāṃ tavāśramam //
meaning:
कोनटे कोटितीर्थे च कुब्जके च कृसोदरि /
निथ्कामेन कृतं स्नानं ततो ऽभ्यागां तवाश्रमम् //
text_mt:
at Konaṭa, at Koṭitīrtha, and at Kubjaka, O slender-waisted lady;
having bathed without desire, I then came to your hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
ihasthāṃ tvāṃ samābhāṣya gamiṣyāmi pṛthūdakam /
pṛcchāmi yadahaṃ tvāṃ vai tatra na kroddhumarhasi //
meaning:
इहस्थां त्वां समाभाष्य गमिष्यामि पृथूदकम् /
पृच्छामि यदहं त्वां वै तत्र न क्रोद्धुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Having spoken with you who are here, I will proceed to Pṛthūdaka.
Do not be angry with me on account of what I ask you:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ yattapasātmānaṃ śoṣayāmi kṛśodari /
bālye 'pi saṃyatatanustattu ślāghyaṃ dvijanmanām //
meaning:
अहं यत्तपसात्मानं शोषयामि कृशोदरि /
बाल्ये ऽपि संयततनुस्तत्तु श्लाघ्यं द्विजन्मनाम् //
text_mt: That I emaciate myself through austerities, O slender-waisted lady, / having a restrained body even in youth—that is praiseworthy for the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ bhavatī raudraṃ prathame vayasi sthitā /
tapaḥ samāśritā bhīru saṃśayaḥ pratibhāti me //
meaning:
किमर्थं भवती रौद्रं प्रथमे वयसि स्थिता /
तपः समाश्रिता भीरु संशयः प्रतिभाति मे //
text_mt: Why have you, living in the first stage of youth, / undertaken fierce austerities, O timid one? Doubt appears to me.

sanskrit_iast:
prathame vayasi strīṇāṃ saha bhartrā vilāsini /
subhogā bhogitāḥ kāle vrajanti sthirayauvane //
meaning:
प्रथमे वयसि स्त्रीणां सह भर्त्रा विलासिनि /
सुभोगा भोगिताः काले व्रजन्ति स्थिरयौवने //
text_mt: In the first stage of life, delightful women, together with their husbands, / enjoy fine pleasures, and in due course proceed into mature youth.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā vāñchayantīha girije sacarācarāḥ /
rūpābhijanamaiśvaryaṃ tacca te vidyate bahu //
meaning:
तपसा वाञ्छयन्तीह गिरिजे सचराचराः /
रूपाभिजनमैश्वर्यं तच्च ते विद्यते बहु //
text_mt: All beings moving and unmoving in this world desire through austerities, O daughter of the mountain, / beauty, noble birth, and sovereignty; and that you possess in abundance.

sanskrit_iast:
tat kimarthamapāsyaitānalaṅkārāñ jaṭā dhṛtāḥ /
cīnāṃśukaṃ parityajya kiṃ tvaṃ valkaladhāriṇī //
meaning:
तत् किमर्थमपास्यैतानलङ्काराञ् जटा धृताः /
चीनांशुकं परित्यज्य किं त्वं वल्कलधारिणी //
text_mt:
Why then have you discarded these ornaments and worn matted hair?
Abandoning Chinese silk, why do you wear bark garments?”

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
tatastu tapasā vṛddhā devyāḥ somaprabhā sakhī /
bhikṣave kathayāmāsa yathāvat sā hi nārada //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
ततस्तु तपसा वृद्धा देव्याः सोमप्रभा सखी /
भिक्षवे कथयामास यथावत् सा हि नारद //
text_mt:
Pulastya said:
Then Somaprabhā, the goddess’s friend grown mature through austerities, / spoke truthfully to the mendicant, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
somaprabhovāca /
tapaścaryā dvijaśreṣṭha pārvatyā yena hetunā /
taṃ śṛṇuṣva tviyaṃ kālī haraṃ bhartāramicchati //
meaning:
सोमप्रभोवाच /
तपश्चर्या द्विजश्रेष्ठ पार्वत्या येन हेतुना /
तं शृणुष्व त्वियं काली हरं भर्तारमिच्छति //
text_mt:
Somaprabhā said:
“Hear, O best of the twice-born, the reason / for Pārvatī’s practice of austerities: this Kālī desires Hara as her husband.”

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
somaprabhāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃkampya vai śiraḥ /
vihasya ca mahāhāsaṃ bhikṣurāha vacastvidam //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
सोमप्रभाया वचनं श्रुत्वा संकम्प्य वै शिरः /
विहस्य च महाहासं भिक्षुराह वचस्त्विदम् //
text_mt:
Pulastya said:
Hearing Somaprabhā’s words, shaking his head / and laughing a great laugh, the mendicant spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuruvāca/ /
vadāmi te pārvati vākyamevaṃ kena pradattā tava buddhireṣā /
kathaṃ karaḥ pallavakomalaste sameṣyate śārvakaraṃ sasarpam //
meaning:
भिक्षुरुवाच/ /
वदामि ते पार्वति वाक्यमेवं केन प्रदत्ता तव बुद्धिरेषा /
कथं करः पल्लवकोमलस्ते समेष्यते शार्वकरं ससर्पम् //
text_mt:
The mendicant said:
“I speak this word to you, Pārvatī: by whom was this idea given to you? / How will your hand, tender as a sprout, join with Śarva’s serpent-bearing hand?

sanskrit_iast:
tathā dukūlāmbaraśālinī tvaṃ mṛgāricarmābhivṛtastu rudraḥ /
tvaṃ candanāktā sa bhasmabhūṣito na yuktarūpaṃ pratibhāti me tvidam //
meaning:
तथा दुकूलाम्बरशालिनी त्वं मृगारिचर्माभिवृतस्तु रुद्रः /
त्वं चन्दनाक्ता स भस्मभूषितो न युक्तरूपं प्रतिभाति मे त्विदम् //
text_mt: Likewise, you are clad in fine silk, while Rudra is covered with the skin of a lion; / you are anointed with sandalwood paste, while he is adorned with ashes; this does not seem suitable to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
evaṃ vādini viprendra pārvatī bhikṣumabravīt /
mā maivaṃ vada bikṣo tvaṃ haraḥ sarvaguṇādhikaḥ //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
एवं वादिनि विप्रेन्द्र पार्वती भिक्षुमब्रवीत् /
मा मैवं वद बिक्षो त्वं हरः सर्वगुणाधिकः //
text_mt:
Pulastya said:
When the best of Brahmins had spoken thus, Pārvatī said to the mendicant: / “Do not speak like this, O mendicant; Hara surpasses all in virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo vāpyathavā bhīmaḥ sadhano nirdhano 'pi vā /
alaṅkṛto vā deveśastathā vāpyanalaṅkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शिवो वाप्यथवा भीमः सधनो निर्धनो ऽपि वा /
अलङ्कृतो वा देवेशस्तथा वाप्यनलङ्कृतः //
text_mt: Whether he is auspicious or terrible, wealthy or penniless, / whether the lord of gods is adorned or unadorned,

sanskrit_iast:
yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi sa me nātho bhaviṣyati /
nivāryatāmayaṃ bhikṣurvivakṣuḥ sphuritādharaḥ /
na tathā nindakaḥ pāpī yathā śṛṇvan śaśiprabhe //
meaning:
यादृशस्तादृशो वापि स मे नाथो भविष्यति /
निवार्यतामयं भिक्षुर्विवक्षुः स्फुरिताधरः /
न तथा निन्दकः पापी यथा शृण्वन् शशिप्रभे //
text_mt:
whichever and whatever he may be, he shall be my lord!
Let this mendicant, eager to speak with quivering lips, be turned away!
The censurer is not as sinful, O moon-radiant one, as the one who listens.”

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
ityevamuktvā varadā samutthātumathaicchata /
tato 'tyajad bhikṣurūpaṃ svarūpastho 'bhavacchivaḥ //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वरदा समुत्थातुमथैच्छत /
ततो ऽत्यजद् भिक्षुरूपं स्वरूपस्थो ऽभवच्छिवः //
text_mt:
Pulastya said:
Having spoken thus, the giver of boons desired to stand up; / then Śiva shed the form of a mendicant and stood in his own form.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtvovāca priye gaccha svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ /
tavārthāya praheṣyāmi maharṣin himavadgṛhe //
meaning:
भूत्वोवाच प्रिये गच्छ स्वमेव भवनं पितुः /
तवार्थाय प्रहेष्यामि महर्षिन् हिमवद्गृहे //
text_mt: Becoming [himself], he said: “Beloved, go to your father’s own dwelling; / for your sake I will send the great sages to Himavat’s house.

sanskrit_iast:
yacceha rudramīhantyā mṛnmayaśceśvaraḥ kṛtaḥ /
asau bhadreśvaretyevaṃ khyāto loke bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
यच्चेह रुद्रमीहन्त्या मृन्मयश्चेश्वरः कृतः /
असौ भद्रेश्वरेत्येवं ख्यातो लोके भविष्यति //
text_mt: And because an earthen lord was fashioned here by you who desired Rudra, / he will be renowned in the world under the name of Bhadreśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣāḥ kiṃpuruṣoragāḥ /
pūjayiṣyanti satataṃ mānavāśca śubhepsavaḥ //
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षाः किंपुरुषोरगाः /
पूजयिष्यन्ति सततं मानवाश्च शुभेप्सवः //
text_mt: Devas, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Kiṃpuruṣas, and Uragas, / and humans seeking auspiciousness shall constantly worship him.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktā devena girirājasutā mune /
jagāmāmbaramāviśya svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ता देवेन गिरिराजसुता मुने /
जगामाम्बरमाविश्य स्वमेव भवनं पितुः //
text_mt: Addressed in this manner by the god, O sage, / the mountain king’s daughter entered the sky and went to her father’s own home.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkaro 'pi mahātejā visṛjya kirikanyakām /
pṛthūdakaṃ jagāmātha snānaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
शङ्करो ऽपि महातेजा विसृज्य किरिकन्यकाम् /
पृथूदकं जगामाथ स्नानं चक्रे विधानतः //
text_mt: Śaṅkara too, endowed with great splendor, having dismissed the mountain's daughter, / then went to Pṛthūdaka and bathed in accordance with the prescribed rules.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu devapravaro maheśvaraḥ pṛthūdake snānamapāstakalmaṣaḥ /
kṛtvā sanandiḥ sagaṇaḥ savāhano mahāgiriṃ mandaramājagāma //
meaning:
ततस्तु देवप्रवरो महेश्वरः पृथूदके स्नानमपास्तकल्मषः /
कृत्वा सनन्दिः सगणः सवाहनो महागिरिं मन्दरमाजगाम //
text_mt: Then Maheśvara, the foremost of gods, having bathed at Pṛthūdaka and cast off all defilement, / went to the great mountain Mandara along with Nandin, his attendants, and his mount.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāti tripurāntake saha gaṇairbrahmarṣibhiḥ saptabhirārohatpulako babhau girivaraḥ saṃhṛṣṭatittaḥ kṣaṇāt /
cakre divyaphalairjalena śucinā mūlaiśca kandādibhiḥ pūjāṃ sarvagaṇeśvaraiḥ saha vibhoradristrinetrasya tu //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
आयाति त्रिपुरान्तके सह गणैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सप्तभिरारोहत्पुलको बभौ गिरिवरः संहृष्टतित्तः क्षणात् /
चक्रे दिव्यफलैर्जलेन शुचिना मूलैश्च कन्दादिभिः पूजां सर्वगणेश्वरैः सह विभोरद्रिस्त्रिनेत्रस्य तु //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
As the destroyer of Tripura approached together with his attendants and the seven Brahmin sages, / the excellent mountain, thrilled in an instant, bristled with joy; / and with all the lords of attendants, the mountain worshipped the all-pervading, three-eyed Lord / with divine fruits, pure water, and roots, tubers, and other offerings.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter in the glorious Vāmana Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
tataḥ saṃpūjito rudraḥ śailena prītimānabhūt /
sasmāra ca maharṣistu arundhatyā samaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
ततः संपूजितो रुद्रः शैलेन प्रीतिमानभूत् /
सस्मार च महर्षिस्तु अरुन्धत्या समं ततः //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Then, duly worshipped by the mountain, Rudra was pleased, / and the great sage [Śiva] then remembered [the seven sages] together with Arundhatī.

sanskrit_iast:
te saṃsmṛtāstu ṛṣayaḥ śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā /
samājagmurmahāśailaṃ mandaraṃ cārukandaram //
meaning:
ते संस्मृतास्तु ऋषयः शङ्करेण महात्मना /
समाजग्मुर्महाशैलं मन्दरं चारुकन्दरम् //
text_mt: Remembered by the great-souled Śaṅkara, those sages / arrived at the great mountain Mandara with its lovely caves.

sanskrit_iast:
tānāgatān samīkṣyaiva devastripuranāśanaḥ /
abhyutthāyābhipūjyaitānidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
तानागतान् समीक्ष्यैव देवस्त्रिपुरनाशनः /
अभ्युत्थायाभिपूज्यैतानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Seeing them arrived, the god who destroyed Tripura / stood up, worshipped them, and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo 'yaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaḥ ślāghyaḥ pūjyaśca daivataiḥ /
dhūtapāpastathā jāto bhavatāṃ pādapaṅkajaiḥ //
meaning:
धन्यो ऽयं पर्वतश्रेष्ठः श्लाघ्यः पूज्यश्च दैवतैः /
धूतपापस्तथा जातो भवतां पादपङ्कजैः //
text_mt: "Blessed is this best of mountains, praiseworthy and worshipful to the deities; / and its sins have been cleansed by your lotus-like feet.

sanskrit_iast:
sthīyatāṃ vistṛte ramye giriprasthe same śubhe /
śilāsu padmavārṇāsu ślakṣṇāsu ca mṛduṣvapi //
meaning:
स्थीयतां विस्तृते रम्ये गिरिप्रस्थे समे शुभे /
शिलासु पद्मवार्णासु श्लक्ष्णासु च मृदुष्वपि //
text_mt: Be seated upon this broad, delightful, level, and auspicious mountain plateau, / on stones coloured like lotuses, smooth and soft."

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
ityevamuktā devena saṃkareṇa maharṣayaḥ /
samameva tvarundhatyā viviśuḥ śailasānuni //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
इत्येवमुक्ता देवेन संकरेण महर्षयः /
सममेव त्वरुन्धत्या विविशुः शैलसानुनि //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Thus addressed by the god Śaṅkara, the great sages, / together with Arundhatī, sat upon the mountain slope.

sanskrit_iast:
upaviṣṭeṣu ṛṣiṣu nandī devagaṇāgraṇīḥ /
arghyādinā samabhyarcya sthitaḥ prayatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
उपविष्टेषु ऋषिषु नन्दी देवगणाग्रणीः /
अर्घ्यादिना समभ्यर्च्य स्थितः प्रयतमानसः //
text_mt: When the sages were seated, Nandī, the leader of the host of gods, / worshipped them with guest-water and other offerings, and stood by with a focused mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bravīt surapatirdharmya vākyaṃ hitaṃ surān /
ātmano yaśaso vṛddhyai saptarṣīn vinayānvitān //
meaning:
ततो ऽब्रवीत् सुरपतिर्धर्म्य वाक्यं हितं सुरान् /
आत्मनो यशसो वृद्ध्यै सप्तर्षीन् विनयान्वितान् //
text_mt: Then the lord of gods, for the increase of his own renown, / spoke righteous and beneficial words to the modest seven sages:

sanskrit_iast:
hara uvāca /
kaśyapātre vāruṇeya gādheya śṛṇu gautam /
bharadvāja śṛṇuṣva tvamaṅgirastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca //
meaning:
हर उवाच /
कश्यपात्रे वारुणेय गाधेय शृणु गौतम् /
भरद्वाज शृणुष्व त्वमङ्गिरस्त्वं शृणुष्व च //
text_mt: Hara said: / "O Kaśyapa, Atri, Vāruṇeya, Gādheya, and Gautama, listen! / Bharadvāja, listen! And you, Aṅgiras, listen!

sanskrit_iast:
mamāsīd dakṣatanujā priyā sā dakṣakopataḥ /
utsasarja satī prāṇān yogadṛṣṭya purā kilaḥ //
meaning:
ममासीद् दक्षतनुजा प्रिया सा दक्षकोपतः /
उत्ससर्ज सती प्राणान् योगदृष्ट्य पुरा किलः //
text_mt: I once had my beloved, the daughter of Dakṣa; out of anger at Dakṣa, / Satī formerly cast off her vital breaths through yogic vision, as is known.

sanskrit_iast:
sādya bhūyaḥ samudbhūtā śailarājasutā umā /
sā madarthāya śailendro yācyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
साद्य भूयः समुद्भूता शैलराजसुता उमा /
सा मदर्थाय शैलेन्द्रो याच्यतां द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Today she has been born again as Umā, the daughter of the king of mountains. / For my sake, O best of twice-borns, let her be asked of the lord of mountains."

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
saptarṣayastvevamuktā bāḍhamityabruvan vacaḥ /
oṃnamaḥ śaṅkarāyeti proktvā jagmurhimālayam //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
सप्तर्षयस्त्वेवमुक्ता बाढमित्यब्रुवन् वचः /
ओंनमः शङ्करायेति प्रोक्त्वा जग्मुर्हिमालयम् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Thus addressed, the seven sages said, 'So be it,' / and having said, 'Om, salutations to Śaṅkara,' they departed for Himālaya.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'pyarundhatīṃ śarvaḥ prāha gacchasva sundari /
purandhryo hi purandhrīṇāṃ gatiṃ dharmasya ve viduḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽप्यरुन्धतीं शर्वः प्राह गच्छस्व सुन्दरि /
पुरन्ध्र्यो हि पुरन्ध्रीणां गतिं धर्मस्य वे विदुः //
text_mt: Then Śarva also said to Arundhatī: 'Go, O beautiful woman; / for noble ladies know the course of dharma of noble ladies.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktā durlaṅghyaṃ lokācāraṃ tvarundhatī /
namaste rudra ityuktvā jagāma patinā saha //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ता दुर्लङ्घ्यं लोकाचारं त्वरुन्धती /
नमस्ते रुद्र इत्युक्त्वा जगाम पतिना सह //
text_mt: Thus addressed, Arundhatī, [knowing] worldly custom is hard to violate, / said, 'Salutations to you, O Rudra,' and departed with her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā himādriśikharamoṣadhiprasthameva ca /
dadṛśuḥ śailarājasya purīṃ surapurīmiva //
meaning:
गत्वा हिमाद्रिशिखरमोषधिप्रस्थमेव च /
ददृशुः शैलराजस्य पुरीं सुरपुरीमिव //
text_mt: Having reached the peak of Himādri and Oṣadhiprastha itself, / they beheld the city of the king of mountains, like the city of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃpūjyamānāste śailayoṣidbhirādarāt /
sunābhādibhiravyagraiḥ pujyamānāstu parvataiḥ //
meaning:
ततः संपूज्यमानास्ते शैलयोषिद्भिरादरात् /
सुनाभादिभिरव्यग्रैः पुज्यमानास्तु पर्वतैः //
text_mt: Then, being respectfully greeted by the mountain women, / and being honoured by unperturbed mountains such as Sunābha and others,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvaiḥ kiṃnarairyakṣaistathānyaistatpurassaraiḥ /
viviśurbhavanaṃ ramyaṃ himādrerhāṭakojjavalam //
meaning:
गन्धर्वैः किंनरैर्यक्षैस्तथान्यैस्तत्पुरस्सरैः /
विविशुर्भवनं रम्यं हिमाद्रेर्हाटकोज्जवलम् //
text_mt: preceded by Gandharvas, Kiṃnaras, Yakṣas, and others, / they entered the delightful dwelling of Himādri, shining with gold.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarve mahātmānāstapasā dhautakalmaṣāḥ /
samāsādya mahādvāraṃ saṃtasthurdvāḥsthakāraṇāt //
meaning:
ततः सर्वे महात्मानास्तपसा धौतकल्मषाः /
समासाद्य महाद्वारं संतस्थुर्द्वाःस्थकारणात् //
text_mt: Then all those great-souled ones, their blemishes washed away by austerity, / approached the great portal and paused there on account of the doorkeeper.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tvarito 'bhyāgād dvāḥstho 'drirgandhamādanaḥ /
dhārayan vai kare daṇḍaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ mahat //
meaning:
ततस्तु त्वरितो ऽभ्यागाद् द्वाःस्थो ऽद्रिर्गन्धमादनः /
धारयन् वै करे दण्डं पद्मरागमयं महत् //
text_mt: Then the mountain Gandhamādana, the doorkeeper, quickly approached, / holding a great staff made of ruby in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastamūcurmunayo gatvā śailapatiṃ śubham /
nivedayāsmān saṃprāptān mahatkāryarthino vayam //
meaning:
ततस्तमूचुर्मुनयो गत्वा शैलपतिं शुभम् /
निवेदयास्मान् संप्राप्तान् महत्कार्यर्थिनो वयम् //
text_mt: Then the sages said to him: 'Go and announce us / as arrived to the auspicious lord of mountains; we seek a great matter.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktaḥ śailendro ṛṣibhirgandhamādanaḥ /
jagāma tatra yatrāste śailarājo 'dribhirvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तः शैलेन्द्रो ऋषिभिर्गन्धमादनः /
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते शैलराजो ऽद्रिभिर्वृतः //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the sages, the mountain Gandhamādana / went to where the king of mountains sat surrounded by mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣaṇṇo bhuvi jānubhyāṃ dattvā hastau mukhe giriḥ /
daṇḍaṃ nikṣipya kakṣāyāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
निषण्णो भुवि जानुभ्यां दत्त्वा हस्तौ मुखे गिरिः /
दण्डं निक्षिप्य कक्षायामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Kneeling on the ground on both knees, placing his hands to his mouth, / and tucking his staff under his armpit, the mountain spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
gandhamādana uvāca /
ime hi ṛṣayaḥ prāptāḥ śailarāja tavārthinaḥ /
dvāre sthaitāḥ kāryiṇaste tava darśanalālasāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धमादन उवाच /
इमे हि ऋषयः प्राप्ताः शैलराज तवार्थिनः /
द्वारे स्थैताः कार्यिणस्ते तव दर्शनलालसाः //
text_mt: Gandhamādana said: / 'Indeed, these sages have arrived as petitioners to you, O king of mountains; / they are standing at the door with a purpose, eager to see you.'

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
dvāḥsthavākyaṃ samākarṇya samutthāyācaleśvaraḥ /
svayamabhyāgamad dvāri samādāyārghyamuttamam //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
द्वाःस्थवाक्यं समाकर्ण्य समुत्थायाचलेश्वरः /
स्वयमभ्यागमद् द्वारि समादायार्घ्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Hearing the doorkeeper's words, the lord of mountains arose / and came in person to the door, taking excellent guest-water.

sanskrit_iast:
tānrcyārghyādinā śailaḥ samānīya sabhātalam /
uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ kṛtāsanaparigrahān //
meaning:
तान्र्च्यार्घ्यादिना शैलः समानीय सभातलम् /
उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः कृतासनपरिग्रहान् //
text_mt: Having honoured them with guest-water and the like, and brought them to the assembly hall, / the mountain, skilled in speech, spoke words to those who had taken their seats:

sanskrit_iast:
himavānuvāca /
anabhravṛṣṭiḥ kimiyamutāho 'kusumaṃ phalam /
apratarkyamacintyaṃ ca bhavadāgamanaṃ tvidam //
meaning:
हिमवानुवाच /
अनभ्रवृष्टिः किमियमुताहो ऽकुसुमं फलम् /
अप्रतर्क्यमचिन्त्यं च भवदागमनं त्विदम् //
text_mt: Himavat said: / 'Is this rain without clouds, or fruit without blossoms? / For this arrival of yours is inconceivable and beyond conjecture.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti dhanyo 'smi śailarāḍadya sattamāḥ /
saṃśuddhadeho 'smayadyaiva yad bhavanto mamājiram //
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति धन्यो ऽस्मि शैलराडद्य सत्तमाः /
संशुद्धदेहो ऽस्मयद्यैव यद् भवन्तो ममाजिरम् //
text_mt: From today onward I am blessed, today I am truly the king of mountains, O best of beings; / today my body is completely purified, in that you [have come] to my courtyard,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmasaṃsargasaṃśuddhaṃ kṛtavanto dvijottamāḥ /
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ padākrāntaṃ tīrthaṃ sārasvataṃ yathā //
meaning:
आत्मसंसर्गसंशुद्धं कृतवन्तो द्विजोत्तमाः /
दृष्टिपूतं पदाक्रान्तं तीर्थं सारस्वतं यथा //
text_mt: and have made it purified by your touch, O best of twice-borns, / sanctified by your gaze, trodden by your feet, like the tīrtha of Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
dāso 'haṃ bhavatāṃ viprāḥ kṛtapuṇyaś ca sāṃpratam /
yenārthino hi te yūyaṃ tanmamājñātumarhatha //
meaning:
दासो ऽहं भवतां विप्राः कृतपुण्यश् च सांप्रतम् /
येनार्थिनो हि ते यूयं तन्ममाज्ञातुमर्हथ //
text_mt: I am your servant, O Brahmins, and now my merit is accomplished. / You should inform me of that which you seek.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāro 'haṃ samaṃ putrairbhṛtyairnaptṛbhiravyayāḥ /
kiṅkaro 'smi sthito yuṣmadājñākārī taducyatām //
meaning:
सदारो ऽहं समं पुत्रैर्भृत्यैर्नप्तृभिरव्ययाः /
किङ्करो ऽस्मि स्थितो युष्मदाज्ञाकारी तदुच्यताम् //
text_mt: Together with my wife, sons, servants, and grandsons, O imperishable ones, / I stand as your servant, ready to carry out your commands; therefore speak!'

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
śailarājavacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ /
ūcuraṅgirasaṃ vṛddhaṃ kāryamadrau nivedaya //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
शैलराजवचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयः संशितव्रतः /
ऊचुरङ्गिरसं वृद्धं कार्यमद्रौ निवेदय //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Hearing the words of the mountain king, the sages of strict vows / said to the elder Aṅgiras: 'Declare the matter to the mountain.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ coditaḥ sarvairṛṣibiḥ kaśyapādibhiḥ /
pratyuvāca paraṃ vākyaṃ girirājaṃ tamaṅgirāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवं चोदितः सर्वैरृषिबिः कश्यपादिभिः /
प्रत्युवाच परं वाक्यं गिरिराजं तमङ्गिराः //
text_mt: Thus urged by all the sages headed by Kaśyapa, / Aṅgiras replied with excellent words to that king of mountains:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirā uvāca /
śrūyatāṃ parvataśreṣṭha yena kāryeṇa vai vayam /
samāgatāstvatsadanamarundhatyā samaṃ gire //
meaning:
अङ्गिरा उवाच /
श्रूयतां पर्वतश्रेष्ठ येन कार्येण वै वयम् /
समागतास्त्वत्सदनमरुन्धत्या समं गिरे //
text_mt: Aṅgiras said: / 'Listen, O best of mountains, to the purpose for which / we have come to your abode together with Arundhatī, O mountain!

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'sau mahātmā sarvātmā dakṣayajñakṣayaṅkaraḥ /
śaṅkaraḥ śūladhṛk śarvastrinetro vṛṣavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽसौ महात्मा सर्वात्मा दक्षयज्ञक्षयङ्करः /
शङ्करः शूलधृक् शर्वस्त्रिनेत्रो वृषवाहनः //
text_mt: He who is the great soul, the self of all, the destroyer of Dakṣa’s sacrifice, / Śaṅkara, the wielder of the trident, Śarva, the three-eyed one, whose mount is the bull,

sanskrit_iast:
jīmūtaketuḥ śatrughno yajñabhoktā svayaṃ prabhuḥ /
yamīśvaraṃ vadantyeke śivaṃ sthāṇau bhavaṃ haram //
meaning:
जीमूतकेतुः शत्रुघ्नो यज्ञभोक्ता स्वयं प्रभुः /
यमीश्वरं वदन्त्येके शिवं स्थाणौ भवं हरम् //
text_mt: Jīmūtaketu, the slayer of foes, the enjoyer of sacrifice, the Lord himself, / whom some call Īśvara, Śiva, Sthāṇu, Bhava, Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmamugraṃ maheśānaṃ mahādevaṃ paśoḥ patim /
vayaṃ tena preṣitāḥ smastvatsakāśaṃ girīśvara //
meaning:
भीममुग्रं महेशानं महादेवं पशोः पतिम् /
वयं तेन प्रेषिताः स्मस्त्वत्सकाशं गिरीश्वर //
text_mt: Bhīma, Ugra, Maheśāna, Mahādeva, the lord of beasts— / we have been sent to your presence by him, O lord of mountains!

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ yā tvatsutā kālī sarvalokeṣu sundarī /
tāṃ prārthayati deveśastāṃ bhavān dātumarhati //
meaning:
इयं या त्वत्सुता काली सर्वलोकेषु सुन्दरी /
तां प्रार्थयति देवेशस्तां भवान् दातुमर्हति //
text_mt: This daughter of yours, Kālī, the most beautiful in all the worlds— / her the lord of gods requests; you ought to bestow her.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva dhanyo hi pitā yasya putrī śubhaṃ patim /
rūpābhijanasaṃpattyā prāpnoti girisattama //
meaning:
स एव धन्यो हि पिता यस्य पुत्री शुभं पतिम् /
रूपाभिजनसंपत्त्या प्राप्नोति गिरिसत्तम //
text_mt: He alone is a blessed father whose daughter obtains an auspicious husband / with an abundance of beauty and noble lineage, O best of mountains!

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanto jaṅgamāgamyā bhūtāḥ śaila caturvidhāḥ /
teṣāṃ mātā tviyaṃ devī yataḥ proktaḥ pitā haraḥ //
meaning:
यावन्तो जङ्गमागम्या भूताः शैल चतुर्विधाः /
तेषां माता त्वियं देवी यतः प्रोक्तः पिता हरः //
text_mt: As many fourfold beings as move and do not move, O mountain, / of them this goddess is the mother, since Hara is declared to be the father.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śaṅkaraṃ devāḥ praṇamantu sutāṃ tava /
kuruṣva pādaṃ śatrūṇāṃ mūrdhni bhasmapariplutam //
meaning:
प्रणम्य शङ्करं देवाः प्रणमन्तु सुतां तव /
कुरुष्व पादं शत्रूणां मूर्ध्नि भस्मपरिप्लुतम् //
text_mt: Bowing to Śaṅkara, let the gods bow to your daughter; / place your foot covered in sacred ash upon the head of your enemies!

sanskrit_iast:
yācitāro vayaṃ śarvo varo dātā tvamapyumā /
vadhūḥ sarvajaganmātā kuru yacchreyase tava //
meaning:
याचितारो वयं शर्वो वरो दाता त्वमप्युमा /
वधूः सर्वजगन्माता कुरु यच्छ्रेयसे तव //
text_mt: We are the suitors, Śarva is the groom, you are the giver, and Umā / is the bride, the mother of the entire universe; do what leads to your highest good!'

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
tadvaco 'ṅgirasaḥ śrutvā kālī tasthāvadhomukhī /
harṣamāgatya sahasā punardainyamupāgatā //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
तद्वचो ऽङ्गिरसः श्रुत्वा काली तस्थावधोमुखी /
हर्षमागत्य सहसा पुनर्दैन्यमुपागता //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Hearing those words of Aṅgiras, Kālī stood with her face cast down; / experiencing sudden joy, she then felt modesty.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śailapatiḥ prāha parvataṃ gandhamādanam /
gaccha śailānupāmantrya sarvānāgānturmahasi //
meaning:
ततः शैलपतिः प्राह पर्वतं गन्धमादनम् /
गच्छ शैलानुपामन्त्र्य सर्वानागान्तुर्महसि //
text_mt: Then the lord of mountains said to the mountain Gandhamādana: / 'Go, invite all the mountains; you must bring them to the festival.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śīghrataraḥ śailo gṛhād gṛhamagāñjavī /
mervādīn parvataśreṣṭhānājuhāva samantataḥ //
meaning:
ततः शीघ्रतरः शैलो गृहाद् गृहमगाञ्जवी /
मेर्वादीन् पर्वतश्रेष्ठानाजुहाव समन्ततः //
text_mt: Then, swift in pace, the mountain [Gandhamādana] went quickly from house to house / and summoned from all directions the best of mountains, headed by Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
te 'pyājagmustvarāvantaḥ kāryaṃ matvā mahattadā /
viviśurvismayāviṣṭāḥ sauvarṇeṣvāsaneṣu te //
meaning:
ते ऽप्याजग्मुस्त्वरावन्तः कार्यं मत्वा महत्तदा /
विविशुर्विस्मयाविष्टाः सौवर्णेष्वासनेषु ते //
text_mt: They too arrived with haste, considering the matter of great importance then; / filled with wonder, they sat upon golden seats:

sanskrit_iast:
udayo hemakūṭaśca ramyako mandarastathā /
uddālako vāruṇaśca varāho garuḍāsanaḥ //
meaning:
उदयो हेमकूटश्च रम्यको मन्दरस्तथा /
उद्दालको वारुणश्च वराहो गरुडासनः //
text_mt: Udaya, Hemakūṭa, Ramyaka, and Mandara, / Uddālaka, Vāruṇa, Varāha, and Garuḍāsana,

sanskrit_iast:
śuktimān vegasānuśca dṛḍhaśṛṅgo 'tha śṛṅvān /
citrakūṭastrikūṭaś ca tathā mandarakācalaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्तिमान् वेगसानुश्च दृढशृङ्गो ऽथ शृङ्वान् /
चित्रकूटस्त्रिकूटश् च तथा मन्दरकाचलः //
text_mt: Śuktimān, Vegasānu, Dṛḍhaśṛṅga, and Śṛṅgavān, / Citrakūṭa, Trikūṭa, and the Mandaraka mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
vindhyaśca malayaścaiva pāriyātro 'tha durdaraḥ /
kailāsādrirmahendraśca niṣadho 'ñjanaparvataḥ //
meaning:
विन्ध्यश्च मलयश्चैव पारियात्रो ऽथ दुर्दरः /
कैलासाद्रिर्महेन्द्रश्च निषधो ऽञ्जनपर्वतः //
text_mt: Vindhya, Malaya, Pāriyātra, and Durdara, / Mount Kailāsa, Mahendra, Niṣadha, and Mount Añjana.

sanskrit_iast:
ete pradhānā girayastathānye kṣudraparvatāḥ /
uviṣṭāḥ sabhāyāṃ vai praṇipatya ṛṣiṃśca tān //
meaning:
एते प्रधाना गिरयस्तथान्ये क्षुद्रपर्वताः /
उविष्टाः सभायां वै प्रणिपत्य ऋषिंश्च तान् //
text_mt: These principal mountains and other minor hills, / having bowed down to those sages, sat down in the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
tato girīśaḥ svāṃ bhāryā menāmāhūtavāṃśca saḥ /
samāgacchata kalyāṇī samaṃ putreṇa bhāminī //
meaning:
ततो गिरीशः स्वां भार्या मेनामाहूतवांश्च सः /
समागच्छत कल्याणी समं पुत्रेण भामिनी //
text_mt: Then the lord of mountains summoned his own wife Menā; / that auspicious and splendid woman arrived together with her son.

sanskrit_iast:
sābhivandya ṛṣīṇāṃ hi cāraṇāṃśca tapasvinī /
sarvān jñātīn samābhāṣya viveśa sasutā tataḥ //
meaning:
साभिवन्द्य ऋषीणां हि चारणांश्च तपस्विनी /
सर्वान् ज्ञातीन् समाभाष्य विवेश ससुता ततः //
text_mt: Having paid homage to the sages' feet, that ascetic lady, / greeting all her kinsmen, then sat down together with her son.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'driṣu mahāśaila upaviṣṭeṣu nārada /
uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñaḥ sarvānābhāṣya susvaram //
meaning:
ततो ऽद्रिषु महाशैल उपविष्टेषु नारद /
उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सर्वानाभाष्य सुस्वरम् //
text_mt: When the mountains had sat down, O Nārada, the great mountain [Himavat], / skilled in speech, addressed them all in an agreeable voice:

sanskrit_iast:
himavānuvāca /
ime saptarṣayaḥ puṇyā yācitāraḥ sutāṃ mama /
maheśvarārthaṃ kanyāṃ tu taccāvedyaṃ bhavatsu vai //
meaning:
हिमवानुवाच /
इमे सप्तर्षयः पुण्या याचितारः सुतां मम /
महेश्वरार्थं कन्यां तु तच्चावेद्यं भवत्सु वै //
text_mt: Himavat said: / 'These holy Seven Sages have asked for my daughter, / the maiden, for the sake of Maheśvara; that is indeed to be made known to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tad vadadhvaṃ yathāprajñaṃ jñātayo yūyameva me /
nollaṅghya yuṣmān dāsyāmi tatkṣamaṃ vaktumarhatha //
meaning:
