नमो ऽस्तु शर्व शंबो त्रिनेत्र चारुगात्र त्रैलोक्यनाथ उमापते दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसकर कामाह्गनासन घोर पापप्रणाशन महापुरुष महोग्रमूर्ते सर्वसत्त्वक्षयङ्कर शुभङ्कर महेश्वर त्रिशूलधारिन् स्मरारे गुहावासिन् दिग्वासः महाशङ्कशेखर (5) जटाधर कपालमालाविभूषिकशरीर वामचक्षुः बामदेव प्रजाध्यक्ष भगाक्ष्णोः क्षयङ्कर भीमसेन महासेननाथ पशुपते कामाङ्गदहन चत्वरवासिन् शिव महादेव ईशान संकर भीम भव वषभध्वज जटिल प्रौढ महानाट्येश्वर भूरिरत्न (10) अविमुक्तक रुद्रश्वर स्थाणो एकलिङ्ग कालिन्दीप्रिय श्रीकण्ठ नीलकण्ठ अपराजित रिपुभयङ्कर संतोषपते वामदेव अघोर तत्पुरुष महाघोर अघोरमूर्त्त शान्त सरस्वतीकान्त कीनाट सहस्रमूर्त्ते महोद्भव (15) विबो कालाग्निरुद्र हर महीधरप्रिय सर्वतीर्थाधिवास हंस कामेश्वर केदाराधिपते परिपूर्ण मुचुकुन्द मधुनिवासिन् कृपाणपाणे भयङ्कर विद्याराज सोमराज कामराज उञ्जक अञ्जनराजकन्याहृदचलवसते समुद्रशायिन् (20) गजमुख घण्टेश्वर गोकर्ण ब्रह्मयोने सहस्रवक्त्राक्षिचरण हाटकेश्वर नमो ऽस्तु ते /
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्ताः सर्व एवर्षिपार्थिवाः /
द्रष्टुं त्रैलोक्यकर्तारं त्र्यम्बकं हाटकेश्वरम् //
text_mt: "Homage to you, O Śarva, Śambhu, three-eyed one, of handsome limbs, lord of the three worlds, husband of Umā, destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice, destroyer of the body of Kāma, terrible one, destroyer of sins, supreme person, of immensely fierce form, destroyer of all beings, auspicious one, Maheśvara, wielder of the trident, enemy of Smara, cave-dweller, sky-clad one, crowned with the great conch, / wearer of matted hair, whose body is adorned with a garland of skulls, left-eyed one, Vāmadeva, overseer of creatures, destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, Bhīmasena, lord of Mahāsena, Paśupati, burner of the limbs of Kāma, dweller in crossroads, Śiva, Mahādeva, Īśāna, Śaṅkara, Bhīma, Bhava, bull-bannered one, matted-haired one, mature one, lord of the great dance, possessor of abundant gems, / Avimuktaka, Rudreśvara, Sthāṇu, Ekaliṅga, lover of the Kālindī, Śrīkaṇṭha, Nīlakaṇṭha, unconquered one, terrifier of enemies, lord of contentment, Vāmadeva, Aghora, Tatpuruṣa, exceedingly terrible one, of non-terrific form, peaceful one, beloved of Sarasvatī, Kīnāṭa, having a thousand forms, of great origin, / omnipresent one, Kālāgnirudra, Hara, lover of the mountain, residing in all tīrthas, Haṃsa, lord of love, lord of Kedāra, complete one, Mucukunda, dweller in Madhu, sword in hand, frightful one, king of knowledge, king of the moon, king of desire, Uñjaka, whose abode is in the heart of the daughter of the king of Añjana, sleeper upon the ocean, / elephant-faced one, Ghaṇṭeśvara, Gokarṇa, source of Brahmā, having a thousand faces, eyes, and feet, Hāṭakeśvara, homage be to you!" / In the meantime, all those sages and kings arrived / to see Hāṭakeśvara, the three-eyed creator of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
samārūḍhāśca susnātā dadṛśuryoṣitaśca tāḥ /
sthitāstu puratastasya gāyantyo geyamuttamam //
meaning:
समारूढाश्च सुस्नाता ददृशुर्योषितश्च ताः /
स्थितास्तु पुरतस्तस्य गायन्त्यो गेयमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having bathed well and ascended, they saw those women / standing before him, singing an excellent song.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sudevatanayo viśvakarmasutāṃ priyām /
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣitacittastu saṃrohatpulako babhau //
meaning:
ततः सुदेवतनयो विश्वकर्मसुतां प्रियाम् /
दृष्ट्वा हृषितचित्तस्तु संरोहत्पुलको बभौ //
text_mt: Then the son of Sudeva, having seen his beloved, the daughter of Viśvakarman, / with an exhilarated heart, shone with horripilation rising.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtadhvajo 'pi tanvaṅgīṃ dṛṣṭvā citrāṅgadāṃ sthitām /
pratyabhijñāya yogātmā babhau muditamānasaḥ //
meaning:
ऋतध्वजो ऽपि तन्वङ्गीं दृष्ट्वा चित्राङ्गदां स्थिताम् /
प्रत्यभिज्ञाय योगात्मा बभौ मुदितमानसः //
text_mt: Ṛtadhvaja too, the yogic soul, having seen the slender-limbed Citrāṅgadā standing / and recognized her, shone with a joyful mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu sahasābhyetya deveśaṃ hāṭakeśvaram /
saṃpūjayantastryakṣaṃ te stuvantaḥ saṃsthitāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
ततस्तु सहसाभ्येत्य देवेशं हाटकेश्वरम् /
संपूजयन्तस्त्र्यक्षं ते स्तुवन्तः संस्थिताः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, coming hastily toward Hāṭakeśvara, the lord of gods, / worshipping and praising the three-eyed one, they stood in order.

sanskrit_iast:
citrāṅgadāpi tān dṛṣṭvā ṛtadhvajapurogamān /
samaṃ tābhiḥ kṛsāṅgībhirabhyutthāyābhyavādayat //
meaning:
चित्राङ्गदापि तान् दृष्ट्वा ऋतध्वजपुरोगमान् /
समं ताभिः कृसाङ्गीभिरभ्युत्थायाभ्यवादयत् //
text_mt: Citrāṅgadā also, having seen them led by Ṛtadhvaja, / stood up together with those slender-limbed women and greeted them.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca tāḥ pratinandyaiva samaṃ putreṇa tāpasaḥ /
samaṃ nṛpatibhirhṛṣṭaḥ saṃviveśa yathāsukham //
meaning:
स च ताः प्रतिनन्द्यैव समं पुत्रेण तापसः /
समं नृपतिभिर्हृष्टः संविवेश यथासुखम् //
text_mt:
And the ascetic, having welcomed them together with his son,
sat down at ease, delighted, along with the kings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kapivaraḥ prāpto ghṛtācyā saha sundari /
snātvā godāvarītīrthe didṛkṣurhāṭakeśvaram //
meaning:
ततः कपिवरः प्राप्तो घृताच्या सह सुन्दरि /
स्नात्वा गोदावरीतीर्थे दिदृक्षुर्हाटकेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Then the excellent monkey arrived together with Ghṛtācī, O fair lady,
having bathed at the Godāvarī tīrtha, wishing to behold Hāṭakeśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'paśyat sutāṃ tanvīṃ ghṛtācī śubhadarśanām /
sāpi tāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭābhūdvaravarṇinī //
meaning:
ततो ऽपश्यत् सुतां तन्वीं घृताची शुभदर्शनाम् /
सापि तां मातरं दृष्ट्वा हृष्टाभूद्वरवर्णिनी //
text_mt:
Then Ghṛtācī beheld her slender daughter of auspicious appearance,
and she too, the fair-complexioned one, was delighted on seeing her mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tato ghṛtācī svāṃ putrīṃ pariṣvajya nyapīḍayat /
snehāt savāṣpanayanāṃ muhustāṃ parijighravīt //
meaning:
ततो घृताची स्वां पुत्रीं परिष्वज्य न्यपीडयत् /
स्नेहात् सवाष्पनयनां मुहुस्तां परिजिघ्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Then Ghṛtācī embraced her daughter and held her close;
out of affection, with tearful eyes, she kissed her head again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
tato ṛtadhvajaḥ śrīmān kapiṃ vacanamabravīt /
gacchanetuṃ guhyakaṃ tvamañjanādrau mahāñjanam //
meaning:
ततो ऋतध्वजः श्रीमान् कपिं वचनमब्रवीत् /
गच्छनेतुं गुह्यकं त्वमञ्जनाद्रौ महाञ्जनम् //
text_mt:
Then the glorious Ṛtadhvaja said these words to the monkey:
'Go to bring the Guhyaka Mahāñjana on Mount Añjana,

sanskrit_iast:
pātālādapi daityeśaṃ vīraṃ kandaramālinam /
svargād gandharvarājānaṃ parjanyaṃ śīghramānaya //
meaning:
पातालादपि दैत्येशं वीरं कन्दरमालिनम् /
स्वर्गाद् गन्धर्वराजानं पर्जन्यं शीघ्रमानय //
text_mt:
and also the heroic lord of the Daityas, Kandaramālin, from Pātāla;
quickly bring Parjanya, the king of the Gandharvas, from heaven.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukte muninā prāha devavatī kapim /
gālavaṃ vānaraśreṣṭha ihānetuṃ tvamarhasi //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ते मुनिना प्राह देववती कपिम् /
गालवं वानरश्रेष्ठ इहानेतुं त्वमर्हसि //
text_mt:
When the sage had spoken thus, Devavatī said to the monkey:
'O best of monkeys, you ought to bring Gālava here.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukte vacane kapirmarutavikramaḥ /
gatvāñjanaṃ samāmantrya jagāmāmaraparvatam //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने कपिर्मरुतविक्रमः /
गत्वाञ्जनं समामन्त्र्य जगामामरपर्वतम् //
text_mt:
When these words were spoken, the monkey, whose prowess was like the wind's,
went, invited Añjana, and proceeded to the mountain of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
parjanyaṃ tatra cāmantrya preṣayitvā mahāśrame /
saptagodāvare tīrthe pātālamagamat kapiḥ //
meaning:
पर्जन्यं तत्र चामन्त्र्य प्रेषयित्वा महाश्रमे /
सप्तगोदावरे तीर्थे पातालमगमत् कपिः //
text_mt:
Having invited Parjanya there and sent him to the great hermitage
at the Saptagodāvara tīrtha, the monkey went to Pātāla.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāmantrya mahāvīryaṃ kapiḥ kandaramālinam /
pātālādabhiniṣkramya mahīṃ paryacarajjavī //
meaning:
तत्रामन्त्र्य महावीर्यं कपिः कन्दरमालिनम् /
पातालादभिनिष्क्रम्य महीं पर्यचरज्जवी //
text_mt:
Having invited the mighty Kandaramālin there,
the swift monkey came out of Pātāla and roamed over the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
gālaṃ tapaso yoniṃ dṛṣṭvā māhiṣmatīmanu /
samutpatyānayacchīghraṃ saptagodāvaraṃ jalam //
meaning:
गालं तपसो योनिं दृष्ट्वा माहिष्मतीमनु /
समुत्पत्यानयच्छीघ्रं सप्तगोदावरं जलम् //
text_mt:
Having seen Gālava, the source of ascetic power, near Māhiṣmatī,
he flew up and quickly brought him to the waters of Saptagodāvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā vidhānena saṃprāpto hāṭakeśvaram /
dadṛśe nandayantī ca sthitāṃ devavatīmapi //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन संप्राप्तो हाटकेश्वरम् /
ददृशे नन्दयन्ती च स्थितां देववतीमपि //
text_mt:
Having bathed there according to rule, he reached Hāṭakeśvara;
and he saw Nandayantī, as well as Devavatī standing there.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gālavaṃ caiva samutthāyābhyavādayat /
sa cārciṣyanmahādevaṃ maharṣīnabhyavādayat /
te cāpi nṛpatiśreṣṭhastaṃ saṃpūjya tapodhanam //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा गालवं चैव समुत्थायाभ्यवादयत् /
स चार्चिष्यन्महादेवं महर्षीनभ्यवादयत् /
ते चापि नृपतिश्रेष्ठस्तं संपूज्य तपोधनम् //

sanskrit_iast:
praharṣamatulaṃ gatvā upaviṣṭā yathāsukham /
teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu tadā vānaropanimantritāḥ //
meaning:
प्रहर्षमतुलं गत्वा उपविष्टा यथासुखम् /
तेषूपविष्टेषु तदा वानरोपनिमन्त्रिताः //
text_mt:
Having attained matchless joy, they sat down at ease.
When they were seated, the high-souled Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
samāyātā mahātmāno yakṣagandharvadānavāḥ /
tānāgatān samīkṣyaiva putryastāḥ pṛthulocanāḥ //
meaning:
समायाता महात्मानो यक्षगन्धर्वदानवाः /
तानागतान् समीक्ष्यैव पुत्र्यस्ताः पृथुलोचनाः //
text_mt:
invited by the monkey, arrived.
Beholding them arrived, those large-eyed daughters,

sanskrit_iast:
snehārdranayanāḥ sarvāstadā sasvajire pitṝn /
nandayantyādikā dṛṣṭvā sapitṛkā varānanā //
meaning:
स्नेहार्द्रनयनाः सर्वास्तदा सस्वजिरे पितॄन् /
नन्दयन्त्यादिका दृष्ट्वा सपितृका वरानना //
text_mt:
all with eyes moist with affection, then embraced their fathers.
Seeing Nandayantī and the others united with their fathers, the fair-faced

sanskrit_iast:
savāṣpanayanā jātā viśvakarmasutā tadā /
atha tāmāha sa muniḥ satyaṃ satyadhvajo vacaḥ //
meaning:
सवाष्पनयना जाता विश्वकर्मसुता तदा /
अथ तामाह स मुनिः सत्यं सत्यध्वजो वचः //
text_mt:
daughter of Viśvakarman then became tearful-eyed.
Then the sage Satyadhvaja spoke these true words to her:

sanskrit_iast:
mā viṣādaṃ kṛtāḥ putri pitāyaṃ tava vānaraḥ /
sā tadvacanamākarṇya vrīḍopahatacetanā //
meaning:
मा विषादं कृताः पुत्रि पितायं तव वानरः /
सा तद्वचनमाकर्ण्य व्रीडोपहतचेतना //
text_mt:
'Do not grieve, daughter; this monkey is your father.'
Hearing his words, her mind was struck with shame:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ tu viśvakarmāsau vānaratvaṃ gato 'dhunā /
duṣputryāṃ mayijātāyaṃ tasmāt tyakṣe kalevaram //
meaning:
कथं तु विश्वकर्मासौ वानरत्वं गतो ऽधुना /
दुष्पुत्र्यां मयिजातायं तस्मात् त्यक्षे कलेवरम् //
text_mt:
'How has this Viśvakarman now fallen into the state of a monkey
because I was born a wicked daughter? Therefore I shall abandon my body!'

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃcintya manasā ṛtadhvajamuvāca ha /
paritrāyasva māṃ brahman pāpopahatacetanām //
meaning:
इति संचिन्त्य मनसा ऋतध्वजमुवाच ह /
परित्रायस्व मां ब्रह्मन् पापोपहतचेतनाम् //
text_mt:
Reflecting thus in her mind, she spoke to Ṛtadhvaja:
'Protect me, O Brahmin, whose mind is afflicted by sin!

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛghnī martumicchāmi tadanujñātumarhasi /
athovāca munistanvīṃ mā viṣādaṃ kṛthādhunā //
meaning:
पितृघ्नी मर्तुमिच्छामि तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि /
अथोवाच मुनिस्तन्वीं मा विषादं कृथाधुना //
text_mt:
I, a slayer of my father, wish to die; you ought to permit it.'
Then the sage said to the slender lady: 'Do not grieve now!

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvyasya naiva nāśo 'sti nanmā tyākṣīḥ kalevaram /
bhaviṣyati pitā tubhyaṃ bhuyayo 'pyamaravarddhakiḥ //
meaning:
भाव्यस्य नैव नाशो ऽस्ति नन्मा त्याक्षीः कलेवरम् /
भविष्यति पिता तुभ्यं भुययो ऽप्यमरवर्द्धकिः //
text_mt:
What is destined to be cannot be destroyed; so do not cast off your body.
Your father will once again become the architect of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
jāte 'patye ghṛtācyāṃ tu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
ityevamukte vacane muninā bhāvitātmanā //
meaning:
जाते ऽपत्ये घृताच्यां तु नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने मुनिना भावितात्मना //
text_mt:
When a child is born to Ghṛtācī, no doubt should be entertained here.'
When these words were spoken by the sage whose soul was refined,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtācī tāṃ sambhyetya prāha citrāṅgadāṃ vacaḥ /
putri tyajasva śokaṃ tvaṃ māsaurdaśabhirātmajaḥ //
meaning:
घृताची तां सम्भ्येत्य प्राह चित्राङ्गदां वचः /
पुत्रि त्यजस्व शोकं त्वं मासौर्दशभिरात्मजः //
text_mt:
Ghṛtācī approached Citrāṅgadā and said these words to her:
'Daughter, cast away your grief; in ten months a son

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyati putustubhyaṃ matsakāśānna saṃśayaḥ /
ityevamuktā saṃhṛṣṭā babhau citrāṅgadā tadā //
meaning:
भविष्यति पुतुस्तुभ्यं मत्सकाशान्न संशयः /
इत्येवमुक्ता संहृष्टा बभौ चित्राङ्गदा तदा //
text_mt:
will be born to your father from me, without a doubt.'
Addressed thus, Citrāṅgadā then shone forth, delighted,

sanskrit_iast:
pratīkṣantī sucārvaṅgī vivāhe pitṛdarśanam /
sarvāstā api tāvantaṃ kālaṃ sutanukanyakāḥ //
meaning:
प्रतीक्षन्ती सुचार्वङ्गी विवाहे पितृदर्शनम् /
सर्वास्ता अपि तावन्तं कालं सुतनुकन्यकाः //
text_mt:
the exceedingly fair-limbed lady waiting to see her father at her wedding.
All those lovely-bodied maidens also, for that length of time,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyaikṣanta vivāhaṃ hi tasyā eva priyepsayā /
tato daśasu māseṣu samatīteṣvathāpsarāḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्यैक्षन्त विवाहं हि तस्या एव प्रियेप्सया /
ततो दशसु मासेषु समतीतेष्वथाप्सराः //
text_mt:
awaited the marriage out of a desire to please her alone.
Then, when ten months had elapsed, the apsaras

sanskrit_iast:
tasmn godāvarītīrthe prasūtā tanayaṃ nalam /
jāte 'patye kapitvācca viśvakarmāpyamucyata //
meaning:
तस्म्न् गोदावरीतीर्थे प्रसूता तनयं नलम् /
जाते ऽपत्ये कपित्वाच्च विश्वकर्माप्यमुच्यत //
text_mt:
gave birth to a son, Nala, at that Godāvarī tīrtha.
When the child was born, Viśvakarman was freed from monkeyhood.

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyetya priyāṃ putrīṃ paryaṣvajata cādarāt /
tataḥ prītena manasā sasmāra suravarddhakiḥ //
meaning:
समभ्येत्य प्रियां पुत्रीं पर्यष्वजत चादरात् /
ततः प्रीतेन मनसा सस्मार सुरवर्द्धकिः //
text_mt:
Approaching his dear daughter, he embraced her with affection.
Then, with a pleased mind, the architect of the gods remembered

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāmadhipaṃ śakraṃ sahaiva surakinnaraiḥ /
tvaṣṭrātha saṃsmṛtaḥ śakro marudgaṇavṛtastadā //
meaning:
सुराणामधिपं शक्रं सहैव सुरकिन्नरैः /
त्वष्ट्राथ संस्मृतः शक्रो मरुद्गणवृतस्तदा //
text_mt:
Śakra, the lord of the gods, together with the gods and Kinnaras.
Remembered by Tvaṣṭṛ, Śakra, surrounded by the host of the Maruts,

sanskrit_iast:
suraiḥ sarudraiḥ saṃprāptastattīrtha hāṭakāhvayam /
samāyāteṣu deveṣu gandharveṣvapsarassu ca //
meaning:
सुरैः सरुद्रैः संप्राप्तस्तत्तीर्थ हाटकाह्वयम् /
समायातेषु देवेषु गन्धर्वेष्वप्सरस्सु च //
text_mt:
arrived at that tīrtha named Hāṭaka, along with the gods and Rudras.
When the gods, Gandharvas, and apsarases had gathered,

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumno muniśreṣṭhamṛtadhvajamuvāca ha /
jābālerdīyatāṃ brahman sutākandaramālinaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्नो मुनिश्रेष्ठमृतध्वजमुवाच ह /
जाबालेर्दीयतां ब्रह्मन् सुताकन्दरमालिनः //
text_mt:
Indradyumna spoke to the best of sages, Ṛtadhvaja:
'O Brahmin, let the daughter of Kandaramālin be given to Jābāli;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhṇātu vidhivat pāṇiṃ daiteyyāstanayastava /
nandayantīṃ ca śakuniḥ pariṇetuṃ svarūpavān //
meaning:
गृह्णातु विधिवत् पाणिं दैतेय्यास्तनयस्तव /
नन्दयन्तीं च शकुनिः परिणेतुं स्वरूपवान् //
text_mt:
let your son take the hand of the Daitya woman according to rule;
and let the handsome Śakuni marry Nandayantī;

sanskrit_iast:
mameyaṃ vedavatyastu tvāṣṭroyī surathasya ca /
bāḍhamityabravīddhṛṣṭo munirmanusutaṃ nṛpam //
meaning:
ममेयं वेदवत्यस्तु त्वाष्ट्रोयी सुरथस्य च /
बाढमित्यब्रवीद्धृष्टो मुनिर्मनुसुतं नृपम् //
text_mt:
let this Vedavatī be mine, and the daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ be Suratha's.'
'So be it,' said the delighted sage to the king, the son of Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'nucakruḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vivāhavidhimuttamam /
ṛtvijo 'bhūd gālavastu hutvā havyaṃ vidhanataḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽनुचक्रुः संहृष्टा विवाहविधिमुत्तमम् /
ऋत्विजो ऽभूद् गालवस्तु हुत्वा हव्यं विधनतः //
text_mt:
Then, delighted, they performed the excellent rites of marriage.
Gālava became the officiating priest, offering the oblation according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyante tatra gandharvā nṛtyante 'psarasastathā /
ādau jābālinaḥ pāṇirgṛhīto daityakanyayā //
meaning:
गायन्ते तत्र गन्धर्वा नृत्यन्ते ऽप्सरसस्तथा /
आदौ जाबालिनः पाणिर्गृहीतो दैत्यकन्यया //
text_mt:
There the Gandharvas sang and the apsarases danced.
First, the hand of the Daitya maiden was taken by Jābāli;

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumnena tadanu vedavatyā vidhānataḥ /
tataḥ śakuninā pāṇirgṛhīto yakṣakanyayā //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्नेन तदनु वेदवत्या विधानतः /
ततः शकुनिना पाणिर्गृहीतो यक्षकन्यया //
text_mt:
after that, the hand of Vedavatī was taken by Indradyumna according to rule;
then the hand of the Yakṣa maiden was taken by Śakuni;

sanskrit_iast:
citrāṅgadāyāḥ kalyāṇi surathaḥ pāṇimagrahīt /
evaṃ kramād vivāhastu nirvṛttastanumadhyame //
meaning:
चित्राङ्गदायाः कल्याणि सुरथः पाणिमग्रहीत् /
एवं क्रमाद् विवाहस्तु निर्वृत्तस्तनुमध्यमे //
text_mt:
Suratha took the hand of Citrāṅgadā, O auspicious one.
Thus in order the marriage was completed, O slender-waisted lady.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛtte munirvivāhe tu śakrādīn prāha daivatān /
asmistīrthe bhavadbhistu saptagodāvare sadā //
meaning:
वृत्ते मुनिर्विवाहे तु शक्रादीन् प्राह दैवतान् /
अस्मिस्तीर्थे भवद्भिस्तु सप्तगोदावरे सदा //
text_mt:
When the wedding was completed, the sage said to the deities headed by Śakra:
'You should always stay at this Saptagodāvara tīrtha,

sanskrit_iast:
stheyaṃ viśeṣato māsamimaṃ mādhavamuttamam /
bāḍhamuktvā surāḥ sarve jagmurhṛṣṭā divaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
स्थेयं विशेषतो मासमिमं माधवमुत्तमम् /
बाढमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुर्हृष्टा दिवं क्रमात् //
text_mt:
especially during this excellent month of Mādhava.'
Saying 'So be it,' all the gods, delighted, went to heaven in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
munayo munimādāya saputraṃ jagmurādarāt /
bhāryāścādāya rājānaḥ svaṃ svaṃ nagaramāgatāḥ //
meaning:
मुनयो मुनिमादाय सपुत्रं जग्मुरादरात् /
भार्याश्चादाय राजानः स्वं स्वं नगरमागताः //
text_mt:
The sages, taking the sage along with his son, went with respect;
and taking their wives, the kings returned each to his own city.

sanskrit_iast:
prahṛṣṭāḥ sukhinastasthuḥ bhuñjate viṣayān priyān /
citrāṅgadāyāḥ kalyāṇi evaṃ vṛttaṃ purā kila /
tanmāṃ kamalapatrākṣi bhajasva lalanottame //
meaning:
प्रहृष्टाः सुखिनस्तस्थुः भुञ्जते विषयान् प्रियान् /
चित्राङ्गदायाः कल्याणि एवं वृत्तं पुरा किल /
तन्मां कमलपत्राक्षि भजस्व ललनोत्तमे //

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā naradevasūnustāṃ bhūmidevasya sutāṃ varorum /
stuvanmṛgākṣīṃ mṛdunā krameṇa sā cāpi vākyaṃ nṛpatiṃ babhāṣe //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा नरदेवसूनुस्तां भूमिदेवस्य सुतां वरोरुम् /
स्तुवन्मृगाक्षीं मृदुना क्रमेण सा चापि वाक्यं नृपतिं बभाषे //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे एकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to the fair-thighed daughter of the Brahmin, / praising that deer-eyed maiden with gentle words, the king's son paused; and she addressed the king in turn:

Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter in the holy Vāmana Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
arajā uvāca /
nātmānaṃ tava dāsyāmi buhanoktena kiṃ tava /
rakṣantī bhavataḥ śāpādātmānaṃ ca mahī pate //
meaning:
अरजा उवाच /
नात्मानं तव दास्यामि बुहनोक्तेन किं तव /
रक्षन्ती भवतः शापादात्मानं च मही पते //
text_mt: Arajā said: / 'I shall not surrender myself to you; what need is there of many words from you? / I am protecting myself, and you, O lord of the earth, from a curse.'

sanskrit_iast:
prahlāda uvāca/ /
itthaṃ vivadamānāṃ tāṃ bhārgavendrasutāṃ balāt /
kāmopahatacittātmā vyadhvaṃsayata mandadhīḥ //
meaning:
प्रह्लाद उवाच/ /
इत्थं विवदमानां तां भार्गवेन्द्रसुतां बलात् /
कामोपहतचित्तात्मा व्यध्वंसयत मन्दधीः //
text_mt: Prahlāda said: / 'Though that daughter of the chief of Bhārgavas was arguing in this way, / the dull-witted king, his heart and mind overwhelmed by lust, violated her by force.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ kṛtvā cyutacāpitrāṃ madāndhaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ /
niścakrāmāśramāt tasmād gataśca nagaraṃ nijam //
meaning:
तां कृत्वा च्युतचापित्रां मदान्धः पृथिवीपतिः /
निश्चक्रामाश्रमात् तस्माद् गतश्च नगरं निजम् //
text_mt: Having brought about her fall from purity, the ruler of the earth, blind with passion, / departed from that hermitage and went to his own city.

sanskrit_iast:
sāpi śukrasutā tanvī arajā rajasāplutā /
āśramādatha niragatya bahistasthāvadhosukhī //
meaning:
सापि शुक्रसुता तन्वी अरजा रजसाप्लुता /
आश्रमादथ निरगत्य बहिस्तस्थावधोसुखी //
text_mt: That slender daughter of Śukra, Arajā, covered in dust, / then stepped out of the hermitage and stood outside, her face turned downwards.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayantī svapitaraṃ rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ /
mahāgrahopatapteva rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā //
meaning:
चिन्तयन्ती स्वपितरं रुदती च मुहुर्मुहुः /
महाग्रहोपतप्तेव रोहिणी शशिनः प्रिया //
text_mt: Brooding upon her father and weeping again and again, / she seemed like Rohiṇī, the beloved of the moon, afflicted by a mighty planet.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bahutithe kāle samāpte yajñakarmaṇi /
pātālādāgamacchukraḥ khamāśramapadaṃ muniḥ //
meaning:
ततो बहुतिथे काले समाप्ते यज्ञकर्मणि /
पातालादागमच्छुक्रः खमाश्रमपदं मुनिः //
text_mt: Then after a long time, when the sacrificial rite was completed, / the sage Śukra returned through the sky to the hermitage grounds from Pātāla.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramānte ca dadṛśe sutāṃ daitya rajakhalām /
meghalekhāmivākāśe saṃdhyārāgeṇa rañjitām //
meaning:
आश्रमान्ते च ददृशे सुतां दैत्य रजखलाम् /
मेघलेखामिवाकाशे संध्यारागेण रञ्जिताम् //
text_mt: And at the edge of the hermitage, O Daitya, he saw his daughter in her menstrual course, / like a streak of cloud in the sky colored by the twilight glow.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paripapraccha putri kenāsi dharṣitā /
kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa samamāśīviṣeṇa hi //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा परिपप्रच्छ पुत्रि केनासि धर्षिता /
कः क्रीडति सरोषेण सममाशीविषेण हि //
text_mt: Seeing her, he asked: "Daughter, by whom have you been violated? / Who plays with an enraged venomous serpent?

sanskrit_iast:
ko 'dyaiva yāmyāṃ nagarīṃ gamiṣyati sudurmatiḥ /
yastvāṃ suddhasamācārāṃ vidhvaṃsayati pāpakṛt //
meaning:
को ऽद्यैव याम्यां नगरीं गमिष्यति सुदुर्मतिः /
यस्त्वां सुद्धसमाचारां विध्वंसयति पापकृत् //
text_mt: Who is that fool who will go to the city of Yama this very day, / that evil-doer who has ruined you of pure conduct?"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svapitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kampamānā punaḥ punāḥ /
rudantī vrīḍayopetā mandaṃ mandamuvāca ha //
meaning:
ततः स्वपितरं दृष्ट्वा कम्पमाना पुनः पुनाः /
रुदन्ती व्रीडयोपेता मन्दं मन्दमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Then, seeing her father, trembling again and again, / weeping and filled with shame, she spoke very slowly:

sanskrit_iast:
tava śiṣyeṇa daṇḍena vāryamāṇena cāsakṛt /
balādanāthā rudatī nītāhaṃ vacanīyatām //
meaning:
तव शिष्येण दण्डेन वार्यमाणेन चासकृत् /
बलादनाथा रुदती नीताहं वचनीयताम् //
text_mt: "Though repeatedly restrained by me, by your pupil Daṇḍa / I, helpless and weeping, have been forcibly brought to reproach."

sanskrit_iast:
etat putryā vacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ /
upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
एतत् पुत्र्या वचः श्रुत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः /
उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Hearing these words of his daughter, his eyes reddened with rage; / having sipped water and become purified, he uttered these words:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt tenāvinitena matto hyabhayamuttamam /
gauravaṃ ca tiraskṛtya cyutadharmārajā kṛtā //
meaning:
यस्मात् तेनाविनितेन मत्तो ह्यभयमुत्तमम् /
गौरवं च तिरस्कृत्य च्युतधर्मारजा कृता //
text_mt: "Since by that undisciplined one, disregarding the supreme protection / and respect due from me, Arajā was deprived of her virtue,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarāṣṭraḥ sabalaḥ sabhṛtyo vāhanaiḥ saha /
saptarātrāntarād bhasma grāvavṛṣṭyā bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तस्मात् सराष्ट्रः सबलः सभृत्यो वाहनैः सह /
सप्तरात्रान्तराद् भस्म ग्राववृष्ट्या भविष्यति //
text_mt: therefore together with his realm, his army, his servants and his mounts, / within seven nights he will become ashes through a shower of stones."

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā munipuṅgavo 'sau śaptvā sa daṇḍaṃ svasutāmuvāca /
tvaṃ pāpamokṣārthamihaiva putri tiṣṭhasva kalyāṇi tapaścarantī //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा मुनिपुङ्गवो ऽसौ शप्त्वा स दण्डं स्वसुतामुवाच /
त्वं पापमोक्षार्थमिहैव पुत्रि तिष्ठस्व कल्याणि तपश्चरन्ती //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, that foremost of sages cursed Daṇḍa and said to his daughter: / "For the sake of freeing yourself from sin, remain right here, O auspicious one, practicing austerities."

sanskrit_iast:
śpatvetthaṃ bhagavān śukro daṇḍamikṣvākunandanam /
jagāma śiṣyasahitaḥ pātālaṃ dānavālayam //
meaning:
श्पत्वेत्थं भगवान् शुक्रो दण्डमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम् /
जगाम शिष्यसहितः पातालं दानवालयम् //
text_mt: Having thus cursed Daṇḍa, the son of Ikṣvāku, the venerable Śukra / went along with his disciples to Pātāla, the abode of the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍo 'pi bhasmasād bhūtaḥ sarāṣṭrabalavāhanaḥ /
mahatā grāvavaraṣeṇa saptarātrāntare tadā //
meaning:
दण्डो ऽपि भस्मसाद् भूतः सराष्ट्रबलवाहनः /
महता ग्राववरषेण सप्तरात्रान्तरे तदा //
text_mt: And Daṇḍa too was reduced to ashes along with his kingdom, army, and mounts / by a great rain of stones within seven nights at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tadṛṇḍakāraṇyaṃ parityajyanati devatā /
ālayaṃ rākṣasānāṃ tu kṛtaṃ devena śaṃbhunā //
meaning:
एवं तदृण्डकारण्यं परित्यज्यनति देवता /
आलयं राक्षसानां तु कृतं देवेन शंभुना //
text_mt: Thus that Daṇḍaka forest was abandoned by the deities, / but made an abode of the Rākṣasas by the god Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ parakalatrāṇi nayanti sukṛtīnapi /
bhasmabhūtān prākṛtāṃstu mahāntaṃ ca parābhavam //
meaning:
एवं परकलत्राणि नयन्ति सुकृतीनपि /
भस्मभूतान् प्राकृतांस्तु महान्तं च पराभवम् //
text_mt: In this manner the wives of others bring even the virtuous to ruin, / turning ordinary people to ashes and bringing them to utter defeat.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādandhaka durbuddhirna kāryā bhavatā tviyam /
prākṛtāpi dahennārī kimutāhodrinandinī //
meaning:
तस्मादन्धक दुर्बुद्धिर्न कार्या भवता त्वियम् /
प्राकृतापि दहेन्नारी किमुताहोद्रिनन्दिनी //
text_mt: Therefore, O Andhaka, you should not hold such an evil intent; / even an ordinary woman could burn [you], how much more the Daughter of the Mountain?

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkaro 'pi na daityeśa śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ /
draṣṭumapyamitaujaskaḥ kimu yodhayituṃ raṇe //
meaning:
शङ्करो ऽपि न दैत्येश शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः /
द्रष्टुमप्यमितौजस्कः किमु योधयितुं रणे //
text_mt: Śaṅkara too, O lord of the Daityas, cannot be conquered by the gods or asuras; / he of immeasurable splendor cannot even be looked upon, how much less fought in battle!"

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
ityevamukte vacane kruddhastāmrekṣaṇaḥ śvasan /
vākyamāha mahātejāḥ prahlādaṃ cāndhakāsuraḥ //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने क्रुद्धस्ताम्रेक्षणः श्वसन् /
वाक्यमाह महातेजाः प्रह्लादं चान्धकासुरः //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / When these words were spoken, the mighty asura Andhaka, / enraged, breathing heavily, with copper-red eyes, said to Prahlāda:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ mamāsau raṇe yoddhuṃ śaktastrimayano 'sura /
ekākī dharmarahito bhasmāruṇitavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
किं ममासौ रणे योद्धुं शक्तस्त्रिमयनो ऽसुर /
एकाकी धर्मरहितो भस्मारुणितविग्रहः //
text_mt: "Is that three-eyed one able to fight with me in battle, O asura— / [he who is] solitary, devoid of righteousness, his body reddened with ashes?

sanskrit_iast:
nāndhako bibhiyādindrānnāmarebhyaḥ kathañcana /
sa kathaṃ vṛṣapatrākṣād bibheti strīmukhekṣakāt //
meaning:
नान्धको बिभियादिन्द्रान्नामरेभ्यः कथञ्चन /
स कथं वृषपत्राक्षाद् बिभेति स्त्रीमुखेक्षकात् //
text_mt: Andhaka would not fear Indra, nor the gods in any way; / how should he fear the bull-eyed one who gazes at the faces of women?"

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvāsya vaco ghoraṃ prahlādaḥ prāha nārada /
na samyaguktaṃ bhavatā viruddhaṃ dharmator'thataḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वास्य वचो घोरं प्रह्लादः प्राह नारद /
न सम्यगुक्तं भवता विरुद्धं धर्मतोर्ऽथतः //
text_mt: Hearing his terrible words, Prahlāda said, O Nārada: / "What you have said is not right; it contradicts both righteousness and welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
hutāśanapataṅgābhyāṃ siṃhakroṣṭukayoriva /
gajendramaśakābhyāṃ ca rukmapāṣāṇayoriva //
meaning:
हुताशनपतङ्गाभ्यां सिंहक्रोष्टुकयोरिव /
गजेन्द्रमशकाभ्यां च रुक्मपाषाणयोरिव //
text_mt: As between fire and a moth, or between a lion and a jackal, / or between a lordly elephant and a gnat, or between gold and a stone,

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmebhiruditaṃ yāvadantaramandhaka /
tāvadevāntaraṃ cāsti bhavato vā harasya ca //
meaning:
एतेषामेभिरुदितं यावदन्तरमन्धक /
तावदेवान्तरं चास्ति भवतो वा हरस्य च //
text_mt: as great a distance as has been proclaimed between these, O Andhaka, / just so great is the difference between you and Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
vārito 'si mayā vīra bhūyo bhūyaśca vāryase /
śṛṇuṣva vākyaṃ devarṣerasitasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
वारितो ऽसि मया वीर भूयो भूयश्च वार्यसे /
शृणुष्व वाक्यं देवर्षेरसितस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: You have been warned by me, O hero, and are warned again and again; / listen to the words of the great-souled divine sage Asita:

sanskrit_iast:
yo dharmaśīlo jitamānaroṣo vidyāvinīto na paropatāpī /
svadāratuṣṭaḥ paradāravarjo natasya loke bhayamasti kiñcit //
meaning:
यो धर्मशीलो जितमानरोषो विद्याविनीतो न परोपतापी /
स्वदारतुष्टः परदारवर्जो नतस्य लोके भयमस्ति किञ्चित् //
text_mt: 'He who is virtuous, has conquered pride and anger, is trained in knowledge, harms not others, / is content with his own wife, and shuns the wives of others, has no fear whatsoever in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dharmahīnaḥ kalahapriyaḥ sadā paropatāpī śrutiśāstravarjitaḥ /
parārthadāreṣsuravarṇasaṃgamī sukhaṃ na vindeta paratra ceha //
meaning:
यो धर्महीनः कलहप्रियः सदा परोपतापी श्रुतिशास्त्रवर्जितः /
परार्थदारेष्सुरवर्णसंगमी सुखं न विन्देत परत्र चेह //
text_mt: He who lacks virtue, is ever fond of quarreling, harms others, is devoid of sacred tradition and scripture, / desires the wealth and wives of others, and unites with outcaste women, will find no happiness here or in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast: dharmānvito 'bhūnmanurarkaputraḥ svadārasaṃtuṣṭamanāstvagastyaḥ //
meaning: धर्मान्वितो ऽभून्मनुरर्कपुत्रः स्वदारसंतुष्टमनास्त्वगस्त्यः //
text_mt: Endowed with righteousness was Manu, the son of the Sun; and Agastya had a mind content with his own wife.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni puṇyāni kṛtānyamībhirmayā nibaddhāni kulakramoktyā /
tejonvitāḥ śāpavarakṣamāśca jātāśca sarve surasiddhapūjyāḥ //
meaning:
एतानि पुण्यानि कृतान्यमीभिर्मया निबद्धानि कुलक्रमोक्त्या /
तेजोन्विताः शापवरक्षमाश्च जाताश्च सर्वे सुरसिद्धपूज्याः //
text_mt: These meritorious deeds done by them have been related by me according to lineage; / they became radiant, capable of curses and boons, and revered by gods and Siddhas.

sanskrit_iast:
adharma'yukto 'ṅgasuto babhūva vibhuśca nityaṃ kalahapriyo 'bhūt /
paropatāpī namucirdurātmā parābalepsurnahuṣaśca rājā //
meaning:
अधर्मऽयुक्तो ऽङ्गसुतो बभूव विभुश्च नित्यं कलहप्रियो ऽभूत् /
परोपतापी नमुचिर्दुरात्मा पराबलेप्सुर्नहुषश्च राजा //
text_mt: Joined with unrighteousness was the son of Aṅga, and a ruler who was ever fond of strife; / the wicked Namuci was an afflicter of others, and King Nahuṣa desired the wives of others.

sanskrit_iast:
parārthalipsurdijito hiraṇyadṛk mūrkhastu tasyāpyanujaḥ sudurmatiḥ /
avarṇasaṃgī yadusttamaujā ete vinaṣṭāstvanayāt purā hi //
meaning:
परार्थलिप्सुर्दिजितो हिरण्यदृक् मूर्खस्तु तस्याप्यनुजः सुदुर्मतिः /
अवर्णसंगी यदुस्त्तमौजा एते विनष्टास्त्वनयात् पुरा हि //
text_mt: Hiraṇyadṛk desired the wealth of others, and his younger brother was foolish and evil-minded; / Yadu of mighty valor united with outcaste women; indeed, all these perished through misconduct in former times.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād dharmo na saṃtyājyo dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ /
dharmahīnā narā yānti rauravaṃ narakaṃ mahat //
meaning:
तस्माद् धर्मो न संत्याज्यो धर्मो हि परमा गतिः /
धर्महीना नरा यान्ति रौरवं नरकं महत् //
text_mt: Therefore righteousness must not be abandoned, for righteousness is the supreme goal; / men devoid of righteousness go to the terrible Raurava hell.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmastu gaditaḥ puṃbhistāraṇe divi ceha ca /
patanāya tathādharma iha loke paratra ca //
meaning:
धर्मस्तु गदितः पुंभिस्तारणे दिवि चेह च /
पतनाय तथाधर्म इह लोके परत्र च //
text_mt: Righteousness has been declared by men for deliverance both in heaven and here, / and likewise unrighteousness for falling, in this world and the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
tyājyaṃ dharmānvitairnnityaṃ paradāropasevanam /
nayanti paradārā hi narakānekaviṃśatim /
sarveṣāmapi varṇānāmeṣa dharmo dhruvo 'ndhaka //
meaning:
त्याज्यं धर्मान्वितैर्न्नित्यं परदारोपसेवनम् /
नयन्ति परदारा हि नरकानेकविंशतिम् /
सर्वेषामपि वर्णानामेष धर्मो ध्रुवो ऽन्धक //
text_mt: Those who possess righteousness must ever abandon dalliance with another's wife; / for the wives of others lead one to twenty-one hells; / this is the eternal duty for all social classes, O Andhaka.

sanskrit_iast:
parārthaparadāreṣu yadā vāñchāṃ kariṣyati /
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ rauravaṃ bahulāḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
परार्थपरदारेषु यदा वाञ्छां करिष्यति /
स याति नरकं घोरं रौरवं बहुलाः समाः //
text_mt: Whenever one directs longing towards another's wealth and another's wife, / he goes to the terrible Raurava hell for many years.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ purāsurapate devarṣirasito 'vyāyaḥ /
prāha dharmavyavasthānaṃ khagendrāyāruṇāya hi //
meaning:
एवं पुरासुरपते देवर्षिरसितो ऽव्यायः /
प्राह धर्मव्यवस्थानं खगेन्द्रायारुणाय हि //
text_mt: Thus in ancient times, O lord of the asuras, the imperishable divine sage Asita / proclaimed the establishment of righteousness to Aruṇa, king of birds.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sudūrato varjet paradārān vicakṣaṇāḥ /
nayanti nikṛtiprajñaṃ paradārāḥ parābhavam //
meaning:
तस्मात् सुदूरतो वर्जेत् परदारान् विचक्षणाः /
नयन्ति निकृतिप्रज्ञं परदाराः पराभवम् //
text_mt: Therefore the wise should avoid the wives of others from afar; / the wives of others bring a deceitful-minded man to destruction."

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
ityevamukte vacane prahlādaṃ prāha cāndhakaḥ /
bhavān dharmaparastveko nāhaṃ dharma samācare //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने प्रह्लादं प्राह चान्धकः /
भवान् धर्मपरस्त्वेको नाहं धर्म समाचरे //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / When these words were spoken, Andhaka said to Prahlāda: / "You alone are devoted to righteousness; I do not practice righteousness!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā prahlādamandhakaḥ prāha śambaram /
gaccha śambara śailendraṃ mandaraṃ vada śaṅkaram //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा प्रह्लादमन्धकः प्राह शम्बरम् /
गच्छ शम्बर शैलेन्द्रं मन्दरं वद शङ्करम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to Prahlāda, Andhaka said to Śambara: / "Go, Śambara, to Mandara, the lord of mountains, and say to Śaṅkara:

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣo kimarthaṃ śaulendraṃ svargopamyaṃ sakandaram /
paribhuñjasi kenādya tava datto vadasva māma //
meaning:
भिक्षो किमर्थं शौलेन्द्रं स्वर्गोपम्यं सकन्दरम् /
परिभुञ्जसि केनाद्य तव दत्तो वदस्व माम //
text_mt: 'O beggar, why do you enjoy the lord of mountains, which resembles heaven with its caves? / Tell me, by whom has it been given to you today?

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanti śāsane mahyaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ /
tat kimarthaṃ nivasase māmanādṛtya mandare //
meaning:
तिष्ठन्ति शासने मह्यं देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः /
तत् किमर्थं निवससे मामनादृत्य मन्दरे //
text_mt: The gods, headed by Śakra, abide by my command; / why then do you dwell on Mandara, disregarding me?

sanskrit_iast:
yadīṣṭastava śailendraḥ kriyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama /
yeyaṃ hi bhavataḥ patnī sā me śīghraṃ pradīyatām //
meaning:
यदीष्टस्तव शैलेन्द्रः क्रियतां वचनं मम /
येयं हि भवतः पत्नी सा मे शीघ्रं प्रदीयताम् //
text_mt: If the lord of mountains is dear to you, let my command be done: / that wife of yours—let her be given to me at once!'"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena śambaro mandaraṃ drutam /
jagāma tatra yatrāste saha devyā pinākadhṛk //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स तदा तेन शम्बरो मन्दरं द्रुतम् /
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते सह देव्या पिनाकधृक् //
text_mt: Thus addressed by him then, Śambara went swiftly to Mandara, / where the wielder of the Pināka dwells together with the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvovācāndhakavaco yāthātathyaṃ danoḥ sutaḥ /
tamuttaraṃ haraḥ prāha śṛṇvatyā girikanyayā //
meaning:
गत्वोवाचान्धकवचो याथातथ्यं दनोः सुतः /
तमुत्तरं हरः प्राह शृण्वत्या गिरिकन्यया //
text_mt: Having arrived, that son of Danu related Andhaka's words accurately; / to him Hara gave this reply while the Daughter of the Mountain was listening:

sanskrit_iast:
mamāyaṃ mandaro dattaḥ sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā /
tanna śaknomyahaṃ tyaktuṃ vinājñāṃ vṛkṣavairiṇaḥ //
meaning:
ममायं मन्दरो दत्तः सहस्राक्षेण धीमता /
तन्न शक्नोम्यहं त्यक्तुं विनाज्ञां वृक्षवैरिणः //
text_mt: "This Mandara was given to me by the wise thousand-eyed Indra; / so I cannot abandon it without the command of the enemy of the trees."

sanskrit_iast:
yaccābravīd dīyatāṃ me giriputrīti dānavaḥ /
tadeṣā yātu svaṃ kāmaṃ nāhaṃ vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ //
meaning:
यच्चाब्रवीद् दीयतां मे गिरिपुत्रीति दानवः /
तदेषा यातु स्वं कामं नाहं वारयितुं क्षमः //
text_mt: And as to what the Dānava said, that the mountain's daughter should be given to him: / let her act according to her own wish; I am unable to prevent her.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bravīt girisutā śambaraṃ munisattama /
brūhi gatvāndhakaṃ vīra mama vākyaṃ vipaścitam //
meaning:
ततो ऽब्रवीत् गिरिसुता शम्बरं मुनिसत्तम /
ब्रूहि गत्वान्धकं वीर मम वाक्यं विपश्चितम् //
text_mt: Then the daughter of the mountain said to Śambara, O best of sages: / 'Go, hero, and speak my wise message to Andhaka:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ patākā saṃgrāme bhavānīśaśca devinau /
prāmadyūtaṃ paristīrya yo jeṣyati sa lapsyate //
meaning:
अहं पताका संग्रामे भवानीशश्च देविनौ /
प्रामद्यूतं परिस्तीर्य यो जेष्यति स लप्स्यते //
text_mt: "I am the prize in the battle, and Bhavānī and Īśa are the players. / Setting out the dice-game of combat, whoever wins shall obtain me."'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukto matimān śambaro 'ndakamāgamat /
samāgamyābravīd vākyaṃ śarvagauryośca bhāṣitam //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तो मतिमान् शम्बरो ऽन्दकमागमत् /
समागम्याब्रवीद् वाक्यं शर्वगौर्योश्च भाषितम् //
text_mt: Being addressed thus, the wise Śambara went to Andhaka; / having approached, he related the words spoken by Śarva and Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchratvā dānavapatiḥ krodhadīptekṣaṇaḥ śvasan /
samāhūyābravīd vākyaṃ duryodhanamidaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रत्वा दानवपतिः क्रोधदीप्तेक्षणः श्वसन् /
समाहूयाब्रवीद् वाक्यं दुर्योधनमिदं वचः //
text_mt: Hearing that, the lord of the Dānavas, his eyes blazing with fury, panting, / summoned Duryodhana and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha śīghraṃ mahābāho bherīṃ sānnāhikīṃ dṛḍhām /
tāḍayasva suviśrabdhaṃ duḥśīlāmiva yoṣitam //
meaning:
गच्छ शीघ्रं महाबाहो भेरीं सान्नाहिकीं दृढाम् /
ताडयस्व सुविश्रब्धं दुःशीलामिव योषितम् //
text_mt: 'Go quickly, O mighty-armed one, and strike firmly the war-drum summoning the army, / beating it without hesitation just like an unchaste woman!'

sanskrit_iast:
samādiṣṭo 'ndhakenātha bherīṃ duryodhano balāt /
tāḍayāmāsa vegena yathāprāṇena bhūyasā //
meaning:
समादिष्टो ऽन्धकेनाथ भेरीं दुर्योधनो बलात् /
ताडयामास वेगेन यथाप्राणेन भूयसा //
text_mt: Thus commanded by Andhaka, Duryodhana / beat the drum violently, forcefully, with all his mighty strength.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tāḍitā balavatā bherī duryodhanena hi /
satvaraṃ bhairavaṃ rāvaṃ rurāva surabhī yathā //
meaning:
सा ताडिता बलवता भेरी दुर्योधनेन हि /
सत्वरं भैरवं रावं रुराव सुरभी यथा //
text_mt: Beaten by the powerful Duryodhana, / the drum quickly sounded forth a terrible roar, like a roaring cow.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstaṃ svaramākarṇya sarva eva mahāsurāḥ /
samāyātāḥ sabhāṃ tūrṇaṃ kimetaditi vādinaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यास्तं स्वरमाकर्ण्य सर्व एव महासुराः /
समायाताः सभां तूर्णं किमेतदिति वादिनः //
text_mt: Hearing that sound, all the great asuras / came at once to the assembly, crying out, 'What is this?'

sanskrit_iast:
yāthātathyaṃ ca tān sarvānāha senāpatirbalī /
te cāpi balināṃ śreṣṭhāḥ sannaddhā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
याथातथ्यं च तान् सर्वानाह सेनापतिर्बली /
ते चापि बलिनां श्रेष्ठाः सन्नद्धा युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः //
text_mt: The mighty commander-in-chief told them all the facts as they were; / and they, the foremost among the strong, armed themselves, eager for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
sahāndhakā niryayuste gajairuṣṭrairhayai rathaiḥ /
andhako rathamāsthāya pañcanalvapraṇamāṇataḥ //
meaning:
सहान्धका निर्ययुस्ते गजैरुष्ट्रैर्हयै रथैः /
अन्धको रथमास्थाय पञ्चनल्वप्रणमाणतः //
text_mt: Together with Andhaka they marched out with elephants, camels, horses, and chariots. / Andhaka, mounting his chariot measuring five nalvas in size,

sanskrit_iast:
tryambakaṃ sa parājetuṃ kṛtabuddhirviniryayau /
jambhaḥ kujambho huṇḍaśca tuhuṇḍaḥ śambaro baliḥ //
meaning:
त्र्यम्बकं स पराजेतुं कृतबुद्धिर्विनिर्ययौ /
जम्भः कुजम्भो हुण्डश्च तुहुण्डः शम्बरो बलिः //
text_mt: set out, having resolved to conquer Tryambaka: / Jambha, Kujambha, Huṇḍa, Tuhuṇḍa, Śambara, Bali,

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇāḥ kārtasvaro hastī sūryaśatrurmahodaraḥ /
ayaḥśuṅkuḥ śibiḥ śālvo vṛṣaparvā virocanaḥ //
meaning:
बाणाः कार्तस्वरो हस्ती सूर्यशत्रुर्महोदरः /
अयःशुङ्कुः शिबिः शाल्वो वृषपर्वा विरोचनः //
text_mt: Bāṇa, Kārtasvara, Hastin, Sūryaśatru, Mahodara, / Ayaḥśaṅku, Śibi, Śālva, Vṛṣaparvan, Virocana,

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīvaḥ kālanemiḥ saṃhlādaḥ kālanāśanaḥ /
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva vipracittiśca vīryavān //
meaning:
हयग्रीवः कालनेमिः संह्लादः कालनाशनः /
शरभः शलभश्चैव विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान् //
text_mt: Hayagrīva, Kālanemi, Saṃhlāda, Kālanāśana, / Śarabha, Śalabha, and the valorous Vipracitti,

sanskrit_iast:
duryodhanaśca pākaśca vipākaḥ kālaśambarau /
ete cānye ca bahavo mahāvīryā mahābalāḥ /
prajagamurutsukā yoddhuṃ nānāyudhadharā raṇe //
meaning:
दुर्योधनश्च पाकश्च विपाकः कालशम्बरौ /
एते चान्ये च बहवो महावीर्या महाबलाः /
प्रजगमुरुत्सुका योद्धुं नानायुधधरा रणे //
text_mt: Duryodhana, Pāka, Vipāka, and Kālaśambara; / these and many others of great prowess and mighty power, / bearing various weapons, marched forth eager to fight in the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ durātmā danusainyapālastadāndhako yoddhumanā hareṇa /
mahācalaṃ mandaramabhyupeyivān sa kālapāśāvasito hi mandadhīḥ //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe catvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्थं दुरात्मा दनुसैन्यपालस्तदान्धको योद्धुमना हरेण /
महाचलं मन्दरमभ्युपेयिवान् स कालपाशावसितो हि मन्दधीः //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे चत्वारिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus that wicked commander of the Danu army, Andhaka, intending to fight Hara, / advanced toward the great mountain Mandara, dull-witted and caught in the noose of Time.

Thus ends the fortieth chapter in the holy Vāmana Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pulāstya uvāca /
haro 'pi śambare yāte samāhūyātha nandinam /
prāhāmantraya śailāde ye sthitāstava śāsane //
meaning:
पुलास्त्य उवाच /
हरो ऽपि शम्बरे याते समाहूयाथ नन्दिनम् /
प्राहामन्त्रय शैलादे ये स्थितास्तव शासने //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / 'When Śambara had gone, Hara summoned Nandin / and said: "O son of Śilāda, summon those who abide under your command."

sanskrit_iast:
tato maheśavacanānnandī tūrṇataraṃ gataḥ /
upaspṛśya jalaṃ śrīmān sasmāra gaṇanāyakān //
meaning:
ततो महेशवचनान्नन्दी तूर्णतरं गतः /
उपस्पृश्य जलं श्रीमान् सस्मार गणनायकान् //
text_mt: Then, at the word of Maheśvara, Nandin went with great speed; / sipping water, the glorious one remembered the leaders of the hosts.

sanskrit_iast:
nandinā saṃsmṛtāḥ sarve gaṇanāthāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
samutpatya tvarāyuktāḥ praṇatāstridaseśvaram //
meaning:
नन्दिना संस्मृताः सर्वे गणनाथाः सहस्रशः /
समुत्पत्य त्वरायुक्ताः प्रणतास्त्रिदसेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Remembered by Nandin, all the leaders of the hosts in their thousands / rose up in haste and bowed down to the lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatāṃśca gaṇānnandī kṛtāñjalipuṭo 'vyayaḥ /
sarvān nivedayāmāsa śaṅkarāya mahātmane //
meaning:
आगतांश्च गणान्नन्दी कृताञ्जलिपुटो ऽव्ययः /
सर्वान् निवेदयामास शङ्कराय महात्मने //
text_mt: And the imperishable Nandin, with folded palms, / presented all the arrived hosts to the great-souled Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
nandyuvāca /
yānetān paśyase śaṃbho trinetrāñjaṭilāñśucīn /
ete rudrā iti khyātāḥ koṭya ekādaśaiva tu //
meaning:
नन्द्युवाच /
यानेतान् पश्यसे शंभो त्रिनेत्राञ्जटिलाञ्शुचीन् /
एते रुद्रा इति ख्याताः कोट्य एकादशैव तु //
text_mt: Nandin said: / "These whom you see, O Śambhu, three-eyed, matted-haired, and pure, / are known as the Rudras, eleven crores in number.

sanskrit_iast:
vānarāsyān paśyase yān śārdūlasamavikramān /
eteṣāṃ dvārapālāste mannamāno yaśodhanāḥ //
meaning:
वानरास्यान् पश्यसे यान् शार्दूलसमविक्रमान् /
एतेषां द्वारपालास्ते मन्नमानो यशोधनाः //
text_mt: Those whom you see with monkey faces, having prowess like tigers, / rich in renown and bearing my name, are their gatekeepers.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmukhān paśyase yāṃśca śaktipāṇīñśikhidhvajān /
ṣaṭ ca ṣaṣṭistathā koṭyaḥ skandanāmnaḥ kumārakān //
meaning:
षण्मुखान् पश्यसे यांश्च शक्तिपाणीञ्शिखिध्वजान् /
षट् च षष्टिस्तथा कोट्यः स्कन्दनाम्नः कुमारकान् //
text_mt: And those whom you see six-faced, holding lances, with peacock banners, / sixty-six crores in number, are the youths bearing the name of Skanda.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvatyastathā koṭya śākhā nāma ṣaḍānanāḥ /
viśākhāstāvadevoktā naigameyāśca śaṅkara //
meaning:
एतावत्यस्तथा कोट्य शाखा नाम षडाननाः /
विशाखास्तावदेवोक्ता नैगमेयाश्च शङ्कर //
text_mt: As many crores are the six-faced ones named Śākhas; / just as many are declared to be the Viśākhas and the Naigameyas, O Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
saptakoṭiśataṃ śaṃbho amī vai pramathottamāḥ /
ekaikaṃ prati deveśa tāvatyo hyapi mātaraḥ //
meaning:
सप्तकोटिशतं शंभो अमी वै प्रमथोत्तमाः /
एकैकं प्रति देवेश तावत्यो ह्यपि मातरः //
text_mt: O Śambhu, these seven hundred crores are the foremost Pramathas; / and for every single one of them, O lord of gods, there are just as many Mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmāruṇitadehāśca trinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ /
ete śaivā iti proktāstava bhaktā gaṇeśvarāḥ //
meaning:
भस्मारुणितदेहाश्च त्रिनेत्राः शूलपाणयः /
एते शैवा इति प्रोक्तास्तव भक्ता गणेश्वराः //
text_mt: Their bodies reddened with ash, three-eyed and holding tridents in hand, / these are called Śaivas, lords of the hosts devoted to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā pāśupatāścānye bhasmaprahāraṇā vibho /
ete gaṇāstvasaṃkhyātāḥ sahāyārthaṃ samāgatāḥ //
meaning:
तथा पाशुपताश्चान्ये भस्मप्रहारणा विभो /
एते गणास्त्वसंख्याताः सहायार्थं समागताः //
text_mt: Likewise, others are the Pāśupatas, O all-pervading lord, wielding ash as their weapon; / these innumerable hosts have arrived to assist you.

sanskrit_iast:
pinākadhāriṇo raudrā gaṇāḥ kālamukhāpare /
tava bhaktāḥ samāyātā jaṭāmaṇḍalinodbhutāḥ //
meaning:
पिनाकधारिणो रौद्रा गणाः कालमुखापरे /
तव भक्ताः समायाता जटामण्डलिनोद्भुताः //
text_mt: Terrible, wielding the Pināka, other hosts are the Kālamukhas; / devoted to you, having masses of matted hair, they have arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṭvāṅgayodhino vīrā raktacarmasamāvṛtāḥ /
ime prāptā gaṇā yoddhuṃ mahāvratina uttamāḥ //
meaning:
खट्वाङ्गयोधिनो वीरा रक्तचर्मसमावृताः /
इमे प्राप्ता गणा योद्धुं महाव्रतिन उत्तमाः //
text_mt: Warriors fighting with skull-staffs, covered with red hides, / these foremost observers of the great vow have arrived to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
digvāsaso mauninaśca ghaṇṭāpraharaṇāstathā /
nirāśrayā nāma gaṇāḥ samāyātā jagadguro //
meaning:
दिग्वाससो मौनिनश्च घण्टाप्रहरणास्तथा /
निराश्रया नाम गणाः समायाता जगद्गुरो //
text_mt: Clothed in the quarters, keeping silence, and bearing bells as weapons, / the hosts called Nirāśrayas have arrived, O teacher of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhadvinetrāḥ padmākṣāḥ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasaḥ /
samāyātāḥ khagārūḍhā vṛṣabhadhvajino 'vyayāḥ //
meaning:
सार्धद्विनेत्राः पद्माक्षाः श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसः /
समायाताः खगारूढा वृषभध्वजिनो ऽव्ययाः //
text_mt: Having two and a half eyes, lotus-eyed, their chests marked with the Śrīvatsa, / mounted on birds, carrying bull-banners, imperishable,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāśupatā nāma cakraśūladharāstathā /
bhairavo viṣṇunā sārddhamabhedenārcito hi yai //
meaning:
महापाशुपता नाम चक्रशूलधरास्तथा /
भैरवो विष्णुना सार्द्धमभेदेनार्चितो हि यै //
text_mt: called the Mahāpāśupatas, wielding the discus and the trident, / by whom Bhairava is worshipped without distinction along with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ime mṛgondravadanāḥ śūlabāṇadhanurdharāḥ /
gaṇāstvadromasaṃbhūtā vīrabhadrapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
इमे मृगोन्द्रवदनाः शूलबाणधनुर्धराः /
गणास्त्वद्रोमसंभूता वीरभद्रपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: These have lion faces, holding tridents, arrows, and bows; / they are the hosts born from your body hair, led by Vīrabhadra.

sanskrit_iast:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ /
sahāyārthaṃ tavāyātā yathāprītyādiśasva tān //
meaning:
एते चान्ये च बहवः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः /
सहायार्थं तवायाता यथाप्रीत्यादिशस्व तान् //
text_mt: These and many others, in hundreds and in thousands, / have arrived to assist you; command them as it pleases you."

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bhyetya gaṇāḥ sarve praṇemurvṛṣabhadhvajam /
tān kareṇaiva bhagavān samāśvāsyopaveśayat //
meaning:
ततो ऽभ्येत्य गणाः सर्वे प्रणेमुर्वृषभध्वजम् /
तान् करेणैव भगवान् समाश्वास्योपवेशयत् //
text_mt: Then, drawing near, all the hosts bowed to the one whose banner is a bull; / the Lord consoled them with his hand and made them sit down.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāśupatān dṛṣṭvā samutthāya maheśvaraḥ /
saṃpariṣvajatādhyakṣāṃste praṇemurmaheśvaram //
meaning:
महापाशुपतान् दृष्ट्वा समुत्थाय महेश्वरः /
संपरिष्वजताध्यक्षांस्ते प्रणेमुर्महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Seeing the Mahāpāśupatas, Maheśvara arose / and embraced their chiefs; and they bowed down to Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast: tatastadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve gaṇeśvarāḥ suciraṃ vismitākṣāśca vailakṣyamagamat param //
meaning: ततस्तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे गणेश्वराः सुचिरं विस्मिताक्षाश्च वैलक्ष्यमगमत् परम् //
text_mt: Then, seeing that most wonderful deed, all the lords of the hosts, their eyes wide with amazement for a long time, fell into utter bewilderment.

sanskrit_iast:
vismitākṣān gaṇān dṛṣṭvā sailadiryogināṃ varaḥ /
prāha prahasya deveśaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ gaṇādhipam //
meaning:
विस्मिताक्षान् गणान् दृष्ट्वा सैलदिर्योगिनां वरः /
प्राह प्रहस्य देवेशं शूलपाणिं गणाधिपम् //
text_mt: Seeing the hosts with wondering eyes, the son of Śilāda, foremost among yogins, / smiled and said to the lord of gods, the trident-handed master of the hosts:

sanskrit_iast:
vismitāmī gaṇā deva sarva eva maheśvara /
mahāpāśupatānāṃ hi yat tvayāliṅganaṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
विस्मितामी गणा देव सर्व एव महेश्वर /
महापाशुपतानां हि यत् त्वयालिङ्गनं कृतम् //
text_mt: 'All these hosts, O god, O Maheśvara, are astonished / at the embrace that was given by you to the Mahāpāśupatas.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeteṣāṃ mahādeva sphuṭaṃ trailokyavindakam /
rūpaṃ jñānaṃ vivekaṃ ca vadasva svecchayā vibho //
meaning:
तदेतेषां महादेव स्फुटं त्रैलोक्यविन्दकम् /
रूपं ज्ञानं विवेकं च वदस्व स्वेच्छया विभो //
text_mt: Therefore, O Mahādeva, clearly declare, according to your will, O lord, / their form, wisdom, and discernment which enlighten the three worlds.'

sanskrit_iast:
pramathādhipatervākyaṃ viditvā bhūtabhāvanaḥ /
babhāṣe tān gaṇān sarvān bhāvābhāvavicāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रमथाधिपतेर्वाक्यं विदित्वा भूतभावनः /
बभाषे तान् गणान् सर्वान् भावाभावविचारिणः //
text_mt: Understanding the words of the lord of the Pramathas, the creator of all beings / addressed all those hosts who contemplate existence and non-existence.

sanskrit_iast:
rudra uvāca/ /
bhavdbhirbhaktisaṃyuktairharo bhāvena pūjitaḥ /
ahaṅkāravimūḍhaiśca nindadbhirvaiṣṇavaṃ padam //
meaning:
रुद्र उवाच/ /
भव्द्भिर्भक्तिसंयुक्तैर्हरो भावेन पूजितः /
अहङ्कारविमूढैश्च निन्दद्भिर्वैष्णवं पदम् //
text_mt:
Rudra said:
“Hara has been worshipped with devotion and affection by you,
who are also deluded by egoism and revile the status of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tenājñānena bhavatonādṛtyānuvirodhitāḥ /
yo 'haṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇurviṣṇuryaḥ so 'hamavyayaḥ //
meaning:
तेनाज्ञानेन भवतोनादृत्यानुविरोधिताः /
यो ऽहं स भगवान् विष्णुर्विष्णुर्यः सो ऽहमव्ययः //
text_mt:
Because of that ignorance, those who are disregarded by you are opposed.
Whoever I am, that is the Lord Viṣṇu; and whoever is Viṣṇu, that imperishable one am I.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvayorvai viśeṣo 'sti ekā mūrtirdvidhā sthitā /
tadamībhirnaravyāghrairbhaktibhāvayutairgaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
नावयोर्वै विशेषो ऽस्ति एका मूर्तिर्द्विधा स्थिता /
तदमीभिर्नरव्याघ्रैर्भक्तिभावयुतैर्गणैः //
text_mt:
There is indeed no difference between us two; one form stands divided in two.
Therefore, by these attendants, tigers among men, endowed with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhaṃ vai parijñāto na bhavadbhistathā dhruvam /
yenāhaṃ nindito nityaṃ bhavadbhirmūḍhabuddhibhiḥ //
meaning:
यथाहं वै परिज्ञातो न भवद्भिस्तथा ध्रुवम् /
येनाहं निन्दितो नित्यं भवद्भिर्मूढबुद्धिभिः //
text_mt:
just as I am truly known, surely you have not known Me in that manner;
for I have been continually reviled by you of foolish minds.

sanskrit_iast:
tena jñānaṃ hi vai naṣṭaṃ nātastvāliṅgitā mayā /
ityevamukte vacane gaṇāḥ procurmaheśvaram //
meaning:
तेन ज्ञानं हि वै नष्टं नातस्त्वालिङ्गिता मया /
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने गणाः प्रोचुर्महेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Therefore, your knowledge is indeed lost; hence you have not been embraced by Me.”
When this statement was made, the attendants spoke to Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ bhavān yathaikyena saṃsthito 'sti janārdanaḥ /
bhavān hi nirmalaḥ suddhaḥ śāntaḥ suklo nirañjanaḥ //
meaning:
कथं भवान् यथैक्येन संस्थितो ऽस्ति जनार्दनः /
भवान् हि निर्मलः सुद्धः शान्तः सुक्लो निरञ्जनः //
text_mt:
kathaṃ bhavān yathaikyena saṃsthito 'sti janārdanaḥ
bhavān hi nirmalaḥ suddhaḥ śāntaḥ suklo nirañjanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpyañjanasaṃkāśaḥ kathaṃ teneha yujyate /
teṣāṃ vacanamarthāḍhyaṃ śrutvā jīmūtavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
स चाप्यञ्जनसंकाशः कथं तेनेह युज्यते /
तेषां वचनमर्थाढ्यं श्रुत्वा जीमूतवाहनः //
text_mt:
sa cāpyañjanasaṃkāśaḥ kathaṃ teneha yujyate
teṣāṃ vacanamarthāḍhyaṃ śrutvā jīmūtavāhanaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
vihasya meghagambhīraṃ gaṇānidamuvāca ha /
śrūyatāṃ sarvamākhyāsye svayaśovarddhanaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
विहस्य मेघगम्भीरं गणानिदमुवाच ह /
श्रूयतां सर्वमाख्यास्ये स्वयशोवर्द्धनं वचः //
text_mt:
vihasya meghagambhīraṃ gaṇānidamuvāca ha
śrūyatāṃ sarvamākhyāsye svayaśovarddhanaṃ vacaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
na tveva yogyā yūyaṃ hi mahājñānasya karhicit /
apavādabhayād guhyaṃ bhavatāṃ hi prakāśaye //
meaning:
न त्वेव योग्या यूयं हि महाज्ञानस्य कर्हिचित् /
अपवादभयाद् गुह्यं भवतां हि प्रकाशये //
text_mt:
na tveva yogyā yūyaṃ hi mahājñānasya karhicit

नरकार्हा भवद्भक्ता रक्षामि स्वयशोर्ऽथतः //

sanskrit_iast:
yannindadhvaṃ jagannāthaṃ puṣkarākṣaṃ ca manmayam /
sa caiva sadṛśo loke vidyate sacarācare /
śvetamūrtiḥ sa gavān pīto rakto 'ñjanaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
यन्निन्दध्वं जगन्नाथं पुष्कराक्षं च मन्मयम् /
स चैव सदृशो लोके विद्यते सचराचरे /
श्वेतमूर्तिः स गवान् पीतो रक्तो ऽञ्जनप्रभः //

yannindadhvaṃ jagannāthaṃ puṣkarākṣaṃ ca manmayam

sanskrit_iast:

śvetamūrtiḥ sa bhagavān pīto rakto 'ñjanaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
न तस्य सदृशो लोके विद्यते सचराचरे /
श्वेतमूर्तिः स भगवान् पीतो रक्तो ऽञ्जनप्रभः //

sanskrit_iast:

sa eva dhatte bhagavān sarvapūjyaḥ sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् परतरं लोके नान्यद् धर्म हि विद्यते /
सात्त्विकं राजसं चैव तामसं मिश्रकं तथा /
स एव धत्ते भगवान् सर्वपूज्यः सदाशिवः //

sanskrit_iast:

क्षणाच्छ्वेतः क्षणाद् रक्तः पीतो नीलः क्षणादपि //

meaning:
ततो ऽमरगुरोर्गौरी चन्दनं रोचनाञ्जनम् /
प्रतिवन्द्य सुसंप्रीता पादावेवाभ्यवन्दत //
text_mt:
tato 'maragurorgaurī candanaṃ rocanāñjanam
prativandya susaṃprītā pādāvevābhyavandata

sanskrit_iast:
tato haraḥ prāha vaco yaśasyaṃ mālinīmapi /
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva jayantīṃ cāparājitām //
meaning:
ततो हरः प्राह वचो यशस्यं मालिनीमपि /
जयां च विजयां चैव जयन्तीं चापराजिताम् //
text_mt:
tato haraḥ prāha vaco yaśasyaṃ mālinīmapi
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ caiva jayantīṃ cāparājitām

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmābhirapramattābhiḥ stheyaṃ gehe surakṣite /
rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena giriputrī pramādataḥ //
meaning:
युष्माभिरप्रमत्ताभिः स्थेयं गेहे सुरक्षिते /
रक्षणीया प्रयत्नेन गिरिपुत्री प्रमादतः //
text_mt:
yuṣmābhirapramattābhiḥ stheyaṃ gehe surakṣite
rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena giriputrī pramādataḥ

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃdiśya tāḥ sarvāḥ samāruhya vṛṣaṃ vibhuḥ /
nirjagāma gṛhāt tuṣṭo jayepsuḥ śūladhṛg balī //
meaning:
इति संदिश्य ताः सर्वाः समारुह्य वृषं विभुः /
निर्जगाम गृहात् तुष्टो जयेप्सुः शूलधृग् बली //
text_mt:
iti saṃdiśya tāḥ sarvāḥ samāruhya vṛṣaṃ vibhuḥ
nirjagāma gṛhāt tuṣṭo jayepsuḥ śūladhṛg balī

sanskrit_iast:
nirgacchatastu bhavanādīśvarasya gaṇādhipāḥ /
samantāt parivāryaiva jayaśabdāṃśca cakrire //
meaning:
निर्गच्छतस्तु भवनादीश्वरस्य गणाधिपाः /
समन्तात् परिवार्यैव जयशब्दांश्च चक्रिरे //
text_mt:
nirgacchatastu bhavanādīśvarasya gaṇādhipāḥ
samantāt parivāryaiva jayaśabdāṃśca cakrire

sanskrit_iast:
raṇāya nirgacchati lokapāle maheśvare śūladhare maharṣe /
śubhāni saumyāni sumaṅgalāni jātānī cihnāni jayāya śaṃbhoḥ //
meaning:
रणाय निर्गच्छति लोकपाले महेश्वरे शूलधरे महर्षे /
शुभानि सौम्यानि सुमङ्गलानि जातानी चिह्नानि जयाय शंभोः //
text_mt:
raṇāya nirgacchati lokapāle maheśvare śūladhare maharṣe
śubhāni saumyāni sumaṅgalāni jātānī cihnāni jayāya śaṃbhoḥ

sanskrit_iast:
śivā sthitā vāmatare 'tha bhāge prayāti cāgre svanamunnadantī /
kravyādasaṃghāś ca tathāmiṣaiṇaḥ prayānti hṛṣṭāstṛṣitāsṛgarthe //
meaning:
शिवा स्थिता वामतरे ऽथ भागे प्रयाति चाग्रे स्वनमुन्नदन्ती /
क्रव्यादसंघाश् च तथामिषैणः प्रयान्ति हृष्टास्तृषितासृगर्थे //
text_mt:
śivā sthitā vāmatare 'tha bhāge prayāti cāgre svanamunnadantī
kravyādasaṃghāś ca tathāmiṣaiṇaḥ prayānti hṛṣṭāstṛṣitāsṛgarthe

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāṅgaṃ nakhāntaṃ vai samakampata śūlinaḥ /
śakuniś cāpi hārīto maunī yāti parāṅgamukhaḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणाङ्गं नखान्तं वै समकम्पत शूलिनः /
शकुनिश् चापि हारीतो मौनी याति पराङ्गमुखः //
text_mt:
The right side of the Trident-bearer's body, up to the end of his nails, trembled;
and a green pigeon, silent and turning its face away, flew past.

sanskrit_iast:
nimittānīdṛśān dṛṣṭvā bhūtabhavyabhavo vibhuḥ /
śailādiṃ prāha vacanaṃ sasmitaṃ śaśiśekharaḥ //
meaning:
निमित्तानीदृशान् दृष्ट्वा भूतभव्यभवो विभुः /
शैलादिं प्राह वचनं सस्मितं शशिशेखरः //
text_mt:
Seeing such omens, the omnipresent Lord, the origin of past and future,
the moon-crested god smiled and addressed Śailādi with these words:

sanskrit_iast:
hara uvāca /
nandin jajo 'dya me bhāvī na kathañcit parājayaḥ /
nimittānīha dṛsyante saṃbhūtāni gaṇeśvara //
meaning:
हर उवाच /
नन्दिन् जजो ऽद्य मे भावी न कथञ्चित् पराजयः /
निमित्तानीह दृस्यन्ते संभूतानि गणेश्वर //
text_mt:
Hara said:
“Nandin, victory will be mine today; defeat can by no means occur.
Such omens that have arisen are seen here, O lord of the gaṇas!”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchaṃbhuvacanaṃ śrutvā śailādiḥ prāha saṃkaram /
kaḥ saṃdeho mahādeva yat tvaṃ jayasi śātravān //
meaning:
तच्छंभुवचनं श्रुत्वा शैलादिः प्राह संकरम् /
कः संदेहो महादेव यत् त्वं जयसि शात्रवान् //
text_mt:
Hearing Śambhu's words, Śailādi said to Śaṅkara:
“What doubt is there, O Mahādeva, that you conquer your enemies?”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchaṃbhuvacanaṃ śrutvā śailādiḥ prāha śaṅkaram /
samādideśa yuddhāya mahāpaśupataiḥ saha //
meaning:
तच्छंभुवचनं श्रुत्वा शैलादिः प्राह शङ्करम् /
समादिदेश युद्धाय महापशुपतैः सह //
text_mt:
Hearing Śambhu's words, Śailādi addressed Śaṅkara;
[Hara] commanded [him] to fight together with the great Pāśupatas.

sanskrit_iast:
te 'bhyetya dānavabalaṃ mardayanti sma vegitāḥ /
nānāśastradharā vīrā vṛkṣānaśanayo yathā //
meaning:
ते ऽभ्येत्य दानवबलं मर्दयन्ति स्म वेगिताः /
नानाशस्त्रधरा वीरा वृक्षानशनयो यथा //
text_mt:
Rushing forward, they crushed the Dānava army with impetuosity,
those heroes bearing various weapons, just as lightning bolts [strike down] trees.

sanskrit_iast:
te vadhyamānā balibhiḥ pramathairdaityadānavāḥ /
pravṛttāḥ pramathān hantuṃ kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
ते वध्यमाना बलिभिः प्रमथैर्दैत्यदानवाः /
प्रवृत्ताः प्रमथान् हन्तुं कूटमुद्गरपाणयः //
text_mt:
Being slain by the mighty Pramathas, those Daityas and Dānavas,
with hidden hammers and clubs in hand, set out to slay the Pramathas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'mbaratale devāḥ sendraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ /
sasūryāgnipurogāstu samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽम्बरतले देवाः सेन्द्रविष्णुपितामहाः /
ससूर्याग्निपुरोगास्तु समायाता दिदृक्षवः //
text_mt:
Then the gods, led by Indra, Viṣṇu, and the Grandfather [Brahmā],
preceded by Sūrya and Agni, gathered in the vault of heaven, eager to watch.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'mbaratale ghoṣaḥ sasvanaḥ samajāyata /
gītavādyādisaṃmiśro dundubhīnāṃ kalipriya //
meaning:
ततो ऽम्बरतले घोषः सस्वनः समजायत /
गीतवाद्यादिसंमिश्रो दुन्दुभीनां कलिप्रिय //
text_mt:
Then a loud roar arose in the sky, accompanied by sound,
mingled with singing, instrumental music, and drums, O lover of strife [Nārada]!

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paśyatsu deveṣu mahāpāśupatādayaḥ /
gaṇāstaddānavaṃ sainyaṃ jighāṃsanti sma kopitāḥ //
meaning:
ततः पश्यत्सु देवेषु महापाशुपतादयः /
गणास्तद्दानवं सैन्यं जिघांसन्ति स्म कोपिताः //
text_mt:
Then, as the gods watched, the great Pāśupatas and the rest,
the attendants, enraged, sought to destroy that Dānava army.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṅgabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanyamānaṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ /
krodhānvitastuhuṇḍastu vegonābisasāra ha //
meaning:
चतुरङ्गबलं दृष्ट्वा हन्यमानं गणेश्वरैः /
क्रोधान्वितस्तुहुण्डस्तु वेगोनाबिससार ह //
text_mt:
Seeing his fourfold army being slaughtered by the lords of the gaṇas,
Tuhuṇḍa, overcome with anger, rushed forth with speed,

sanskrit_iast:
ādāya parighaṃ ghoraṃ paṭṭodbddhamayasmayam /
rājataṃ rājate 'tyarthamindradhvajamivocchritam //
meaning:
आदाय परिघं घोरं पट्टोद्ब्द्धमयस्मयम् /
राजतं राजते ऽत्यर्थमिन्द्रध्वजमिवोच्छ्रितम् //
text_mt:
taking up a dreadful iron iron-bar bound with metal bands,
resplendent with silver, exceedingly shining, elevated like Indra's banner.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ bhrāmayāno balavān nijaghāna raṇe gaṇān /
rudrādyāḥ skandaparyantāste 'bhajyanta bhayāturāḥ //
meaning:
तं भ्रामयानो बलवान् निजघान रणे गणान् /
रुद्राद्याः स्कन्दपर्यन्तास्ते ऽभज्यन्त भयातुराः //
text_mt:
Whirling it around, the mighty one struck down the attendants in battle;
those [attendants] from Rudra's followers down to Skanda broke and fled, afflicted with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprabhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇanātho vināyakaḥ /
samādravata vegena tuhuṇḍaṃ danuruṅgavam //
meaning:
तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा गणनाथो विनायकः /
समाद्रवत वेगेन तुहुण्डं दनुरुङ्गवम् //
text_mt:
Seeing that broken army, Vināyaka, the lord of the gaṇas,
rushed swiftly toward Tuhuṇḍa, the bull among Danu's sons.

sanskrit_iast:
āpatantaṃ gaṇapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā daityo durātmavān /
parighaṃ pātayāmāsa gumbhapṛṣṭhe mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
आपतन्तं गणपतिं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यो दुरात्मवान् /
परिघं पातयामास गुम्भपृष्ठे महाबलः //
text_mt:
Seeing the lord of the gaṇas rushing forward, the wicked Daitya,
mighty in strength, brought down his iron bar upon the back of his frontal globe.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakasya tatkumbhe parighaṃ vajrabhūṣaṇam /
śatadhā tvagamad brahman meroḥ kūṭa ivāśaniḥ //
meaning:
विनायकस्य तत्कुम्भे परिघं वज्रभूषणम् /
शतधा त्वगमद् ब्रह्मन् मेरोः कूट इवाशनिः //
text_mt:
Upon the frontal globe of Vināyaka, that iron bar adorned with vajra,
shattered into a hundred pieces, O Brahmin, like a thunderbolt upon a peak of Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
parighaṃ viphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ ca pārṣadam /
babandha bāhupāśena rāhū rakṣan hi mātulam //
meaning:
परिघं विफलं दृष्ट्वा समायान्तं च पार्षदम् /
बबन्ध बाहुपाशेन राहू रक्षन् हि मातुलम् //
text_mt:
Seeing the iron bar fail and the attendant advancing,
Rāhu, protecting his maternal uncle, bound him with the noose of his arms.

sanskrit_iast:
sa baddho bāhupāsena balādākṛṣya dānavam /
samājaghāna śiraśi kuṭhāreṇa mahodaraḥ //
meaning:
स बद्धो बाहुपासेन बलादाकृष्य दानवम् /
समाजघान शिरशि कुठारेण महोदरः //
text_mt:
Bound by the noose of his arms, Mahodara forcibly pulled the Dānava
and struck him on the head with an axe.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhavat sa dvidhā bhūto nipapāta dharātale /
tathāpi nātyajad rāhurbalavān dānaveśvaraḥ /
sa mokṣārthe 'karod yatnaṃ na śaśāka ca nārada //
meaning:
काष्ठवत् स द्विधा भूतो निपपात धरातले /
तथापि नात्यजद् राहुर्बलवान् दानवेश्वरः /
स मोक्षार्थे ऽकरोद् यत्नं न शशाक च नारद //

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakaṃ saṃyatamīkṣya rāhuṇā kuṇḍodaro nāma gaṇeśvaro 'tha /
pragṛhya tūrṇa muśalaṃ mahātmā rāhuṃ durātmānamasau jaghāna //
meaning:
विनायकं संयतमीक्ष्य राहुणा कुण्डोदरो नाम गणेश्वरो ऽथ /
प्रगृह्य तूर्ण मुशलं महात्मा राहुं दुरात्मानमसौ जघान //
text_mt:
Seeing Vināyaka bound by Rāhu, a lord of the gaṇas named Kuṇḍodara,
a great-souled one, swiftly seizing a pestle, struck that wicked Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaṇeśaḥ kalaśadhvajastu prāsena rāhuṃ hṛdaye bibheda /
ghaṭodaro vai gadayā jaghāna khaḍgena rakṣo 'dhipatiḥ sukeśī //
meaning:
ततो गणेशः कलशध्वजस्तु प्रासेन राहुं हृदये बिभेद /
घटोदरो वै गदया जघान खड्गेन रक्षो ऽधिपतिः सुकेशी //
text_mt:
Then the gaṇa-leader Kalaśadhvaja pierced Rāhu in the heart with a dart,
Ghaṭodara struck him with a mace, and the lord of the rākṣasas, Sukeśin, with a sword.

sanskrit_iast:
sa taiścaturbhiḥ paritāḍyamāno gaṇādhipaṃ rāhurathotsasarja /
saṃtyaktamātro 'tha paraśvadhena tuhuṇmūrddhānamatho bibheda //
meaning:
स तैश्चतुर्भिः परिताड्यमानो गणाधिपं राहुरथोत्ससर्ज /
संत्यक्तमात्रो ऽथ परश्वधेन तुहुण्मूर्द्धानमथो बिभेद //
text_mt:
Being beaten on all sides by those four, Rāhu then released the lord of the gaṇas;
and as soon as he was released, he split Tuhuṇḍa's head with a battle-axe.

sanskrit_iast:
hate tuhuṇḍe vimukhe ca rāhau gaṇeśvarāḥ krodhaviṣaṃ mumukṣavaḥ /
pañcaikakālānalasannikāśā viśānti senāṃ danupuṅgavānām //
meaning:
हते तुहुण्डे विमुखे च राहौ गणेश्वराः क्रोधविषं मुमुक्षवः /
पञ्चैककालानलसन्निकाशा विशान्ति सेनां दनुपुङ्गवानाम् //
text_mt:
When Tuhuṇḍa was slain and Rāhu turned away, the lords of the gaṇas, eager to discharge the poison of their anger,
resembling the fire of destruction at the end of time, entered the army of the foremost Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ badhyamānāṃ svacamūṃ samīkṣyacabalirbalī mārutatulyavegaḥ /
gadāṃ samāvidhya jaghāna mūrdhni vināyakaṃ kumbhataṭe kare ca //
meaning:
तां बध्यमानां स्वचमूं समीक्ष्यचबलिर्बली मारुततुल्यवेगः /
गदां समाविध्य जघान मूर्ध्नि विनायकं कुम्भतटे करे च //
text_mt:
Seeing his own army being slaughtered, the mighty Bali, swift as the wind,
whirled his mace and struck Vināyaka on the head, on the slope of his frontal globe, and on his trunk.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍodaraṃ bhagnakaṭiṃ cakāra mahodaraṃ śīrṇaśiraḥkapālam /
kumbhadhvajaṃ cūrṇitasaṃdhibandhaṃ ghaṭodaraṃ coruvibhinnasaṃdhim //
meaning:
कुण्डोदरं भग्नकटिं चकार महोदरं शीर्णशिरःकपालम् /
कुम्भध्वजं चूर्णितसंधिबन्धं घटोदरं चोरुविभिन्नसंधिम् //
text_mt:
He broke Kuṇḍodara's hip, shattered Mahodara's cranium,
crushed Kumbhadhvaja's joints, and dislocated Ghaṭodara's thigh-joints.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇādhipāṃstān vimukhān sa kṛtvā balanvito vīrataro 'surendraḥ /
samabhyadhāvat tvarito nihantuṃ gaṇeśvarān skandaviśākhamukhyān //
meaning:
गणाधिपांस्तान् विमुखान् स कृत्वा बलन्वितो वीरतरो ऽसुरेन्द्रः /
समभ्यधावत् त्वरितो निहन्तुं गणेश्वरान् स्कन्दविशाखमुख्यान् //
text_mt:
Having turned those leaders of the gaṇas back, the mighty asura-lord, supremely valiant,
rushed forward swiftly to slay the lords of the gaṇas led by Skanda and Viśākha.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāpatantaṃ bhagavān samīkṣya maheśvaraḥ śreṣṭhatamaṃ gaṇānām /
śailādimāmantrya vaco babhāṣe gacchasva daityān jahi vīra yuddha //
meaning:
तमापतन्तं भगवान् समीक्ष्य महेश्वरः श्रेष्ठतमं गणानाम् /
शैलादिमामन्त्र्य वचो बभाषे गच्छस्व दैत्यान् जहि वीर युद्ध //
text_mt:
Seeing him rushing forward, the blessed Lord Maheśvara addressed
Śailādi, the foremost of the gaṇas, saying: “Go, slay the Daityas, fight, O hero!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukto vṛṣabhadhvajena vajraṃ samādāya śilādasūnuḥ /
baliṃ sambhyetya jaghāna mūrdhni saṃmohitaḥ so 'vanimāsasāda //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तो वृषभध्वजेन वज्रं समादाय शिलादसूनुः /
बलिं सम्भ्येत्य जघान मूर्ध्नि संमोहितः सो ऽवनिमाससाद //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by the Bull-bannered god, the son of Śilāda took up a thunderbolt,
rushed toward Bali, and struck him on the head; bewildered, he fell to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmohitaṃ bhrātṛsutaṃ viditvā balī kujambho musalaṃ pragṛhya /
saṃbhrāmayaṃstūrṇataraṃ sa vegāt sasarja nandiṃ prati jātakopaḥ //
meaning:
संमोहितं भ्रातृसुतं विदित्वा बली कुजम्भो मुसलं प्रगृह्य /
संभ्रामयंस्तूर्णतरं स वेगात् ससर्ज नन्दिं प्रति जातकोपः //
text_mt:
Knowing his brother's son to be stunned, the mighty Kujambha seized a pestle,
and whirling it very swiftly with great force, hurled it in anger toward Nandin.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāpatantaṃ musalaṃ pragṛhya kareṇa tūrṇa bhagavān sa nandī /
jaghāna tenaiva kujambhamāhave sa prāṇahīno nipapāta bhūmau //
meaning:
तमापतन्तं मुसलं प्रगृह्य करेण तूर्ण भगवान् स नन्दी /
जघान तेनैव कुजम्भमाहवे स प्राणहीनो निपपात भूमौ //
text_mt:
Swiftly catching with his hand that pestle as it flew toward him, the blessed Nandin
struck Kujambha in battle with that very weapon; he fell lifeless to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā kujambhaṃ musalena nandī vajreṇa vīraḥ śataśo jaghāna /
te vadhyamānā gaṇanāyakena duryodhanaṃ vai śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ //
meaning:
हत्वा कुजम्भं मुसलेन नन्दी वज्रेण वीरः शतशो जघान /
ते वध्यमाना गणनायकेन दुर्योधनं वै शरणं प्रपन्नाः //
text_mt:
Having slain Kujambha with the pestle, the heroic Nandin struck down hundreds with his thunderbolt;
being slaughtered by the leader of the gaṇas, they took refuge with Duryodhana.

sanskrit_iast:
duryodhanaḥ prekṣya gaṇādhipena vajrapahārairnihatān ditīśān /
prāsaṃ samāvidhya taḍitprakāśaṃ nandiṃ pracikṣepa hato 'si vai bruvan //
meaning:
दुर्योधनः प्रेक्ष्य गणाधिपेन वज्रपहारैर्निहतान् दितीशान् /
प्रासं समाविध्य तडित्प्रकाशं नन्दिं प्रचिक्षेप हतो ऽसि वै ब्रुवन् //
text_mt:
Seeing the lords of Diti slain by the leader of the gaṇas with blows of his thunderbolt,
Duryodhana brandished a dart gleaming like lightning and hurled it at Nandin, shouting: “You are slain!”

sanskrit_iast:
tamāpatantaṃ kuliśena nandī bibheda guhyaṃ piśuno yathā naraḥ /
tatprāsamālakṣya tadā nikṛttaṃ saṃvarttya muṣṭiṃ gaṇamāsasāda //
meaning:
तमापतन्तं कुलिशेन नन्दी बिभेद गुह्यं पिशुनो यथा नरः /
तत्प्रासमालक्ष्य तदा निकृत्तं संवर्त्त्य मुष्टिं गणमाससाद //
text_mt:
As it flew toward him, Nandin shattered it with his thunderbolt, just as a treacherous man reveals a secret;
seeing that dart sliced apart, Duryodhana clenched his fist and charged the attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'sya nandī kulisena tṛrṇa śiro 'cchinat tālaphalaprakāśam /
hato 'tha bhūmau nipapāta vegād daityāśca bhītā vigatā diśo daśa //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्य नन्दी कुलिसेन तृर्ण शिरो ऽच्छिनत् तालफलप्रकाशम् /
हतो ऽथ भूमौ निपपात वेगाद् दैत्याश्च भीता विगता दिशो दश //
text_mt:
Then Nandin quickly cut off his head, which was like a palmyra fruit, with his thunderbolt;
slain, he fell headlong to the earth, and the terrified Daityas fled in the ten directions.

sanskrit_iast:
tato hataṃ svaṃ tanayaṃ nirīkṣya hastī tadā nandinamājagāma /
pragṛhya bāṇāsanamugravegaṃ bibheda bāṇairyamadaṇḍakalpaiḥ //
meaning:
ततो हतं स्वं तनयं निरीक्ष्य हस्ती तदा नन्दिनमाजगाम /
प्रगृह्य बाणासनमुग्रवेगं बिभेद बाणैर्यमदण्डकल्पैः //
text_mt:
Then seeing his own son slain, Hastin approached Nandin;
seizing a bow of fierce velocity, he pierced him with arrows resembling the rod of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇān sandīn vṛṣabhadhvajāṃstān dhārābhirevāmburāstu śailān /
te chādyamānāsurabāmajālairvināyakādyā balino 'pi samantān //
meaning:
गणान् सन्दीन् वृषभध्वजांस्तान् धाराभिरेवाम्बुरास्तु शैलान् /
ते छाद्यमानासुरबामजालैर्विनायकाद्या बलिनो ऽपि समन्तान् //
text_mt:
Just as clouds [deluge] mountains with torrents of water, [he showered] the gaṇas, Nandin, and the followers of the Bull-bannered god;
and though mighty, Vināyaka and the others were completely enveloped on all sides by the nets of the asura's arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
parāṅmukhān vīkṣya gaṇān kumāraḥ śaktyā pṛṣatkāntha vārayitvā /
tūrṇaṃ sabhabhyetya ripuṃ samīkṣya pragṛhya śaktyā hṛdaye vibheda //
meaning:
पराङ्मुखान् वीक्ष्य गणान् कुमारः शक्त्या पृषत्कान्थ वारयित्वा /
तूर्णं सभभ्येत्य रिपुं समीक्ष्य प्रगृह्य शक्त्या हृदये विभेद //
text_mt: Seeing the gaṇas turned back, Kumāra warded off the arrows with his spear; / having quickly approached and looked upon the enemy, he seized his spear and pierced his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktinirbhinnahṛdayo hastī bhūmyāṃ papātaha /
mamāra cāripṛtanā jātā bhūyaḥ parāṅmukhī //
meaning:
शक्तिनिर्भिन्नहृदयो हस्ती भूम्यां पपातह /
ममार चारिपृतना जाता भूयः पराङ्मुखी //
text_mt: With his heart pierced by the spear, Hastin fell down to the ground / and died; and the enemy army turned back once again.

sanskrit_iast:
amarāribalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ kruddhā gaṇeśvarāḥ /
purato nandinaṃ kṛtvā jighāṃsanti sma dānavān //
meaning:
अमरारिबलं दृष्ट्वा भग्नं क्रुद्धा गणेश्वराः /
पुरतो नन्दिनं कृत्वा जिघांसन्ति स्म दानवान् //
text_mt: Seeing the army of the gods' enemies broken, the enraged lords of gaṇas, / placing Nandin in front, sought to slay the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
te vadhyamānāḥ pramathairdaityāścāpi parāṅmukhāḥṣa /
bhūyo nivṛttā balinaḥ kārttasvarapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
ते वध्यमानाः प्रमथैर्दैत्याश्चापि पराङ्मुखाःष /
भूयो निवृत्ता बलिनः कार्त्तस्वरपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: Being slaughtered by the Pramathas, those Daityas turned their backs, / but then returned again, mighty, led by Kārttasvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tān nivṛttān samīkṣyaiva krodhadīptekṣaṇaḥ śvaśasan /
nandiṣeṇo vyāghramukho nivṛttaścāpi vegavān //
meaning:
तान् निवृत्तान् समीक्ष्यैव क्रोधदीप्तेक्षणः श्वशसन् /
नन्दिषेणो व्याघ्रमुखो निवृत्तश्चापि वेगवान् //
text_mt: Seeing them return, with eyes glowing with rage, hissing, / tiger-faced Nandiṣeṇa also turned back swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin nivṛtte gaṇape paṭṭiśāgrakare tadā /
kārttasvaro nivavṛte gadāmādāya nārada //
meaning:
तस्मिन् निवृत्ते गणपे पट्टिशाग्रकरे तदा /
कार्त्तस्वरो निववृते गदामादाय नारद //
text_mt: When that lord of gaṇas turned back with a paṭṭiśa in his hand, / Kārttasvara turned back, seizing his mace, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāpatantaṃ jvalanaprakāśaṃ gamaḥ samīkṣyaiva mahāsurendram /
taṃ paṭṭiśaṃ bhrāmya jaghāna mūrdhni kārtasvaraṃ visvaramunnadantam //
meaning:
तमापतन्तं ज्वलनप्रकाशं गमः समीक्ष्यैव महासुरेन्द्रम् /
तं पट्टिशं भ्राम्य जघान मूर्ध्नि कार्तस्वरं विस्वरमुन्नदन्तम् //
text_mt: Seeing that mighty lord of asuras rushing, blazing like fire, / the gaṇa brandished that paṭṭiśa and struck Kārttasvara, who cried out discordantly, on the head.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin hate samāvidhya turaṅgakandharaḥ /
babandha vīraḥ saha paṭṭiśena gaṇeśvaraṃ cāpyatha nandiṣeṇam //
meaning:
तस्मिन् हते समाविध्य तुरङ्गकन्धरः /
बबन्ध वीरः सह पट्टिशेन गणेश्वरं चाप्यथ नन्दिषेणम् //
text_mt: When he was slain, Turaṅgakandhara, whirling [his lasso], / the hero bound the lord of gaṇas, Nandiṣeṇa, along with his paṭṭiśa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandiṣeṇaṃ tathā baddhaṃ samīkṣya balināṃ varaḥ /
viśākhaḥ kapito 'bhyetya śaktipāṇiravasthitaḥ //
meaning:
नन्दिषेणं तथा बद्धं समीक्ष्य बलिनां वरः /
विशाखः कपितो ऽभ्येत्य शक्तिपाणिरवस्थितः //
text_mt: Seeing Nandiṣeṇa bound in that way, the best of the mighty, / enraged Viśākha, rushed forward and stood with spear in hand.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā balināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pāśapāṇirayaḥśirāḥ /
saṃyodhayāmāsa balī viśākhaṃ kukkuṭadhvajam //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा बलिनां श्रेष्ठः पाशपाणिरयःशिराः /
संयोधयामास बली विशाखं कुक्कुटध्वजम् //
text_mt: Seeing him, the mighty Ayaḥśiras, best among the strong, with a noose in hand, / fought against Viśākha, whose banner bore a rooster.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhaṃ saṃniruddhaṃ vai dṛṣṭvāyaśirasā raṇe /
śākhaśca naigameyaśca tūrṇamādravatāṃ ripum //
meaning:
विशाखं संनिरुद्धं वै दृष्ट्वायशिरसा रणे /
शाखश्च नैगमेयश्च तूर्णमाद्रवतां रिपुम् //
text_mt: Seeing Viśākha held back in battle by Ayaḥśiras, / Śākha and Naigameya quickly rushed against the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
ekato naigameyena bhinnaḥ śaktyā tvayaḥsirāḥ /
śākhaśca naigameyaśca tūrṇamādravatāṃ ripum //
meaning:
एकतो नैगमेयेन भिन्नः शक्त्या त्वयःसिराः /
शाखश्च नैगमेयश्च तूर्णमाद्रवतां रिपुम् //
text_mt: Pierced on one side with a spear by Naigameya, Ayaḥśiras / […] Śākha and Naigameya quickly rushed against the enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tribhiḥ śaṅkarasutaiḥ pīḍyamāno jahau paṇam /
te prāptāḥ śambaraṃ tūrṇaṃ prekṣyamāṇā gaṇeśvarāḥ //
meaning:
स त्रिभिः शङ्करसुतैः पीड्यमानो जहौ पणम् /
ते प्राप्ताः शम्बरं तूर्णं प्रेक्ष्यमाणा गणेश्वराः //
text_mt: Afflicted by the three sons of Śaṅkara, he abandoned the wager; / and those lords of gaṇas quickly reached Śambara, under their eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśaṃ śaktyā samāhatya caturbhiḥ śaṅkarātmajaiḥ /
jagāma vilayaṃ tūrṇamākāsādiva bhūtalam //
meaning:
पाशं शक्त्या समाहत्य चतुर्भिः शङ्करात्मजैः /
जगाम विलयं तूर्णमाकासादिव भूतलम् //
text_mt: When the noose was struck down with a spear by the four sons of Śaṅkara, / it quickly vanished, as if [falling] from the sky to the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśe nirāśatāṃ yāte śambaraḥ kātarekṣaṇaḥ /
diśo 'tha bheje devarṣe kumāraḥ sainyamardayat //
meaning:
पाशे निराशतां याते शम्बरः कातरेक्षणः /
दिशो ऽथ भेजे देवर्षे कुमारः सैन्यमर्दयत् //
text_mt: When his noose had become useless, Śambara, with terrified eyes, / fled in every direction, O divine sage, and Kumāra crushed the army.

sanskrit_iast:
tairvadhyamānā pṛtanā maharṣe sādānavī rudrasutairgaṇaiśca /
viṣaṇṇārūpā bhayavihvalāṅgī jagāma sukraṃ śaraṇaṃ bhayārtā //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तैर्वध्यमाना पृतना महर्षे सादानवी रुद्रसुतैर्गणैश्च /
विषण्णारूपा भयविह्वलाङ्गी जगाम सुक्रं शरणं भयार्ता //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Slaughtered by them, the sons of Rudra and the gaṇas, O great sage, that Dānava army, / dejected in form, its limbs trembling with fear, took refuge in Śukra, afflicted with dread.

Thus ends the forty-second chapter in the glorious Vāmana Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
tataḥ svaisainyamālakṣya nihataṃ pramathairatha /
andhako 'bhyetya śukraṃ tu idaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
ततः स्वैसैन्यमालक्ष्य निहतं प्रमथैरथ /
अन्धको ऽभ्येत्य शुक्रं तु इदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Then, seeing his own army slain by the Pramathas, / Andhaka approached Śukra and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavaṃstvāṃ māśritya vayaṃ bādhāma devatāḥ /
athānyānapi viprarṣe gandharvasurakinnarān //
meaning:
भगवंस्त्वां माश्रित्य वयं बाधाम देवताः /
अथान्यानपि विप्रर्षे गन्धर्वसुरकिन्नरान् //
text_mt: "O Lord, relying upon you, we harass the gods, / and other Gandharvas, suras, and Kinnaras as well, O Brahmin sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tadiyaṃ paśya bhagavan mayā guptā varūthinī /
anāthena yathā nārī pramathairapi kālyate //
meaning:
तदियं पश्य भगवन् मया गुप्ता वरूथिनी /
अनाथेन यथा नारी प्रमथैरपि काल्यते //
text_mt: Therefore behold, O Lord, this army protected by me / is driven away by the Pramathas, like a woman without a protector.

sanskrit_iast:
kujambhādyāśca nihatā bhrātaro mama bhārgava /
akṣayāḥ pramathāścāmī kurukṣetraphalaṃ yathā //
meaning:
कुजम्भाद्याश्च निहता भ्रातरो मम भार्गव /
अक्षयाः प्रमथाश्चामी कुरुक्षेत्रफलं यथा //
text_mt: My brothers, Kujambha and the others, have been slain, O Bhārgava, / while these Pramathas are inexhaustible, like the fruit of Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt kuruṣva śreyo no na jīyema yathā paraiḥ /
jayema ca parān yuddhe tathā tvaṃ kurtumarhasi //
meaning:
तस्मात् कुरुष्व श्रेयो नो न जीयेम यथा परैः /
जयेम च परान् युद्धे तथा त्वं कुर्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Therefore, bring about our welfare, so that we may not be defeated by our enemies; / and you ought to act in such a way that we conquer the enemies in battle."

sanskrit_iast:
śukro 'ndhakavacaḥ śrutvā sāntvayan paramādbhutam /
vacanaṃ prāha devarṣe brahmarṣirdānaveśvaram /
tvaddhitārtha yatiṣyāmi kariṣyāmi tava priyam //
meaning:
शुक्रो ऽन्धकवचः श्रुत्वा सान्त्वयन् परमाद्भुतम् /
वचनं प्राह देवर्षे ब्रह्मर्षिर्दानवेश्वरम् /
त्वद्धितार्थ यतिष्यामि करिष्यामि तव प्रियम् //
text_mt: Hearing Andhaka's words, consoling him, the divine seer, / the Brahmin sage Śukra spoke very wondrous words to the lord of the Dānavas: / 'I shall strive for your welfare, I shall do what is pleasing to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ vidyāṃ saṃjīvanīṃ kaviḥ /
ārvatayāmāsa tadā vidhānena śucivrataḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं विद्यां संजीवनीं कविः /
आर्वतयामास तदा विधानेन शुचिव्रतः //
text_mt: Having spoken these words, the sage of pure observances / then recited the Saṃjīvanī lore according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmāvartyamānāyāṃ vidyāyāmasureśvarāḥ /
