text_mt: having bowed to the Lord of the Universe bearing the form of the Tortoise, / he then went to what is called Kṛṣṇā to see the horse-headed Lord. / Having bathed there in Devahrada and gratified the ancestors and the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya hayaśīrṣaṃ ca jagāma gajasāhvayam /
tatra devaṃ jagannāthaṃ govindaṃ cakrapāṇinam //
meaning:
संपूज्य हयशीर्षं च जगाम गजसाह्वयम् /
तत्र देवं जगन्नाथं गोविन्दं चक्रपाणिनम् //
text_mt: and having worshipped the horse-headed one, he went to the city named after the elephant. / There [he worshipped] the god, the Lord of the Universe, Govinda who holds the discus in hand.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā saṃpūjya vidhivat jagāma yamunāṃ nīm /
tasyāṃ snātaḥ śucirbhūtvā saṃtarpyārṣisurān pitṝn /
dadarśa devadeveśaṃ lokanāthaṃ trivikramam //
meaning:
स्नात्वा संपूज्य विधिवत् जगाम यमुनां नीम् /
तस्यां स्नातः शुचिर्भूत्वा संतर्प्यार्षिसुरान् पितॄन् /
ददर्श देवदेवेशं लोकनाथं त्रिविक्रमम् //
text_mt: Having bathed and worshipped according to rule, he went to the river Yamunā. / Having bathed in it, become purified, and gratified the sages, gods, and ancestors, / he beheld Trivikrama, the ruler of the gods of gods, the lord of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca /
sāmprataṃ bhagavān viṣṇustrailokyākramaṇaṃ vapuḥ /
kariṣyati jagatsvāmī balerbandhanamīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच /
साम्प्रतं भगवान् विष्णुस्त्रैलोक्याक्रमणं वपुः /
करिष्यति जगत्स्वामी बलेर्बन्धनमीश्वरः //
text_mt: Nārada said: / At present the Lord Viṣṇu, master of the universe and sovereign, / will assume the form that strides across the three worlds to bind Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathaṃ pūrvakāle 'pi vibhurāsīt trivikramaḥ /
kasya vā bandhanaṃ viṣṇuḥ kṛtavāṃstacca me vada //
meaning:
तत्कथं पूर्वकाले ऽपि विभुरासीत् त्रिविक्रमः /
कस्य वा बन्धनं विष्णुः कृतवांस्तच्च मे वद //
text_mt: How then was the omnipresent Trivikrama also [present] in earlier times? / Or whom did Viṣṇu bind? Tell me that.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
śrūyatāṃ kathiyiṣyāmi yo 'yaṃ proktastrivikramaḥ /
yasmin kāle saṃbabhūva yaṃ ca vañcitavānasau //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
श्रूयतां कथियिष्यामि यो ऽयं प्रोक्तस्त्रिविक्रमः /
यस्मिन् काले संबभूव यं च वञ्चितवानसौ //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Listen, I will tell of this one who is spoken of as Trivikrama, / at what time he arose and whom he deceived.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīd dhundhuriti khyātaḥ kaśyapasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ /
danugarbhasamudbhūto mābalaparākramaḥ //
meaning:
आसीद् धुन्धुरिति ख्यातः कश्यपस्यौरसः सुतः /
दनुगर्भसमुद्भूतो माबलपराक्रमः //
text_mt: There was a son born of the loins of Kaśyapa known as Dhundhu, / born from the womb of Danu, possessed of great strength and valor.

sanskrit_iast:
sa samārādya varadaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tapasāsuraḥ /
avadhyatvaṃ suraiḥ sendraiḥ prārthayat sa tu nārada //
meaning:
स समाराद्य वरदं ब्रह्माणं तपसासुरः /
अवध्यत्वं सुरैः सेन्द्रैः प्रार्थयत् स तु नारद //
text_mt: Having propitiated the boon-bestowing Brahmā through asceticism, that asura / requested invulnerability from the gods along with Indra, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
tad varaṃ tasya ca prādāt tapasā paṅkajodbhavaḥ /
parituṣṭaḥ sa ca balī nirjagāma triviṣṭapam //
meaning:
तद् वरं तस्य च प्रादात् तपसा पङ्कजोद्भवः /
परितुष्टः स च बली निर्जगाम त्रिविष्टपम् //
text_mt: And the lotus-born [Brahmā], highly pleased by his asceticism, granted him that boon. / Then that mighty one set forth to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthasya kalerādau jitvā devān savāsavān /
dhundhuḥ śakratvamakaroddhiraṇyakaśipau sati //
meaning:
चतुर्थस्य कलेरादौ जित्वा देवान् सवासवान् /
धुन्धुः शक्रत्वमकरोद्धिरण्यकशिपौ सति //
text_mt: At the beginning of the fourth Kali, having conquered the gods with Indra, / Dhundhu exercised Indra's sovereignty while Hiraṇyakaśipu was [yet] alive.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin kāle sa balavān hiraṇyakaśipustataḥ /
cacāra mandaragirau daityaṃ dhundhuṃ samāśritaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन् काले स बलवान् हिरण्यकशिपुस्ततः /
चचार मन्दरगिरौ दैत्यं धुन्धुं समाश्रितः //
text_mt: At that time, that mighty Hiraṇyakaśipu / moved about on Mount Mandara, taking refuge with the Daitya Dhundhu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'surā yathā kāmaṃ viharanti triviṣṭape /
brahmaloke ca tridaśāḥ saṃsthitā duḥkhasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽसुरा यथा कामं विहरन्ति त्रिविष्टपे /
ब्रह्मलोके च त्रिदशाः संस्थिता दुःखसंयुताः //
text_mt: Then the asuras roamed at will in heaven, / while the thirty [gods] stayed in Brahmaloka, overcome with sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'marān brahmasado nivāsinaḥ śrutvātha dhundhurditijānuvāca /
brajāma daitya vayamagrajasya sado vijetuṃ tridaśān saśakrān //
meaning:
ततो ऽमरान् ब्रह्मसदो निवासिनः श्रुत्वाथ धुन्धुर्दितिजानुवाच /
ब्रजाम दैत्य वयमग्रजस्य सदो विजेतुं त्रिदशान् सशक्रान् //
text_mt: Then Dhundhu, having heard that the immortals were dwelling in the realm of Brahmā, spoke to the sons of Diti: / 'O Daityas, let us go to the realm of our elder brother to conquer the thirty [gods] along with Indra.'

sanskrit_iast:
te dhundhuvākyaṃ tu niśamya daityāḥ procurna no vidyati lokapāla /
gatiryayā yāma pitāmahājiraṃ sudurgamo 'yaṃ parato hi mārgaḥ //
meaning:
ते धुन्धुवाक्यं तु निशम्य दैत्याः प्रोचुर्न नो विद्यति लोकपाल /
गतिर्यया याम पितामहाजिरं सुदुर्गमो ऽयं परतो हि मार्गः //
text_mt: Hearing Dhundhu's words, the Daityas said: / 'O protector of the world, there is no way known to us by which we may go to the courtyard of the Grandfather; indeed, the road beyond is exceedingly difficult to traverse.

sanskrit_iast:
itaḥ sahasrairbahuyojanākhyairloko maharnāma maharṣijuṣṭaḥ /
yeṣāṃ hi dṛṣṭyār'paṇacoditena dahyanti daityāḥ sahasekṣitena //
meaning:
इतः सहस्रैर्बहुयोजनाख्यैर्लोको महर्नाम महर्षिजुष्टः /
येषां हि दृष्ट्यार्ऽपणचोदितेन दह्यन्ति दैत्याः सहसेक्षितेन //
text_mt: Many thousands of leagues from here is the world named Mahas, frequented by great sages, / by whose gaze, impelled by focused intention, Daityas are instantly consumed when seen.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'paro yojanakoṭinā vai loko jano nāma vasnti yatra /
gomātaro 'smāsu vināśakāri yāsāṃ rajo 'pīha mahāsurendra //
meaning:
ततो ऽपरो योजनकोटिना वै लोको जनो नाम वस्न्ति यत्र /
गोमातरो ऽस्मासु विनाशकारि यासां रजो ऽपीह महासुरेन्द्र //
text_mt: Beyond that, at a distance of ten million leagues, is the world named Janas, where dwell / the mothers of cows, whose very dust here causes destruction to us, O great lord of asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'paro yojanakoṭibhistu ṣaḍbhistapo nāma tapasvijuṣṭaḥ /
tiṣṭhanti yatrāsura sādhyavaryā yeṣāṃ hi naśvāsamarut tvasahyaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽपरो योजनकोटिभिस्तु षड्भिस्तपो नाम तपस्विजुष्टः /
तिष्ठन्ति यत्रासुर साध्यवर्या येषां हि नश्वासमरुत् त्वसह्यः //
text_mt: Beyond that, at a distance of sixty million leagues, is [the world] named Tapas, frequented by ascetics, / where the foremost Sādhyas abide, O asura, the wind of whose breath is unbearable.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'paro yojanakoṭibhistu triṃśadbhirādityasahasradīptiḥ /
satyābhidhāno bhagavannivāso varaprado 'bhud bhavato hi yo 'sau //
meaning:
ततो ऽपरो योजनकोटिभिस्तु त्रिंशद्भिरादित्यसहस्रदीप्तिः /
सत्याभिधानो भगवन्निवासो वरप्रदो ऽभुद् भवतो हि यो ऽसौ //
text_mt: Beyond that, at a distance of three hundred million leagues, blazing with the brilliance of a thousand suns, / is the abode of the Lord named Satya, he who indeed was the grantor of your boon.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vedadhvaniṃ śrutvā vikasanti su rādayaḥ /
saṃkocamasurā yānti ye ca teṣāṃ sadharmiṇaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य वेदध्वनिं श्रुत्वा विकसन्ति सु रादयः /
संकोचमसुरा यान्ति ये च तेषां सधर्मिणः //
text_mt: Upon hearing whose sound of the Veda, the gods and others flourish, / while the asuras, and those who share their nature, contract.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmā tvaṃ mahābāho matimetāṃ samādadhaḥ /
vairājabhuvanaṃ dhundho durārohaṃ sadā nṛbhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्मा त्वं महाबाहो मतिमेतां समादधः /
वैराजभुवनं धुन्धो दुरारोहं सदा नृभिः //
text_mt: Therefore, O long-armed one, do not set your mind on this; / the realm of Virāj, O Dhundhu, is ever difficult to ascend by men.'

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ vacanamākarṇya dhundhuḥ provāca dānavān /
gantukāmaḥ sa sadanaṃ brahmaṇo jetumīśvarān //
meaning:
तेषां वचनमाकर्ण्य धुन्धुः प्रोवाच दानवान् /
गन्तुकामः स सदनं ब्रह्मणो जेतुमीश्वरान् //
text_mt: Hearing their words, Dhundhu, desirous of going / to the realm of Brahmā to conquer the lords, spoke to the Dānavas:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ tu karmaṇā kena gamyate dānavarṣabhāḥ /
kathaṃ tatra sahasrākṣaḥ saṃprāptaḥ saha daivataiḥ //
meaning:
कथं तु कर्मणा केन गम्यते दानवर्षभाः /
कथं तत्र सहस्राक्षः संप्राप्तः सह दैवतैः //
text_mt: 'How then, by what action is it reached, O best of Dānavas? / How did the thousand-eyed [Indra] arrive there together with the deities?'

sanskrit_iast:
te dhundhunā dānavendrāḥ pṛṣṭāḥ procurvaco 'dhipam /
karma tanna vayaṃ vidmaḥ śukrastad vettyasaṃśayam //
meaning:
ते धुन्धुना दानवेन्द्राः पृष्टाः प्रोचुर्वचो ऽधिपम् /
कर्म तन्न वयं विद्मः शुक्रस्तद् वेत्त्यसंशयम् //
text_mt: Those chiefs of the Dānavas, questioned by Dhundhu, said to their sovereign: / 'We do not know that action; Śukra undoubtedly knows it.'

sanskrit_iast:
daityānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dhunadhurdaityapurohitam /
papraccha śukraṃ kiṃ karma kṛtvā brahmasadogatiḥ //
meaning:
दैत्यानां वचनं श्रुत्वा धुनधुर्दैत्यपुरोहितम् /
पप्रच्छ शुक्रं किं कर्म कृत्वा ब्रह्मसदोगतिः //
text_mt: Having heard the words of the Daityas, Dhundhu questioned the family priest of the Daityas, / Śukra: 'Having performed what action does one attain the realm of Brahmā?'

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'smai kathayāmāsa daityacāryaḥ kalipriya /
śakrasya caritaṃ śrīmān purā vṛtraripoḥ kila //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्मै कथयामास दैत्यचार्यः कलिप्रिय /
शक्रस्य चरितं श्रीमान् पुरा वृत्ररिपोः किल //
text_mt: Then the illustrious teacher of the Daityas, fond of strife, related to him / the ancient conduct of Indra, the enemy of Vṛtra:

sanskrit_iast:
śakraḥ śataṃ tu puṇyānāṃ krotūnāmajayat purā /
daityendra vājimedhānāṃ tena brahmasado gataḥ //
meaning:
शक्रः शतं तु पुण्यानां क्रोतूनामजयत् पुरा /
दैत्येन्द्र वाजिमेधानां तेन ब्रह्मसदो गतः //
text_mt: 'Formerly, Indra conquered a hundred meritorious sacrifices, / horse-sacrifices, O lord of Daityas; by means of that he went to the realm of Brahmā.'

sanskrit_iast:
tadvākyaṃ dānavapatiḥ śrutvā śukrasya vīryavān /
yaṣṭuṃ turagamedhānāṃ cakāra matimuttamām /
athāmantryāsuraguruṃ dānavāṃścāpyanuttamān //
meaning:
तद्वाक्यं दानवपतिः श्रुत्वा शुक्रस्य वीर्यवान् /
यष्टुं तुरगमेधानां चकार मतिमुत्तमाम् /
अथामन्त्र्यासुरगुरुं दानवांश्चाप्यनुत्तमान् //
text_mt: Hearing that statement of Śukra, the valiant lord of Dānavas / made the supreme resolution to perform horse-sacrifices. / Then, having summoned the teacher of the asuras and the peerless Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
provāca yakṣye 'haṃ yajñairaśvamedhaiḥ sadakṣimaiḥ /
tadāgacchadhvamavanīṃ gacchāmo vasudhādhipān //
meaning:
प्रोवाच यक्ष्ये ऽहं यज्ञैरश्वमेधैः सदक्षिमैः /
तदागच्छध्वमवनीं गच्छामो वसुधाधिपान् //
text_mt: he said: 'I shall sacrifice with horse-sacrifices accompanied by generous gifts. / Therefore, come, let us go to the earth, to the rulers of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vijitya hayamedhān vai yathākāmaguṇanvinatān /
āhūyantāṃ ca nidhayastvājñāpyanātāṃ ca guhyakāḥ //
meaning:
विजित्य हयमेधान् वै यथाकामगुणन्विनतान् /
आहूयन्तां च निधयस्त्वाज्ञाप्यनातां च गुह्यकाः //
text_mt: Having conquered the kings, we shall perform horse-sacrifices endowed with every desired virtue. / Let the Treasures be summoned, and let the Guhyakas be commanded.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantryantāṃ ca ṛṣayaḥ prayāmo devikāṭatam /
sā hi puṇyā saricchreṣṭha sarvasiddhikarī śubhā /
sthānaṃ prācīnamāsādya vājisedhān yajāmahe //
meaning:
आमन्त्र्यन्तां च ऋषयः प्रयामो देविकाटतम् /
सा हि पुण्या सरिच्छ्रेष्ठ सर्वसिद्धिकरी शुभा /
स्थानं प्राचीनमासाद्य वाजिसेधान् यजामहे //
text_mt: Let the sages be invited, and let us go to the bank of the Devikā; / for she is the auspicious, best of rivers, bringer of all accomplishments. / Having reached the eastern site, we shall perform horse-sacrifices.'

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ surārervacanaṃ niśamyāsurayājakaḥ /
bāḍhamityabravīd hṛṣṭo nidhayaḥ saṃdideśa saḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं सुरारेर्वचनं निशम्यासुरयाजकः /
बाढमित्यब्रवीद् हृष्टो निधयः संदिदेश सः //
text_mt: Having heard this speech of the enemy of the gods, the priest of the asuras / said joyfully, 'So be it,' and gave orders to the Treasures.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dhundhurdevikāyāḥ prācīne pāpanāśane /
bhārgavendreṇa śukreṇa vājimedhāya dīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
ततो धुन्धुर्देविकायाः प्राचीने पापनाशने /
भार्गवेन्द्रेण शुक्रेण वाजिमेधाय दीक्षितः //
text_mt: Then Dhundhu was consecrated for the horse-sacrifice by the foremost of the Bhārgavas, Śukra, / at the sin-destroying eastern [bank] of the Devikā.

sanskrit_iast:
sadasyā ṛtvijaścāpi tatrāsan bhārgavā dvijāḥ /
śukrasyānumate brahman śukraśiṣyāśca paṇyitāḥ //
meaning:
सदस्या ऋत्विजश्चापि तत्रासन् भार्गवा द्विजाः /
शुक्रस्यानुमते ब्रह्मन् शुक्रशिष्याश्च पण्यिताः //
text_mt: The members of the sacrificial assembly and the officiating priests there were twice-born Bhārgavas, / with the approval of Śukra, O Brahmin, as well as learned disciples of Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabhāgabhujastatra svarbhānupramukhā mune /
kṛtāścāsuranāthena śukrasyānumate 'surāḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञभागभुजस्तत्र स्वर्भानुप्रमुखा मुने /
कृताश्चासुरनाथेन शुक्रस्यानुमते ऽसुराः //
text_mt: There the asuras, headed by Svarbhānu, were made partakers / of the sacrificial shares, O sage, by the lord of the asuras with the approval of Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravṛtto yajñastu samutsṛṣṭastathā hayaḥ /
hayasyānu yayau śrīmānasilomā mahāsuraḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रवृत्तो यज्ञस्तु समुत्सृष्टस्तथा हयः /
हयस्यानु ययौ श्रीमानसिलोमा महासुरः //
text_mt: Then the sacrifice commenced, and the horse was let loose; / the glorious, great asura Asiloman followed after the horse.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'gnidhūmena mahī saśailā vyāptā diśaḥ khaṃ vidiśaśca pūrṇāḥ /
tenogragandhena divaspṛsena marud vavau brahmaloke maharṣe //
meaning:
ततो ऽग्निधूमेन मही सशैला व्याप्ता दिशः खं विदिशश्च पूर्णाः /
तेनोग्रगन्धेन दिवस्पृसेन मरुद् ववौ ब्रह्मलोके महर्षे //
text_mt: Then the earth, with its mountains, was enveloped in the smoke of the fire, the directions and the sky were covered, and the intermediate quarters filled; / with that pungent, sky-reaching odor, O great sage, the wind blew to Brahmaloka.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ gandhamāghrāya surā viṣaṇṇā jānanta dhundhuṃ hayamedhadīkṣitam /
tataḥ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ janārdhanaṃ jagmuḥ saśakrā jagātaḥ parayaṇam //
meaning:
तं गन्धमाघ्राय सुरा विषण्णा जानन्त धुन्धुं हयमेधदीक्षितम् /
ततः शरण्यं शरणं जनार्धनं जग्मुः सशक्रा जगातः परयणम् //
text_mt: Smelling that odor, the gods were dejected, knowing that Dhundhu was consecrated for a horse sacrifice; / then, headed by Śakra, they went for refuge to Janārdana, the refuge and supreme goal of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya varadaṃ devaṃ padmanābhaṃ janārdanam /
procuḥ sarve suragaṇā bhayagadgadayā girā //
meaning:
प्रणम्य वरदं देवं पद्मनाभं जनार्दनम् /
प्रोचुः सर्वे सुरगणा भयगद्गदया गिरा //
text_mt: Bowing to the boon-granting god, Padmanābha, Janārdana, / all the hosts of gods spoke with voices choked with fear:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan devadeveśa carācaraparāyaṇa /
vijñaptiḥ śrūyatāṃ viṣṇo surāṇāmārtināśana //
meaning:
भगवन् देवदेवेश चराचरपरायण /
विज्ञप्तिः श्रूयतां विष्णो सुराणामार्तिनाशन //
text_mt: “Lord, ruler of the gods of gods, refuge of all moving and unmoving beings, / O Viṣṇu, destroyer of the gods' distress, listen to our petition!

sanskrit_iast:
dhundhurnāmāsurapatirbalavān varabṛṃhitaḥ /
sarvān surān vinirjitya trailokyamahārad baliḥ //
meaning:
धुन्धुर्नामासुरपतिर्बलवान् वरबृंहितः /
सर्वान् सुरान् विनिर्जित्य त्रैलोक्यमहारद् बलिः //
text_mt: The mighty asura king named Dhundhu, strengthened by a boon, / having thoroughly conquered all the gods, has seized the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛte pinākino devāt trāt'smān na yato hare /
ato vivṛddhimagamad yathā vyādhirupekṣitaḥ //
meaning:
ऋते पिनाकिनो देवात् त्रात्ऽस्मान् न यतो हरे /
अतो विवृद्धिमगमद् यथा व्याधिरुपेक्षितः //
text_mt: Since, O Hari, none can protect us except the god who bears the Pināka bow, / he has therefore grown in strength, just as an neglected disease does.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmprataṃ brahmalokasthānapi jetuṃ samudyataḥ /
śukrasya matamāstāya so 'śvamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
साम्प्रतं ब्रह्मलोकस्थानपि जेतुं समुद्यतः /
शुक्रस्य मतमास्ताय सो ऽश्वमेधाय दीक्षितः //
text_mt: Now he is preparing to conquer even the dwellers of Brahmaloka; / following the counsel of Śukra, he has consecrated himself for the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ kratūnāmiṣṭvāsau brahmalokaṃ mahāsuraḥ /
aroḍhumicchati vaśī vijetuṃ tridaśānapi //
meaning:
शतं क्रतूनामिष्ट्वासौ ब्रह्मलोकं महासुरः /
अरोढुमिच्छति वशी विजेतुं त्रिदशानपि //
text_mt: Having performed a hundred sacrifices, this self-controlled great asura / desires to ascend to Brahmaloka and to conquer even the thirty [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādakālahīnaṃ tu cintayasva jagadguro /
uvāyaṃ makhavidhvaṃse yena syāma sunirvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादकालहीनं तु चिन्तयस्व जगद्गुरो /
उवायं मखविध्वंसे येन स्याम सुनिर्वृताः //
text_mt: Therefore, without losing any time, O teacher of the universe, devise / a means for the destruction of the sacrifice, so that we may be at peace.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā surāṇāṃ vacanaṃ bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ /
dattvābhayaṃ mahābāhuḥ preṣayāmāsa sāmpratam /
visṛjya devatāḥ sarvā jñātvājeyaṃ mahāsuram //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सुराणां वचनं भगवान् मधुसूदनः /
दत्त्वाभयं महाबाहुः प्रेषयामास साम्प्रतम् /
विसृज्य देवताः सर्वा ज्ञात्वाजेयं महासुरम् //
text_mt: Hearing the words of the gods, the blessed Madhusūdana, / the mighty-armed one, granted them freedom from fear and sent them away at once. / Having dismissed all the deities, and knowing the great asura to be unconquerable [in direct battle],

sanskrit_iast:
bandhanāya matiṃ cakre dhundhordharmadhvajasya vai /
tataḥ kṛtvā sa bhagavān vāmanaṃ rūpamīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
बन्धनाय मतिं चक्रे धुन्धोर्धर्मध्वजस्य वै /
ततः कृत्वा स भगवान् वामनं रूपमीश्वरः //
text_mt: he resolved upon the binding of Dhundhu, that bearer of virtue's banner. / Then the Lord, the blessed one, assumed the form of Vāmana;

sanskrit_iast:
dehaṃ tyaktvā nirālambaṃ kāṣṭavad devikājale /
kṣaṇānmajjaṃstathonmajjanmuktakeśo yadṛcchayā //
meaning:
देहं त्यक्त्वा निरालम्बं काष्टवद् देविकाजले /
क्षणान्मज्जंस्तथोन्मज्जन्मुक्तकेशो यदृच्छया //
text_mt: leaving his body unsupported like a piece of wood in the waters of the Devikā, / now sinking, now floating up, with his hair disheveled at will,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭo 'tha daityapatinā daityaiścānyaistatharṣibhiḥ /
tataḥ karma parityajya yajñiyaṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ //
meaning:
दृष्टो ऽथ दैत्यपतिना दैत्यैश्चान्यैस्तथर्षिभिः /
ततः कर्म परित्यज्य यज्ञियं ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः //
text_mt: he was seen by the Daitya king, by the other Daityas, and by the sages. / Thereupon, abandoning the sacrificial work, those best of Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
samuttārayituṃ vipramādravanta samākulāḥ /
sadasyā yajamānaśca ṛtvijo 'tha mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
समुत्तारयितुं विप्रमाद्रवन्त समाकुलाः /
सदस्या यजमानश्च ऋत्विजो ऽथ महौजसः //
text_mt: the members of the assembly, the sacrificer, and the sacrificial priests of great splendor / ran in agitation to rescue the Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
nimajjamānamujjahruḥ sarve te vāmanaṃ dvijam /
samuttārya prasannāste papracchuḥ sarva eva hi /
kimarthaṃ patito 'sīha kenākṣipto 'si no vada //
meaning:
निमज्जमानमुज्जह्रुः सर्वे ते वामनं द्विजम् /
समुत्तार्य प्रसन्नास्ते पप्रच्छुः सर्व एव हि /
किमर्थं पतितो ऽसीह केनाक्षिप्तो ऽसि नो वद //
text_mt: They all lifted up the twice-born Vāmana as he was sinking; / having brought him out, pleased, they all asked: / “Why have you fallen here? By whom were you thrown? Tell us!”

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmākarṇya vacanaṃ kampamāno muhurmuhuḥ /
prāha dhundhupurogāṃstāñ chrūyatāmatra kāraṇam //
meaning:
तेषामाकर्ण्य वचनं कम्पमानो मुहुर्मुहुः /
प्राह धुन्धुपुरोगांस्ताञ् छ्रूयतामत्र कारणम् //
text_mt: Hearing their words, trembling again and again, / he spoke to those led by Dhundhu: “Listen to the reason for this:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo guṇavānāsīt prabhāsa iti viśrutaḥ /
sarvasāstrārthavit prājño gotrataś cāpi vāruṇaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो गुणवानासीत् प्रभास इति विश्रुतः /
सर्वसास्त्रार्थवित् प्राज्ञो गोत्रतश् चापि वारुणः //
text_mt: There was a virtuous Brahmin known as Prabhāsa, / who knew the meaning of all śāstras, wise, and of the Vāruṇa lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putradvayaṃ jātaṃ mandaprajñaṃ suduḥkhitam /
tatra jyeṣṭho mama bhrātā kanīyānaparastvaham //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रद्वयं जातं मन्दप्रज्ञं सुदुःखितम् /
तत्र ज्येष्ठो मम भ्राता कनीयानपरस्त्वहम् //
text_mt: Two dull-witted, very miserable sons were born to him; / of them, the elder is my brother, and I am the younger.

sanskrit_iast:
netrabhāsa iti khyāto jyeṣṭho bhrātā mamāsura /
mama nāma pitā cakre gatibhāseti kautukāt //
meaning:
नेत्रभास इति ख्यातो ज्येष्ठो भ्राता ममासुर /
मम नाम पिता चक्रे गतिभासेति कौतुकात् //
text_mt: My elder brother is known as Netrabhāsa, O asura; / in jest, my father gave me the name Gatibhāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
ramyaścāvasatho bandho śubhaścāsīt piturmama /
triviṣṭapaguṇairyuktaścārurūpo mahāsura //
meaning:
रम्यश्चावसथो बन्धो शुभश्चासीत् पितुर्मम /
त्रिविष्टपगुणैर्युक्तश्चारुरूपो महासुर //
text_mt: My father had a pleasant, good, and comfortable dwelling, / endowed with the virtues of heaven and lovely in form, O great asura.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena mahatā āvayoḥ sa pitā mṛtaḥ /
tasyordhvadehikaṃ kṛtvā gṛhamāvāṃ samāgatau //
meaning:
ततः कालेन महता आवयोः स पिता मृतः /
तस्योर्ध्वदेहिकं कृत्वा गृहमावां समागतौ //
text_mt: Then, after a long time, our father died. / Having performed his funeral rites, the two of us returned home.

sanskrit_iast:
tato mayoktaḥ sa bhrātā vibhajāma gṛhaṃ vayam /
tenokto naiva bhavato vidyate bhāgā ityaham //
meaning:
ततो मयोक्तः स भ्राता विभजाम गृहं वयम् /
तेनोक्तो नैव भवतो विद्यते भागा इत्यहम् //
text_mt: Then I said to that brother: ‘Let us divide the house.’ / But he said to me: ‘You have no share at all!

sanskrit_iast:
kubjavāmanakhañjānāṃ klībānāṃ śvitriṇāmapi /
unmattānāṃ tathāndhānāṃ dhanabhāgo na vidyate //
meaning:
कुब्जवामनखञ्जानां क्लीबानां श्वित्रिणामपि /
उन्मत्तानां तथान्धानां धनभागो न विद्यते //
text_mt: For hunchbacks, dwarfs, the lame, eunuchs, and also lepers, / for the insane, and likewise the blind, there is no share of the wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śayyāsanasthānamātraṃ svecchayānnabhujakriyā /
etāvad dīyate tebhyo nārthabhāgaharā hi te //
meaning:
शय्यासनस्थानमात्रं स्वेच्छयान्नभुजक्रिया /
एतावद् दीयते तेभ्यो नार्थभागहरा हि ते //
text_mt: Only a place to lie and sit, and the eating of food according to one’s desire— / just this much is given to them; they do not take a share of the property.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamukte mayā soktaḥ kimarthaṃ paitṛkād gṛhāt /
dhanārthabhāgamarhāmi nāhaṃ nyāyena kena vai //
meaning:
एवमुक्ते मया सोक्तः किमर्थं पैतृकाद् गृहात् /
धनार्थभागमर्हामि नाहं न्यायेन केन वै //
text_mt: When this was said, I said to him: ‘For what reason / do I not deserve a share of the wealth and property from my father's house by any right?’

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktāvati vākye 'sau bhrātā me kopasaṃyutaḥ /
samutkṣipyākṣipannadyāmasyāṃ māmiti kāraṇāt //
meaning:
इत्युक्तावति वाक्ये ऽसौ भ्राता मे कोपसंयुतः /
समुत्क्षिप्याक्षिपन्नद्यामस्यां मामिति कारणात् //
text_mt: As I was saying these words, my brother, filled with anger, / picked me up and threw me into this river for that reason.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāsyāṃ nimnagāyāṃ tu madhyena plavato gataḥ /
kālaḥ saṃvatsarākhyastu yuṣmābhiriha coddhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ममास्यां निम्नगायां तु मध्येन प्लवतो गतः /
कालः संवत्सराख्यस्तु युष्माभिरिह चोद्धृतः //
text_mt: Floating along the middle of this river, / a span of time called a full year has passed for me, and now I have been rescued here by you.

sanskrit_iast:
ke bhavanto 'tra saṃprāptāḥ sasnehā bāndhavā iva /
ko 'yaṃ ca śakrapratimo dīkṣito yo mahābhujaḥ //
meaning:
के भवन्तो ऽत्र संप्राप्ताः सस्नेहा बान्धवा इव /
को ऽयं च शक्रप्रतिमो दीक्षितो यो महाभुजः //
text_mt: Who are you that have arrived here with affection like kinsmen? / And who is this mighty-armed one, equal to Indra, who is consecrated for the sacrifice?

sanskrit_iast:
tanme sarvaṃ samākhyātā yāthātathyaṃ tapodhanāḥ /
maharddhisaṃyutā yūyaṃ sānukampāśca me bhṛśam //
meaning:
तन्मे सर्वं समाख्याता याथातथ्यं तपोधनाः /
महर्द्धिसंयुता यूयं सानुकम्पाश्च मे भृशम् //
text_mt: Tell me all that in truth, O ascetics! / You possess great supernatural power and have shown great compassion toward me.”

sanskrit_iast:
tad vāmanavacaḥ śrutvā bhārgavā dvijasattamāḥ /
procurvaṃ dvijā brahman gotraścāpi bhārgavāḥ //
meaning:
तद् वामनवचः श्रुत्वा भार्गवा द्विजसत्तमाः /
प्रोचुर्वं द्विजा ब्रह्मन् गोत्रश्चापि भार्गवाः //
text_mt: Hearing those words of Vāmana, the Bhārgavas, the best of the twice-born, / said: “We are Brahmins, O holy one, and of the Bhārgava gotra.

sanskrit_iast:
asāvapi mahātejā dhundhurnāma mahāsuraḥ /
dātā bhoktā vibhaktā ca dīkṣito yajñakarmaṇi //
meaning:
असावपि महातेजा धुन्धुर्नाम महासुरः /
दाता भोक्ता विभक्ता च दीक्षितो यज्ञकर्मणि //
text_mt: And this is the great asura named Dhundhu, endowed with great splendor; / a giver, an enjoyer, and a divider, consecrated for the rite of sacrifice.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā deveśaṃ vāmanaṃ bhārgavāstataḥ /
procurdaityapatiṃ sarve vāmanārthakaraṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा देवेशं वामनं भार्गवास्ततः /
प्रोचुर्दैत्यपतिं सर्वे वामनार्थकरं वचः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to Vāmana, the lord of the gods, all the Bhārgavas / then addressed words to the Daitya king that served Vāmana’s purpose:

sanskrit_iast:
dīyatāmasya daityendra sarvopaskarasaṃyutam /
śrīmadāvasathaṃ dāsyo ratnāni vividhāni ca //
meaning:
दीयतामस्य दैत्येन्द्र सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् /
श्रीमदावसथं दास्यो रत्नानि विविधानि च //
text_mt: “O king of Daityas, let there be given to him, equipped with all furnishings, / a splendid dwelling, female slaves, and diverse gems!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti dvijānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā daityapatirvacaḥ /
prāha dvijendra te dadmi yāvadicchasi vai dhanam //
meaning:
इति द्विजानां वचनं श्रुत्वा दैत्यपतिर्वचः /
प्राह द्विजेन्द्र ते दद्मि यावदिच्छसि वै धनम् //
text_mt: Hearing that speech of the Brahmins, the Daitya king said: / “O best of the twice-born, I will give you as much wealth as you desire!

sanskrit_iast:
dāste gṛhaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca vājinaḥ syandanān gajān /
prayacchāmyadya bhavato vriyatāmīpsitaṃ vibho //
meaning:
दास्ते गृहं हिरण्यं च वाजिनः स्यन्दनान् गजान् /
प्रयच्छाम्यद्य भवतो व्रियतामीप्सितं विभो //
text_mt: Houses, gold, horses, chariots, and elephants— / I grant them to you today; choose whatever is desired, O noble one!”

sanskrit_iast:
tadvākyaṃ dānavapateḥ śrutvā devo 'tha vāmanaḥ /
prāhāsurapatiṃ dhundhuṃ svārthasiddhikaraṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
तद्वाक्यं दानवपतेः श्रुत्वा देवो ऽथ वामनः /
प्राहासुरपतिं धुन्धुं स्वार्थसिद्धिकरं वचः //
text_mt: Hearing that statement of the Dānava king, the god Vāmana / then spoke words to Dhundhu, the king of the asuras, that accomplished his own purpose:

sanskrit_iast:
sodareṇāpi hi bhrātrā hriyante yasya saṃpadaḥ /
tasyākṣamasya yaddattaṃ kimanyo na hariṣyati //
meaning:
सोदरेणापि हि भ्रात्रा ह्रियन्ते यस्य संपदः /
तस्याक्षमस्य यद्दत्तं किमन्यो न हरिष्यति //
text_mt: “When even a uterine brother seizes one’s possessions, / who else will not take away what is given to one who is powerless?

sanskrit_iast:
dāsīdāsāṃśca bhṛtyāṃśca gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ paricchadam /
samartheṣu dvijendreṣu prayacchasva mahābhuja //
meaning:
दासीदासांश्च भृत्यांश्च गृहं रत्नं परिच्छदम् /
समर्थेषु द्विजेन्द्रेषु प्रयच्छस्व महाभुज //
text_mt: Female slaves, male slaves, servants, a house, jewels, and clothing— / bestow these upon capable, foremost Brahmins, O mighty-armed one!

sanskrit_iast:
mama pramāṇamālokya māmakaṃ ca padatrayam /
saṃprayacchasva daityendra nādhikaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ //
meaning:
मम प्रमाणमालोक्य मामकं च पदत्रयम् /
संप्रयच्छस्व दैत्येन्द्र नाधिकं रक्षितुं क्षमः //
text_mt: Looking at my measure, grant me three paces / of my own; I am not able to protect any more, O king of Daityas!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukte vacane mahātmanā vihasya daityādhipatiḥ saṛtvijaḥ /
prādād dvijendrāya padatrayaṃ tadā yadā sa nānyaṃ pragṛhāṇa kiñcit //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने महात्मना विहस्य दैत्याधिपतिः सऋत्विजः /
प्रादाद् द्विजेन्द्राय पदत्रयं तदा यदा स नान्यं प्रगृहाण किञ्चित् //
text_mt: When these words were spoken by the great-souled one, the king of the Daityas, along with his priests, laughed / and granted the three paces to the foremost Brahmin, when he would accept nothing else.

sanskrit_iast:
kramatrayaṃ tāvadavekṣya dattaṃ mahāsurendreṇa vibhuryaśasvī /
cakre tato laṅghayituṃ trivikramaṃ rūpamanantaśaktiḥ //
meaning:
क्रमत्रयं तावदवेक्ष्य दत्तं महासुरेन्द्रेण विभुर्यशस्वी /
चक्रे ततो लङ्घयितुं त्रिविक्रमं रूपमनन्तशक्तिः //
text_mt: Seeing the three steps given by the great king of the asuras, the renowned, all-pervading lord / of infinite power then assumed the Trivikrama form in order to stride across.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā ca rūpaṃ ditijāṃśca hatvā praṇamya carṣin prathamakrameṇa /
mahīṃ mahīdhraiḥ sahitāṃ sahārmavāṃ jahāra ratnākarapattanairyutām //
meaning:
कृत्वा च रूपं दितिजांश्च हत्वा प्रणम्य चर्षिन् प्रथमक्रमेण /
महीं महीध्रैः सहितां सहार्मवां जहार रत्नाकरपत्तनैर्युताम् //
text_mt: Assuming that form, slaying the sons of Diti, and bowing to the sages, with his first step / he took the earth, along with its mountains and oceans, filled with jewel-mines and cities.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaṃ sanākaṃ tridasādhivāsaṃ somārkaṛkṣair abhimaṇḍitaṃ nabhaḥ /
devo dvitīyena jahāra vegāt krameṇa devapriyamīpsurīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
भुवं सनाकं त्रिदसाधिवासं सोमार्कऋक्षैर् अभिमण्डितं नभः /
देवो द्वितीयेन जहार वेगात् क्रमेण देवप्रियमीप्सुरीश्वरः //
text_mt: The god, the lord, eager to do what was pleasing to the gods, swiftly seized with his second step / the sky along with heaven, the abode of the thirty [gods], adorned with the moon, sun, and stars.

sanskrit_iast:
kramaṃ tṛtīyaṃ na yadāsya pūritaṃ tadātikopād danupuṅgavasya /
papāta pṛṣṭhe bhagavāṃstrivikramo merupramāṇena tu vigraheṇa //
meaning:
क्रमं तृतीयं न यदास्य पूरितं तदातिकोपाद् दनुपुङ्गवस्य /
पपात पृष्ठे भगवांस्त्रिविक्रमो मेरुप्रमाणेन तु विग्रहेण //
text_mt: When his third step could not be fulfilled, the blessed Trivikrama, / out of great anger toward the foremost Dānava, fell upon his back with a body the size of Mount Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
patatā vāsudevena dānavopari nārada /
triṃśadyojanasāhasrī bhūmergartā dṛḍhīkṛtā //
meaning:
पतता वासुदेवेन दानवोपरि नारद /
त्रिंशद्योजनसाहस्री भूमेर्गर्ता दृढीकृता //
text_mt: As Vāsudeva fell upon the Dānava, O Nārada, / a pit of thirty thousand yojanas in depth was made firm in the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tato daityaṃ samutpāṭya tasyāṃ prakṣipya vegataḥ /
avarṣat sikatāvṛṣṭyā tāṃ gartāmapūrayata //
meaning:
ततो दैत्यं समुत्पाट्य तस्यां प्रक्षिप्य वेगतः /
अवर्षत् सिकतावृष्ट्या तां गर्तामपूरयत //
text_mt: Then, violently uprooting the Daitya and casting him into it, / he rained down a shower of sand and filled up that pit.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svargaṃ sahasrākṣo vāsudevaprasādataḥ /
surāśca sarve trailokyamavāpurnirupadravāḥ //
meaning:
ततः स्वर्गं सहस्राक्षो वासुदेवप्रसादतः /
सुराश्च सर्वे त्रैलोक्यमवापुर्निरुपद्रवाः //
text_mt: Then the thousand-eyed Indra, through the grace of Vāsudeva, / and all the gods regained the three worlds, free from affliction.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānapi daityendraṃ pa3kṣipya sikatārṇave /
kālindya rūpamādhāya tatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
भगवानपि दैत्येन्द्रं प3क्षिप्य सिकतार्णवे /
कालिन्द्य रूपमाधाय तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: The Lord, too, casting the lord of Daityas into the ocean of sand / and assuming the form of the Kālindī, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ purā viṣṇurabhūcca vāmano dhundhuṃ vijetuṃ ca trivikramo 'bhūt /
yasmin sa daityendrasuto jagāma mahāśrame puṇyayuto maharṣe //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe dvipañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं पुरा विष्णुरभूच्च वामनो धुन्धुं विजेतुं च त्रिविक्रमो ऽभूत् /
यस्मिन् स दैत्येन्द्रसुतो जगाम महाश्रमे पुण्ययुतो महर्षे //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे द्विपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus of old Viṣṇu became Vāmana, and Trivikrama in order to conquer Dhundhu, / when that son of the Daitya lord went, endowed with merit, to the great hermitage, O great sage.

Thus ends the fifty-second chapter in the glorious Vāmanapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
kālindīsalile snātvā pūjayitvā trivikramam /
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ liṅgabhedaṃ giriṃ yayau //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
कालिन्दीसलिले स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा त्रिविक्रमम् /
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां लिङ्गभेदं गिरिं ययौ //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Having bathed in the water of the Kālindī and worshipped Trivikrama, / having fasted for one night, he went to the Liṅgabheda mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca vimale bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bhaktitaḥ /
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ tīrthaṃ kedāramāvrajat //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च विमले भवं दृष्ट्वा च भक्तितः /
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां तीर्थं केदारमाव्रजत् //
text_mt: And having bathed there in the pure [water] and seen Bhava with devotion, / having fasted for one night, he proceeded to Kedāra tīrtha.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvār'cya ceśānaṃ mādhavaṃ cāpyabhedataḥ /
uṣitvā vāsarān sapta kubjāmraṃ prajagāma ha //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वार्ऽच्य चेशानं माधवं चाप्यभेदतः /
उषित्वा वासरान् सप्त कुब्जाम्रं प्रजगाम ह //
text_mt: Having bathed there and worshipped Īśāna and Mādhava without seeing any difference [between them], / and having stayed for seven days, he went to Kubjāmra.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ sutīrthe snātvā ca sopavāsī jitendriyaḥ. hṛṣīkeśaṃ samabhyarcya yayau badarikāśramam //
meaning: ततः सुतीर्थे स्नात्वा च सोपवासी जितेन्द्रियः. हृषीकेशं समभ्यर्च्य ययौ बदरिकाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Then, having bathed at the excellent tīrtha, fasting and self-controlled, / he worshipped Hṛṣīkeśa and went to Badarikāśrama.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣya nārāyaṇamarcya bhaktyā snātvātha vidvān sa sarasvatījale /
varāhatīrthe garuḍāsanaṃ sa dṛṣṭvātha saṃpūjya subhaktimāṃśca //
meaning:
तत्रोष्य नारायणमर्च्य भक्त्या स्नात्वाथ विद्वान् स सरस्वतीजले /
वराहतीर्थे गरुडासनं स दृष्ट्वाथ संपूज्य सुभक्तिमांश्च //
text_mt: Staying there, having worshipped Nārāyaṇa with devotion and then, wise, having bathed in the waters of the Sarasvatī, / having seen the One whose seat is Garuḍa at the Varāhatīrtha, he worshipped [him] with great devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrakarṇe tato gatvā jayeśaṃ śaśiśekharam /
dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya ca śivaṃ vipāśāmabhito yayau //
meaning:
भद्रकर्णे ततो गत्वा जयेशं शशिशेखरम् /
दृष्ट्वा संपूज्य च शिवं विपाशामभितो ययौ //
text_mt: Then, having gone to Bhadrakarṇa, having seen Jayeśa, the moon-crested / Śiva, and worshipped him, he went towards the Vipāśā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ snātvā samabhyarcya devadevaṃ dvijapriyam /
upavāsī irāvatyāṃ dadarśa parameśvaram //
meaning:
तस्यां स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य देवदेवं द्विजप्रियम् /
उपवासी इरावत्यां ददर्श परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Having bathed in it and worshipped the god of gods, who loves the twice-born, / fasting on the Irāvatī, he beheld the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
yamārādhya dvijaśreṣṭha śākale vai purūravāḥ /
samavāpa paraṃ rūpamaiśvarya ca sudurlabham //
meaning:
यमाराध्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ शाकले वै पुरूरवाः /
समवाप परं रूपमैश्वर्य च सुदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: by worshipping whom, O best of the twice-born, Purūravas in Śākala / attained supreme beauty and sovereignty very difficult to obtain;

sanskrit_iast:
kuṣṭharogābhibhūtaśca yaṃ samārāghya vai bhṛguḥ /
ārogyamatulaṃ prāpa saṃtānamapi cākṣayam //
meaning:
कुष्ठरोगाभिभूतश्च यं समाराघ्य वै भृगुः /
आरोग्यमतुलं प्राप संतानमपि चाक्षयम् //
text_mt: and by thoroughly worshipping whom, Bhṛgu, afflicted with leprosy, / attained matchless health and imperishable progeny as well.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca /
kathaṃ purūravā viṣṇumārāghya dvijasattama /
virūpatvaṃ samutsṛjya rūpaṃ prāpa śriyā saha //
meaning:
नारद उवाच /
कथं पुरूरवा विष्णुमाराघ्य द्विजसत्तम /
विरूपत्वं समुत्सृज्य रूपं प्राप श्रिया सह //
text_mt: Nārada said: / How did Purūravas, having worshipped Viṣṇu, O best of Brahmins, / cast off his deformity and obtain beauty together with prosperity?

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpupraṇāśinīm /
pūrvaṃ tretāyugasyādau yathāvṛttaṃ tapodhana //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
श्रूयतां कथयिष्यामि कथां पापुप्रणाशिनीम् /
पूर्वं त्रेतायुगस्यादौ यथावृत्तं तपोधन //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Listen, I will tell the story that destroys sins, / as it happened of old, at the beginning of the Tretā age, O one rich in austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
madradeśa iti khyāto deśo vai brahmaṇaḥ suta /
śākalaṃ nāma nagaraṃ khyātaṃ sthānīyamuttamam //
meaning:
मद्रदेश इति ख्यातो देशो वै ब्रह्मणः सुत /
शाकलं नाम नगरं ख्यातं स्थानीयमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: There is a country known as the Madra country, O son of Brahmā; / a city named Śākala, known as an excellent capital city.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin vipaṇivṛttisthaḥ sudharmākhyo 'bhavad vaṇik /
dhanāḍhyo guṇavān bhogī nānāsāstraviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन् विपणिवृत्तिस्थः सुधर्माख्यो ऽभवद् वणिक् /
धनाढ्यो गुणवान् भोगी नानासास्त्रविशारदः //
text_mt: In it there was a merchant named Sudharman engaged in the business of the marketplace, / wealthy, virtuous, enjoying pleasures, and skilled in various treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvekadā nijād rāṣṭrāt surāṣṭraṃ gantumadyataḥ /
sārthena mahatā yukto nānāvipaṇapaṇyavān //
meaning:
स त्वेकदा निजाद् राष्ट्रात् सुराष्ट्रं गन्तुमद्यतः /
सार्थेन महता युक्तो नानाविपणपण्यवान् //
text_mt: Once he prepared to go from his own kingdom to Surāṣṭra, / accompanied by a large caravan, carrying commodities for various markets.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchataḥ pathi tasyātha marubhūmau kalipriya /
abhavad dasyuto rātrau avaskando 'tiduḥsahaḥ //
meaning:
गच्छतः पथि तस्याथ मरुभूमौ कलिप्रिय /
अभवद् दस्युतो रात्रौ अवस्कन्दो ऽतिदुःसहः //
text_mt: As he was traveling on the road in the desert, O fond of strife, / a very unbearable night attack by bandits took place.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa hṛtasarvasvo vaṇig guḥkhasamanvitaḥ /
asahāyo marau tasmiṃś cacāronmattavad vaśī //
meaning:
ततः स हृतसर्वस्वो वणिग् गुःखसमन्वितः /
असहायो मरौ तस्मिंश् चचारोन्मत्तवद् वशी //
text_mt: Then that merchant, his all stolen, accompanied by sorrow, / helpless, wandered in that desert like a madman, though self-controlled.

sanskrit_iast:
caratā tadaraṇyaṃ vai duḥkhākrāntena nārada /
ātmā iva śamīvṛkṣo marāvāsāditaḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
चरता तदरण्यं वै दुःखाक्रान्तेन नारद /
आत्मा इव शमीवृक्षो मरावासादितः शुभः //
text_mt: As he wandered through that wilderness overcome by grief, O Nārada, / a solitary, auspicious śamī tree was reached in the desert.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ mṛgauḥ pikṣikṣiścaiva hīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā śamītarum / śrāntaḥ kṣuttṛṭparītātmā tasyādhaḥ samupāviśat //
meaning: तं मृगौः पिक्षिक्षिश्चैव हीनं दृष्ट्वा शमीतरुम् / श्रान्तः क्षुत्तृट्परीतात्मा तस्याधः समुपाविशत् //
text_mt: Seeing that śamī tree devoid of beasts and birds, / exhausted, overcome by hunger and thirst, he sat down beneath it.

sanskrit_iast:
suptaścāpi suviśrānto madhyāhne punarutyitaḥ /
samapaśyadathāyāntaṃ pretaṃ pretaśatairvṛtam //
meaning:
सुप्तश्चापि सुविश्रान्तो मध्याह्ने पुनरुत्यितः /
समपश्यदथायान्तं प्रेतं प्रेतशतैर्वृतम् //
text_mt: Having fallen asleep and rested well, he got up again at midday; / then he saw a ghost approaching, surrounded by hundreds of ghosts,

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhyantamathānyena pretena pretanāyakam /
piṇḍāśibhiśca purato dhāvadbhī rūkṣavigrahaiḥ //
meaning:
उद्वाह्यन्तमथान्येन प्रेतेन प्रेतनायकम् /
पिण्डाशिभिश्च पुरतो धावद्भी रूक्षविग्रहैः //
text_mt: the leader of the ghosts being carried aloft by another ghost, / with rough-bodied [ghosts] that feed on funerary offerings running ahead.

sanskrit_iast:
athājagāma preto 'sau paryaṭitvā vanāni ca /
upāgamya śamīmūle vaṇikputraṃ dadarśa saḥ //
meaning:
अथाजगाम प्रेतो ऽसौ पर्यटित्वा वनानि च /
उपागम्य शमीमूले वणिक्पुत्रं ददर्श सः //
text_mt: Then that ghost arrived after wandering through the forests, / and approaching the foot of the śamī tree, he saw the merchant's son.

sanskrit_iast:
svāgatenābhivādyainaṃ samābhāṣya parasparam /
sukhopaviṣṭaśchāyāyāṃ pṛṣṭvā kuśalamāptavān //
meaning:
स्वागतेनाभिवाद्यैनं समाभाष्य परस्परम् /
सुखोपविष्टश्छायायां पृष्ट्वा कुशलमाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Greeting him with a welcome and conversing with one another, / comfortably seated in the shade, he inquired after his well-being.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pretādhipatinā pṛṣṭaḥ sa tu vaṇiksakhaḥ /
kuta āgamyate brūhi kva sādho vā gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
ततः प्रेताधिपतिना पृष्टः स तु वणिक्सखः /
कुत आगम्यते ब्रूहि क्व साधो वा गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: Then, questioned by the lord of the ghosts, that merchant's friend [was asked]: / "From where have you come, tell [me]; or where will you go, O virtuous one?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ cedaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ mṛgapakṣivivarjitam /
samāpanno 'si bhadraṃ te sarvamākhyātumarhasi //
meaning:
कथं चेदं महारण्यं मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् /
समापन्नो ऽसि भद्रं ते सर्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि //
text_mt: And how have you arrived in this great wilderness devoid of beasts and birds? / May good betide you; you ought to tell everything."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pretādhipatinā vaṇik pṛṣṭaḥ samāsataḥ /
sarvamākhyātavān brahman svadeśadhanavicyutim //
meaning:
एवं प्रेताधिपतिना वणिक् पृष्टः समासतः /
सर्वमाख्यातवान् ब्रह्मन् स्वदेशधनविच्युतिम् //
text_mt: Thus questioned in brief by the lord of the ghosts, / the merchant related everything, O Brahmin: the loss of his country and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya śrutvā sa vṛttāntaṃ tasya duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ /
vamikputraṃ tataḥ prāha pretapālaḥ svabandhuvat //
meaning:
तस्य श्रुत्वा स वृत्तान्तं तस्य दुःखेन दुःखितः /
वमिक्पुत्रं ततः प्राह प्रेतपालः स्वबन्धुवत् //
text_mt: Hearing his account, grieved by his sorrow, / the guardian of the ghosts then spoke to the merchant's son like his own kinsman:

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gate 'pi mā śokaṃ kartumarhasi suvrata /
bhūyo 'pyarthāḥ bhaviṣyanti yadi bhāgyabalaṃ tava //
meaning:
एवं गते ऽपि मा शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत /
भूयो ऽप्यर्थाः भविष्यन्ति यदि भाग्यबलं तव //
text_mt: "Though this has happened, you should not grieve, O one of good vows; / wealth will come again if you have the power of good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgyakṣayer'thāḥ kṣīyante bhavantyabhyudaye punaḥ /
kṣīṇasyāsya śarīrasya cintayā nodayo bhavet //
meaning:
भाग्यक्षयेर्ऽथाः क्षीयन्ते भवन्त्यभ्युदये पुनः /
क्षीणस्यास्य शरीरस्य चिन्तया नोदयो भवेत् //
text_mt: When fortune wanes, riches dwindle; they come again when prosperity arises; / through anxiety there can be no revitalization of this wasted body."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccārya samāhūya svān bhṛtyān vākyamabravīt /
adyātithirayaṃ pūjyaḥ sadaiva svajano mama //
meaning:
इत्युच्चार्य समाहूय स्वान् भृत्यान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
अद्यातिथिरयं पूज्यः सदैव स्वजनो मम //
text_mt: Having said this, he summoned his servants and spoke these words: / "Today this guest is to be honored; he is always my own kinsman.

sanskrit_iast: asmin samāgate pretāḥ prītirjātā mamātulā //
meaning: अस्मिन् समागते प्रेताः प्रीतिर्जाता ममातुला //
text_mt: Now that he has arrived, O ghosts, matchless joy has arisen in me."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi vadatastasya mṛtpātraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam /
dadhyodanena saṃpūrṇamājagāma yathepsitam //
meaning:
एवं हि वदतस्तस्य मृत्पात्रं सुदृढं नवम् /
दध्योदनेन संपूर्णमाजगाम यथेप्सितम् //
text_mt: Even as he was speaking thus, a firm, new earthen vessel, / filled with curd-rice, appeared as desired.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā navā ca sudṛḍhā saṃpūrṇā paramāmbhasā /
vāridhānī ca saṃprāptā pretānāmagrataḥ sthitā //
meaning:
तथा नवा च सुदृढा संपूर्णा परमाम्भसा /
वारिधानी च संप्राप्ता प्रेतानामग्रतः स्थिता //
text_mt: Likewise, a new, firm water pot filled with excellent water / arrived and stood before the ghosts.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ sasalilamannaṃ vīkṣya mahāmatiḥ /
prāhottiṣṭha vaṇikputra tvamāhnikamupācara //
meaning:
तमागतं ससलिलमन्नं वीक्ष्य महामतिः /
प्राहोत्तिष्ठ वणिक्पुत्र त्वमाह्निकमुपाचर //
text_mt: Seeing that food arrived along with water, the intelligent one / said: "Rise, O son of a merchant, perform your daily rites."

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu vāridhānyāstau salilena vidhānataḥ /
kṛtāhnikāvubhau jātau vaṇik pretapatistathā //
meaning:
ततस्तु वारिधान्यास्तौ सलिलेन विधानतः /
कृताह्निकावुभौ जातौ वणिक् प्रेतपतिस्तथा //
text_mt: Then both of them, with water from the water pot according to the rule, / performed their daily rites—both the merchant and the lord of the ghosts.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vaṇiksutāyādau dadhyodanamathecchayā /
dattvā tebhyaśca sarvebhyaḥ pretebhyo vyadadāt tataḥ //
meaning:
ततो वणिक्सुतायादौ दध्योदनमथेच्छया /
दत्त्वा तेभ्यश्च सर्वेभ्यः प्रेतेभ्यो व्यददात् ततः //
text_mt: Then, having first given curd-rice to the merchant's son according to his wish, / he then distributed it to all those ghosts.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktavatsu ca sarveṣu kāmato 'mbhasi sevite /
anantaraṃ sabubhuje pretapālo barāśanam //
meaning:
भुक्तवत्सु च सर्वेषु कामतो ऽम्भसि सेविते /
अनन्तरं सबुभुजे प्रेतपालो बराशनम् //
text_mt: And when all had eaten and drunk water to their desire, / thereafter the guardian of the ghosts enjoyed the excellent food.

sanskrit_iast:
prakāmatṛpte preta ca vāridhānyodanaṃ tathā /
antardhānamagād brahman vaṇikputrasya paśyataḥ //
meaning:
प्रकामतृप्ते प्रेत च वारिधान्योदनं तथा /
अन्तर्धानमगाद् ब्रह्मन् वणिक्पुत्रस्य पश्यतः //
text_mt: When the ghost was satisfied to his desire, the water pot and the rice / vanished, O Brahmin, while the merchant's son looked on.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastadadbhutatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa matimān vaṇik /
papraccha taṃ pretapālaṃ kautūhalamanā vaśī //
meaning:
ततस्तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा स मतिमान् वणिक् /
पप्रच्छ तं प्रेतपालं कौतूहलमना वशी //
text_mt: Then, seeing that most wondrous marvel, the wise merchant, / his mind filled with curiosity, self-controlled, asked that guardian of the ghosts:

sanskrit_iast:
araṇye nirjane sādho kuto 'nnasya samudbhavaḥ /
kutaśca vāridhānīyaṃ saṃpūrṇā paramāmbhasā //
meaning:
अरण्ये निर्जने साधो कुतो ऽन्नस्य समुद्भवः /
कुतश्च वारिधानीयं संपूर्णा परमाम्भसा //
text_mt: "In this uninhabited wilderness, O good one, whence did the food arise? / And whence this water pot filled with excellent water?

sanskrit_iast:
tathāmī tava ye bhṛtyāstvattaste varmataḥ kṛśāḥ /
bhavānapi ca tejasvī kiñcitpuṣṭavapuḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
तथामी तव ये भृत्यास्त्वत्तस्ते वर्मतः कृशाः /
भवानपि च तेजस्वी किञ्चित्पुष्टवपुः शुभः //
text_mt: Moreover, these servants of yours are emaciated in body compared to you, / while you are radiant, with a somewhat well-nourished, handsome body,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklavastraparīdhāno bahūnāṃ paripālakaḥ /
sarvametanmamācakṣva ko bhavān kā śamī tviyam //
meaning:
शुक्लवस्त्रपरीधानो बहूनां परिपालकः /
सर्वमेतन्ममाचक्ष्व को भवान् का शमी त्वियम् //
text_mt: wearing white garments, the protector of many; / explain all this to me: who are you, and what is this śamī tree?"

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vaṇiksutavacaḥ śrutvāsau pretanāyakaḥ /
śaśaṃsa sarvamasyādyaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam //
meaning:
इत्थं वणिक्सुतवचः श्रुत्वासौ प्रेतनायकः /
शशंस सर्वमस्याद्यं यथावृत्तं पुरातनम् //
text_mt: Hearing these words of the merchant's son, that leader of the pretas / related all his former condition, as it had happened long ago:

sanskrit_iast:
ahamāsaṃ purā vipraḥ śākale nagarottame /
somaśarmeti vikhyāto bahulāgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
अहमासं पुरा विप्रः शाकले नगरोत्तमे /
सोमशर्मेति विख्यातो बहुलागर्भसंभवः //
text_mt: "Formerly, I was a Brahmin in the excellent city of Śākala, / well known as Somaśarman, born from the womb of Bahulā.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāsti ca vaṇik śrīmān prāti veśyo mahādhanaḥ /
sa tu somaśravā nāma viṣṇubhakto mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
ममास्ति च वणिक् श्रीमान् प्राति वेश्यो महाधनः /
स तु सोमश्रवा नाम विष्णुभक्तो महायशाः //
text_mt: And I had a prosperous neighbor, a very wealthy merchant; / he was named Somaśravas, a devoted worshipper of Viṣṇu, and of great renown.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ kadaryo mūḍhātmā dhane 'pi sati durmatiḥ /
na dadāmi dvijātibhyo na cāśnāmyannamuttamam //
meaning:
सो ऽहं कदर्यो मूढात्मा धने ऽपि सति दुर्मतिः /
न ददामि द्विजातिभ्यो न चाश्नाम्यन्नमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: That [same] I was a miser, foolish-minded, wicked in thought despite having wealth; / I gave nothing to the twice-born, nor did I eat fine food.

sanskrit_iast:
pramādād yadi bhuñjāmi dadhikṣīraghṛtānvitam /
tato rātrau nṛbhir ghoraistāḍyate mama vigrahaḥ //
meaning:
प्रमादाद् यदि भुञ्जामि दधिक्षीरघृतान्वितम् /
ततो रात्रौ नृभिर् घोरैस्ताड्यते मम विग्रहः //
text_mt: If by mistake I ate [anything] prepared with yogurt, milk, or ghee, / then at night my body would be beaten by terrible men.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarbhavati me ghorā mṛtyutulyā viṣūcikā /
na ca kaścinmābhyāse tatra tiṣṭhati bāndhavaḥ //
meaning:
प्रातर्भवति मे घोरा मृत्युतुल्या विषूचिका /
न च कश्चिन्माभ्यासे तत्र तिष्ठति बान्धवः //
text_mt: In the morning, a dreadful cholera resembling death would come upon me, / and no kinsman whatsoever would stay near me there.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ kathamapi prāṇā mayā saṃpratidhāritāḥ /
evametādṛśaḥ pāpī nivasāmyatinirghṛṇaḥ //
meaning:
कथं कथमपि प्राणा मया संप्रतिधारिताः /
एवमेतादृशः पापी निवसाम्यतिनिर्घृणः //
text_mt: Somehow or other I kept my life-breaths alive; / thus, being so sinful and utterly pitiless, I lived.

sanskrit_iast:
sauvīratilapiṇyākasaktuśākādibhonaiḥ /
kṣapayāmi kadannādyairātmānaṃ kālayāpanaiḥ //
meaning:
सौवीरतिलपिण्याकसक्तुशाकादिभोनैः /
क्षपयामि कदन्नाद्यैरात्मानं कालयापनैः //
text_mt: Consuming bad food and such to pass the time— / eating fermented barley-water, sesame oil-cake, barley groats, herbs, and the like—I wasted myself away.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tatrāsato mahyaṃ mahān kālo 'bhyagādatha /
śravaṇadvādaśī nāma māsi bhādrapade 'bhavat //
meaning:
एवं तत्रासतो मह्यं महान् कालो ऽभ्यगादथ /
श्रवणद्वादशी नाम मासि भाद्रपदे ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Then, as I lived there in this manner, a long time passed; / and the Śravaṇadvādaśī occurred in the month of Bhādrapada.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nāgariko loko gataḥ snātuṃ hi saṃgamam /
irāvatyā naḍvalāyā brahmakṣatrapurassaraḥ //
meaning:
ततो नागरिको लोको गतः स्नातुं हि संगमम् /
इरावत्या नड्वलाया ब्रह्मक्षत्रपुरस्सरः //
text_mt: Then the townsfolk went to bathe at the confluence / of the Irāvatī and the Naḍvalā, led by Brahmins and Kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
prātiveśyaprasaṃgena tatrāpyanugato 'smyaham /
kṛtopavāsaḥ śucimānekādaśyāṃ yatavrataḥ //
meaning:
प्रातिवेश्यप्रसंगेन तत्राप्यनुगतो ऽस्म्यहम् /
कृतोपवासः शुचिमानेकादश्यां यतव्रतः //
text_mt: In company with my neighbor, I too followed along there; / having fasted, being pure and restraining my vows on the eleventh day,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃgamatoyena vāridhānīṃ dṛḍhāṃ navām /
saṃpūrṇāṃ vastusaṃvītāṃ chatropānahasaṃyutām //
meaning:
ततः संगमतोयेन वारिधानीं दृढां नवाम् /
संपूर्णां वस्तुसंवीतां छत्रोपानहसंयुताम् //
text_mt: then with the water of the confluence, a firm, new water-jar, / filled to the brim, wrapped in cloth, accompanied by an umbrella and a pair of sandals,

sanskrit_iast:
sṛtpātramapi miṣṭasya pūrṇaṃ dadhyodanasya ha /
pradattaṃ brāhmaṇendrāya śucaye jñānadharmiṇe //
meaning:
सृत्पात्रमपि मिष्टस्य पूर्णं दध्योदनस्य ह /
प्रदत्तं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राय शुचये ज्ञानधर्मिणे //
text_mt: as well as an earthen vessel filled with sweet curd-rice, / was given to an excellent Brahmin who was pure and practiced knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva jīvatā dattaṃ mayā dānaṃ vaṇiksuta /
varṣāṇāṃ saptatīnāṃ vai nānyad dattaṃ hi kiñcana //
meaning:
तदेव जीवता दत्तं मया दानं वणिक्सुत /
वर्षाणां सप्ततीनां वै नान्यद् दत्तं हि किञ्चन //
text_mt: That alone was the gift given by me during my life, O merchant's son; / indeed, throughout seventy years nothing else whatsoever was given.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtaḥ pretatvamāpanno dattvā pretānnameva hi /
amī cādattadānāstu madannenopajīvinaḥ //
meaning:
मृतः प्रेतत्वमापन्नो दत्त्वा प्रेतान्नमेव हि /
अमी चादत्तदानास्तु मदन्नेनोपजीविनः //
text_mt: Having died, I arrived at the state of a preta, having given only food for a preta; / and these [beings here], having given no gifts, subsist upon my food.

sanskrit_iast:
etate kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ yattadannaṃ mayāmbhasā /
dattaṃ tadidamāyāti madhyāhne 'pi dine dine //
meaning:
एतते कारणं प्रोक्तं यत्तदन्नं मयाम्भसा /
दत्तं तदिदमायाति मध्याह्ने ऽपि दिने दिने //
text_mt: This is told to you as the reason that the food along with water / which was given by me arrives here day after day, even at midday.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannāhaṃ ca bhuñjāmi na tāvat kṣayameti vai /
mayi bhukte ca pīte ca sarvamantarhitaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
यावन्नाहं च भुञ्जामि न तावत् क्षयमेति वै /
मयि भुक्ते च पीते च सर्वमन्तर्हितं भवेत् //
text_mt: As long as I have not eaten, so long indeed does it not diminish; / but once I have eaten and drunk, everything disappears.

sanskrit_iast:
yaccātapatramadadaṃ so 'yaṃ jātaḥ śamītaruḥ /
uvānadyugale datte preto me vāhano 'bhavat //
meaning:
यच्चातपत्रमददं सो ऽयं जातः शमीतरुः /
उवानद्युगले दत्ते प्रेतो मे वाहनो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: And the parasol that I gave has become this śamī tree; / since a pair of shoes was given, a preta became my mount.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ tovaktā dharmajña mayā kīnāśatātmanaḥ /
śravaṇadvādaśīpuṇyaṃ tavokyaṃ puṇayavardharam //
meaning:
इयं तोवक्ता धर्मज्ञ मया कीनाशतात्मनः /
श्रवणद्वादशीपुण्यं तवोक्यं पुणयवर्धरम् //
text_mt: This miserliness of my own has been told to you, O knower of righteousness; / and the merit of Śravaṇadvādaśī, which increases virtue, has been told to you.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukte vacane vaṇikputro 'bravīd vacaḥ /
yanmayā tāta karttavyaṃ tadanujñātumarhasi //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने वणिक्पुत्रो ऽब्रवीद् वचः /
यन्मया तात कर्त्तव्यं तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि //
text_mt: When these words had thus been spoken, the merchant's son said these words: / 'Whatever ought to be done by me, O father, you should please instruct.'

sanskrit_iast:
tat tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vaṇikputrasya nārada /
pretapālo vacaḥ prāha svārthasiddhikaraṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
तत् तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा वणिक्पुत्रस्य नारद /
प्रेतपालो वचः प्राह स्वार्थसिद्धिकरं ततः //
text_mt: Hearing that speech of the merchant's son, O Nārada, / the protector of pretas then spoke words that would accomplish his own goal:

sanskrit_iast:
yat tvayā tāta karttavyaṃ maddhitārthaṃ mahāmate /
kathayiṣyāmi tat samyak tava śreyaskaraṃ mama //
meaning:
यत् त्वया तात कर्त्तव्यं मद्धितार्थं महामते /
कथयिष्यामि तत् सम्यक् तव श्रेयस्करं मम //
text_mt: 'What ought to be done by you for my benefit, O noble-minded one, / that I shall fully explain, which will bring welfare to you and to me.

sanskrit_iast:
gayāyāṃ tīrthajuṣṭāyāṃ snātvā śaucasamanvitaḥ /
mama nāma samuddiśya piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuru //
meaning:
गयायां तीर्थजुष्टायां स्नात्वा शौचसमन्वितः /
मम नाम समुद्दिश्य पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुरु //
text_mt: Having bathed at Gayā, frequented by tīrthas, endowed with purity, / perform the offering of piṇḍas dedicating it to my name.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra piṇḍapradānena pretabhāvādahaṃ sakhe /
muktastu sarvadātṛṇāṃ yāsyāmi sahalokatām //
meaning:
तत्र पिण्डप्रदानेन प्रेतभावादहं सखे /
मुक्तस्तु सर्वदातृणां यास्यामि सहलोकताम् //
text_mt: By the offering of the piṇḍa there, O friend, freed from the state of a preta, / I shall go to the common world of all givers.

sanskrit_iast:
yatheyaṃ dvādaśī puṇyā māsi prauṣṭhapade sitā /
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā sātiśreyaskarī smṛtā //
meaning:
यथेयं द्वादशी पुण्या मासि प्रौष्ठपदे सिता /
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता सातिश्रेयस्करी स्मृता //
text_mt: Since this auspicious twelfth day in the bright [half] of the month of Prauṣṭhapada, / conjoined with Wednesday and the Śravaṇa [nakṣatra], is remembered as bringing supreme welfare.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā vaṇijaṃ pretarājo 'nugaiḥ saha /
svanāmāni yathānyāyaṃ samyagākhyātavāñchuciḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वणिजं प्रेतराजो ऽनुगैः सह /
स्वनामानि यथान्यायं सम्यगाख्यातवाञ्छुचिः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to the merchant, the king of pretas along with his followers / duly declared their own names, being pure.

sanskrit_iast:
pretaskandhe samāropya tyājito marumaṇḍalam /
ramye 'tha śūrasenākhye deśe prāptaḥ sa vai vaṇik //
meaning:
प्रेतस्कन्धे समारोप्य त्याजितो मरुमण्डलम् /
रम्ये ऽथ शूरसेनाख्ये देशे प्राप्तः स वै वणिक् //
text_mt: Having mounted him upon the shoulder of a preta, he caused him to leave the desert region; / then that merchant reached the charming land named Śūrasena.

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmadharmayogena dhanamuccāvacaṃ bahu /
uvārjayitvā prayayau gayāśīrṣamanuttamam //
meaning:
स्वकर्मधर्मयोगेन धनमुच्चावचं बहु /
उवार्जयित्वा प्रययौ गयाशीर्षमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Through the practice of his own proper duty, having acquired / much various wealth, he set out for the incomparable Gayāśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tatra pretānāmanupūrvaśaḥ /
cakāra svapitṝṇāṃ ca dāyādānāmanantaram //
meaning:
पिण्डनिर्वपणं तत्र प्रेतानामनुपूर्वशः /
चकार स्वपितॄणां च दायादानामनन्तरम् //
text_mt: There he performed the offering of piṇḍas for the pretas in proper sequence, / and thereafter for his own ancestors and heirs.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaśca mahābuddhirmahābodhyaṃ tilairvinā /
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ cakre tathānyānapi gotrajān //
meaning:
आत्मनश्च महाबुद्धिर्महाबोध्यं तिलैर्विना /
पिण्डनिर्वपणं चक्रे तथान्यानपि गोत्रजान् //
text_mt: And for himself, the one of great intelligence performed the offering of piṇḍas / without sesame seeds at Mahābodhi, and likewise for other members of his lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pradatteṣvatha vai piṇḍeṣu pretabhāvataḥ /
vimuktāste dvija pretā brahmalokaṃ tato gatāḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रदत्तेष्वथ वै पिण्डेषु प्रेतभावतः /
विमुक्तास्ते द्विज प्रेता ब्रह्मलोकं ततो गताः //
text_mt: When the piṇḍas were thus offered, those pretas, O twice-born, / were freed from the state of pretas, and then went to Brahmaloka.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi hi vaṇikputro nijamālayamāvrajat /
śravaṇadvādaśīṃ kṛtvā kāladharmamupeyivān //
meaning:
स चापि हि वणिक्पुत्रो निजमालयमाव्रजत् /
श्रवणद्वादशीं कृत्वा कालधर्ममुपेयिवान् //
text_mt: And that merchant's son also returned to his own home; / having performed the Śravaṇadvādaśī [vow], he met with the law of time [death].

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvaloke suciraṃ bhogān bhuktvā sudurlabhān /
mānuṣyaṃ janmamāsādya sa babhau śākale virāṭ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वलोके सुचिरं भोगान् भुक्त्वा सुदुर्लभान् /
मानुष्यं जन्ममासाद्य स बभौ शाकले विराट् //
text_mt: After enjoying pleasures extremely difficult to obtain in the Gandharva world for a very long time, / having obtained a human birth, he shone forth as a sovereign in Śākala.

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmakarmavṛttisthaḥ śravaṇadvādaśīrataḥ /
kāladharmamavāpyāsau guhyakāvāsamāśrayat //
meaning:
स्वधर्मकर्मवृत्तिस्थः श्रवणद्वादशीरतः /
कालधर्ममवाप्यासौ गुह्यकावासमाश्रयत् //
text_mt: Devoted to the conduct of his own duty, dedicated to the Śravaṇadvādaśī, / having attained the law of time, he took up residence among the Guhyakas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ bhogān bhuktvātha kāmataḥ /
martyalokamanuprāpya rājanyatanayo 'bhavat //
meaning:
तत्रोष्य सुचिरं कालं भोगान् भुक्त्वाथ कामतः /
मर्त्यलोकमनुप्राप्य राजन्यतनयो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Having dwelt there for a very long time and enjoyed pleasures at will, / having reached the mortal world, he became the son of a king.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi kṣatravṛttistho dānabhogarato vaśī /
gograhe 'rigaṇāñjitvā kāladharmamupeyivān /
śakralokaṃ sa saṃprāpya devaiḥ sarvaiḥ supūjitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रापि क्षत्रवृत्तिस्थो दानभोगरतो वशी /
गोग्रहे ऽरिगणाञ्जित्वा कालधर्ममुपेयिवान् /
शक्रलोकं स संप्राप्य देवैः सर्वैः सुपूजितः //
text_mt: There too, abiding by the conduct of a Kṣatriya, devoted to gifts and enjoyment, self-controlled, / having conquered hordes of enemies in a cattle-raid, he met with the law of time; / having attained the world of Śakra, he was highly honored by all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyakṣayāt paribhraṣṭaḥ śākale so 'bhavad dvijaḥ /
tato vikaṭarūpo 'sau sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ //
meaning:
पुण्यक्षयात् परिभ्रष्टः शाकले सो ऽभवद् द्विजः /
ततो विकटरूपो ऽसौ सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः //
text_mt: Fallen from there through the exhaustion of his merit, he became a twice-born in Śākala; / then, having a hideous form, he was master of the meaning of all the śāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhayad dvijasutāṃ rūpeṇānupamāṃ dvija /
sāvamene ca bharttāraṃ suśīlamapi bhāminī //
meaning:
विवाहयद् द्विजसुतां रूपेणानुपमां द्विज /
सावमेने च भर्त्तारं सुशीलमपि भामिनी //
text_mt: He married the daughter of a twice-born, incomparable in beauty, O twice-born; / and that passionate woman despised her husband, though he was of good character,

sanskrit_iast:
virūpamiti manvānā tatassobhūt suduḥkhitaḥ /
tato nirvedasaṃyukto gatvāśramapadaṃ mahat //
meaning:
विरूपमिति मन्वाना ततस्सोभूत् सुदुःखितः /
ततो निर्वेदसंयुक्तो गत्वाश्रमपदं महत् //
text_mt: thinking, 'He is deformed.' Thereupon he became exceedingly miserable; / then, filled with detachment, having gone to a great hermitage

sanskrit_iast:
irāvatyāstaṭe śrīmān rūpadhāriṇamāsadat /
tamārādhya jagannāthaṃ nakṣatrapuruṣeṇa hi //
meaning:
इरावत्यास्तटे श्रीमान् रूपधारिणमासदत् /
तमाराध्य जगन्नाथं नक्षत्रपुरुषेण हि //
text_mt: on the bank of the Irāvatī, the fortunate one approached the Bearer of Form; / having worshipped that Lord of the Universe through the Nakṣatrapuruṣa [observance],

sanskrit_iast:
surūpatāmavāpyāgryāṃ tasminneva ca janmani /
tataḥ priyo 'bhūd bhāryāyā bhogavāṃścābhavad vaśī /
śravaṇadvādaśībhaktaḥ pūrvābhyāsādajāyata //
meaning:
सुरूपतामवाप्याग्र्यां तस्मिन्नेव च जन्मनि /
ततः प्रियो ऽभूद् भार्याया भोगवांश्चाभवद् वशी /
श्रवणद्वादशीभक्तः पूर्वाभ्यासादजायत //
text_mt: and having obtained foremost handsome form in that very birth, / he then became dear to his wife, enjoyed pleasures, was self-controlled, / and became devoted to the Śravaṇadvādaśī because of his previous practice.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ purāsau dvijapuṅgavastu kurūparūpo bhagavatprasādāt /
anaṅgarūpapratimo babhūva mṛśca rājā sa purūravābhūt //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe tripañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं पुरासौ द्विजपुङ्गवस्तु कुरूपरूपो भगवत्प्रसादात् /
अनङ्गरूपप्रतिमो बभूव मृश्च राजा स पुरूरवाभूत् //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे त्रिपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus formerly that best of the twice-born, though of deformed appearance, through the grace of the Lord / became like the Bodiless One [Kāma] in form, and having died, he became King Purūravas.

Thus ends the fifty-third chapter in the glorious Vāmana Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca /
purūravā dvijaśreṣṭha yathā devaṃ śriyaḥ patim /
nakṣatrapuruṣākhyena ārādhayata tad vada //
meaning:
नारद उवाच /
पुरूरवा द्विजश्रेष्ठ यथा देवं श्रियः पतिम् /
नक्षत्रपुरुषाख्येन आराधयत तद् वद //
text_mt: Nārada said: / 'O best of the twice-born, tell how Purūravas worshipped / the Lord, the husband of Śrī, by the name of Nakṣatrapuruṣa.'

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi nakṣatrapuruṣavratam /
nakṣatrāṅgani devasya yāni yānīha nārada //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
श्रूयतां कथयिष्यामि नक्षत्रपुरुषव्रतम् /
नक्षत्राङ्गनि देवस्य यानि यानीह नारद //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / 'Listen, I shall explain the Nakṣatrapuruṣa observance, / [and] which stellar limbs belong to the Lord here, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlarkṣaṃ caraṇau viṣṇorjaṅghe dve rohiṇī smṛte /
dve jānunī tathāśvinyau saṃstite rūpadhārimaḥ //
meaning:
मूलर्क्षं चरणौ विष्णोर्जङ्घे द्वे रोहिणी स्मृते /
द्वे जानुनी तथाश्विन्यौ संस्तिते रूपधारिमः //
text_mt: The asterism Mūla is the feet of Viṣṇu; the two Rohiṇīs are known as his shanks; / likewise, the two Aśvinīs are situated as the knees of the Bearer of Form.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhaṃ dve dvayaṃ corvorguhyasthaṃ phālgunīdvayam /
kaṭisthāḥ kṛttikāścaiva vāsudevasya saṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
आषाढं द्वे द्वयं चोर्वोर्गुह्यस्थं फाल्गुनीद्वयम् /
कटिस्थाः कृत्तिकाश्चैव वासुदेवस्य संस्थिताः //
text_mt: The pair of Āṣāḍhās is the two thighs; the two Phālgunīs reside in the private parts; / and the Kṛttikās are situated at the waist of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
prauṣṭhapadyādvayaṃ pārśve kukṣibhyāṃ revatī sthitā /
uraḥsaṃsthā tvanurādhā śraviṣṭhā pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitā //
meaning:
प्रौष्ठपद्याद्वयं पार्श्वे कुक्षिभ्यां रेवती स्थिता /
उरःसंस्था त्वनुराधा श्रविष्ठा पृष्ठसंस्थिता //
text_mt: The two Prauṣṭhapadās are on the flanks, and Revatī is situated on the two sides of the belly; / Anurādhā is situated on the chest, and Śraviṣṭhā is situated on the back.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhā bhujayorhastaḥ karadvayamudāhṛtam /
punarvasurathāṅgulyo nakhāḥ sārpaṃ tathocyate //
meaning:
विशाखा भुजयोर्हस्तः करद्वयमुदाहृतम् /
पुनर्वसुरथाङ्गुल्यो नखाः सार्पं तथोच्यते //
text_mt: Viśākhā is proclaimed to be on the arms, Hasta on the two forearms, / Punarvasu on the fingers, and Sārpa [Āśleṣā] on the nails.

sanskrit_iast:
grīvāsthaitā tathā jyeṣṭhā śravaṇaṃ karṇayoḥ sthitam /
mukhasaṃsthastathā puṣyaḥ svātirdantāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रीवास्थैता तथा ज्येष्ठा श्रवणं कर्णयोः स्थितम् /
मुखसंस्थस्तथा पुष्यः स्वातिर्दन्ताः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Jyeṣṭhā is situated on the neck, and Śravaṇa on the ears; / Puṣya is situated on the mouth, and Svāti is proclaimed to be the teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
hanū dve vāruṇaścokto nāsā paitra udāhṛtaḥ /
mṛgaśīrṣaṃ nayanayo rūpadhāriṇi tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
हनू द्वे वारुणश्चोक्तो नासा पैत्र उदाहृतः /
मृगशीर्षं नयनयो रूपधारिणि तिष्ठति //
text_mt: The two jaws are declared to be Vāruṇa [Śatabhiṣā], and the nose is declared to be Paitra [Maghā]; / Mṛgaśīrṣa is situated on the eyes of the one who assumes this form.

sanskrit_iast:
citrā caiva lalāṭe tu bharaṇī tu tathā śiraḥ /
śiroruhasthā caivārdrā nakṣatrāṅgamidaṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
चित्रा चैव ललाटे तु भरणी तु तथा शिरः /
शिरोरुहस्था चैवार्द्रा नक्षत्राङ्गमिदं हरेः //
text_mt: Citrā is on the forehead, and Bharaṇī is the head; / Ārdrā is located on the hair of the head: such is the constellation-body of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhānaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathāyogena nārada /
saṃpūjito hariḥ kāmān vidadhāti yathepsitān //
meaning:
विधानं संप्रवक्ष्यामि यथायोगेन नारद /
संपूजितो हरिः कामान् विदधाति यथेप्सितान् //
text_mt: I shall explain the ritual rule according to its proper application, O Nārada; / when worshiped, Hari grants desired wishes as one longs for them.

sanskrit_iast:
caitramāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ yadā mūlagataḥ śaśī /
tadā tu bhagavatpādau pūjayet tu vidhānataḥ /
nakṣatrasannidhau dadyād viprendrāya ca bhojanam //
meaning:
चैत्रमासे सिताष्टम्यां यदा मूलगतः शशी /
तदा तु भगवत्पादौ पूजयेत् तु विधानतः /
नक्षत्रसन्निधौ दद्याद् विप्रेन्द्राय च भोजनम् //
text_mt: In the month of Caitra, on the bright eighth day, when the moon has entered Mūla, / one should then worship the two feet of the Blessed Lord according to rule, / and in proximity to the asterism one should give food to a lordly Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
jānunī cāśvinīyoge pūjayedatha bhaktitaḥ /
dohade ca haviṣyānnaṃ pūrvavad dvijabhojanam //
meaning:
जानुनी चाश्विनीयोगे पूजयेदथ भक्तितः /
दोहदे च हविष्यान्नं पूर्ववद् द्विजभोजनम् //
text_mt: And when conjoined with Aśvinī, one should devoutly worship the two knees; / for the special offering, [give] sacrificial food, and feeding of a twice-born as before.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhābhyāṃ tathā dvābhyāṃ dvāvūrū pūjayed budhaḥ /
salilaṃ śiśiraṃ tatra dohade ca prakīrtitam //
meaning:
आषाढाभ्यां तथा द्वाभ्यां द्वावूरू पूजयेद् बुधः /
सलिलं शिशिरं तत्र दोहदे च प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: Under both Āṣāḍhās, the wise man should likewise worship the two thighs; / and cool water is proclaimed as the special offering there.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunīdvitaye guhyaṃ pūjanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
dodahe ca payo gavyaṃ deyaṃ ca dvijabhojanam //
meaning:
फाल्गुनीद्वितये गुह्यं पूजनीयं विचक्षणैः /
दोदहे च पयो गव्यं देयं च द्विजभोजनम् //
text_mt: Under the pair of Phālgunīs, the private parts should be worshiped by the discerning; / for the special offering, cow's milk should be given, and feeding of a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikāsu kaṭiḥ pūjyā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ /
deyañca dohadaṃ viṣṇoḥ sugandhakusumodakam //
meaning:
कृत्तिकासु कटिः पूज्या सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः /
देयञ्च दोहदं विष्णोः सुगन्धकुसुमोदकम् //
text_mt: Under the Kṛttikās, the hips should be worshiped, fasting and with senses conquered; / and water with fragrant flowers should be given as the special offering to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pārśve bhādrapadāyugme pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ /
guḍaṃ salehakaṃ dadyād dohade devakīrtitam //
meaning:
पार्श्वे भाद्रपदायुग्मे पूजयित्वा विधानतः /
गुडं सलेहकं दद्याद् दोहदे देवकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: Having worshiped the flanks according to rule under the pair of Bhādrapadās, / one should give jaggery with a sweet electuary as the special offering, declared for the god.

sanskrit_iast:
dve kukṣī revatīyoge dohade mudgamodakāḥ /
anurādhāsu jaṭharaṃ ṣaṣṭhikānnaṃ ca dohade //
meaning:
द्वे कुक्षी रेवतीयोगे दोहदे मुद्गमोदकाः /
अनुराधासु जठरं षष्ठिकान्नं च दोहदे //
text_mt: Under conjunction with Revatī, the two sides of the belly [are worshiped], with mung-bean sweets as the special offering; / under the Anurādhās, the belly, and sixty-day rice as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
śraviṣṭhāyāṃ tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ sālibhaktaṃ ca dohade /
bhujayugmaṃ viśākhāsu dohade paramodanam //
meaning:
श्रविष्ठायां तथा पृष्ठं सालिभक्तं च दोहदे /
भुजयुग्मं विशाखासु दोहदे परमोदनम् //
text_mt: Under Śraviṣṭhā, likewise the back, with cooked śāli rice as the special offering; / under the Viśākhās, the two arms, with the finest cooked rice as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
haste hastau tathā pūjyau yāvakaṃ dohade smṛtam /
punarvasāvaṅgulīśca paṭolastatra dohade //
meaning:
हस्ते हस्तौ तथा पूज्यौ यावकं दोहदे स्मृतम् /
पुनर्वसावङ्गुलीश्च पटोलस्तत्र दोहदे //
text_mt: Under Hasta, the two hands should likewise be worshiped, barley gruel being prescribed as the special offering; / under Punarvasu, the fingers, with snake-gourd as the special offering there.

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣāsu nakhān pūjya dohade tittirāmiṣam /
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūjayed grīvāṃ dohade tilamodakam //
meaning:
आश्लेषासु नखान् पूज्य दोहदे तित्तिरामिषम् /
ज्येष्ठायां पूजयेद् ग्रीवां दोहदे तिलमोदकम् //
text_mt: Having worshiped the nails under the Āśleṣās, [give] partridge meat as the special offering; / under Jyeṣṭhā, one should worship the neck, with sesame sweetmeats as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇe śravaṇau pūjyau dadhibhaktaṃ ca dohade /
puṣye mukhaṃ pūjayeta dohade ghṛtapāyasam //
meaning:
श्रवणे श्रवणौ पूज्यौ दधिभक्तं च दोहदे /
पुष्ये मुखं पूजयेत दोहदे घृतपायसम् //
text_mt: Under Śravaṇa, the two ears should be worshiped, with curd-rice as the special offering; / under Puṣya, one should worship the mouth, with milk-pudding in ghee as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
svātiyoge ca daśanā dohade tilaśaṣkulī /
dātavyā keśavaprītyai brahmaṇasya ca bhojanam //
meaning:
स्वातियोगे च दशना दोहदे तिलशष्कुली /
दातव्या केशवप्रीत्यै ब्रह्मणस्य च भोजनम् //
text_mt: Under conjunction with Svāti, the teeth [are worshiped], and a sesame pastry as the special offering / should be given for Keśava’s pleasure, along with feeding of a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
hanū śatabhiṣāyoge pūjayecca prayatnataḥ /
priyaṅguraktaśālyannaṃ dohadaṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ //
meaning:
हनू शतभिषायोगे पूजयेच्च प्रयत्नतः /
प्रियङ्गुरक्तशाल्यन्नं दोहदं मधुविद्विषः //
text_mt: Under conjunction with Śatabhiṣā, one should diligently worship the two jaws; / food of red śāli rice with priyaṅgu is the special offering for the enemy of Madhu.

sanskrit_iast:
maghāsu nāsikā pūjyā madhu dadyācca dohade /
mṛgottamāṅge nayane mṛgamāṃsaṃ ca dohade //
meaning:
मघासु नासिका पूज्या मधु दद्याच्च दोहदे /
मृगोत्तमाङ्गे नयने मृगमांसं च दोहदे //
text_mt: Under the Maghās, the nose should be worshiped, and one should give honey as the special offering; / under Mṛgaśiras, the eyes, with venison as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
citrāyoge lalāṭaṃ ca dohade cārubhojanam /
bharaṇīṣu śiraḥ pūjyaṃ cāru bhaktaṃ ca dohade //
meaning:
चित्रायोगे ललाटं च दोहदे चारुभोजनम् /
भरणीषु शिरः पूज्यं चारु भक्तं च दोहदे //
text_mt: Under conjunction with Citrā, the forehead [is worshiped], with lovely food as the special offering; / under the Bharaṇīs, the head should be worshiped, with fine cooked rice as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjanīyā vidvadbhirārdrāyoge śiroruhāḥ /
viprāṃśca bhojayed bhaktayā dohade ca guḍārdrakam //
meaning:
संपूजनीया विद्वद्भिरार्द्रायोगे शिरोरुहाः /
विप्रांश्च भोजयेद् भक्तया दोहदे च गुडार्द्रकम् //
text_mt: The hair of the head should be worshiped by the wise under conjunction with Ārdrā; / one should also devoutly feed Brahmins, and [give] jaggery and ginger as the special offering.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣetrayogeṣveteṣu sampūjya jagataḥ patim /
pārite dakṣiṇāndadyāt strīpuṃsoścāruvāsasī //
meaning:
नक्षेत्रयोगेष्वेतेषु सम्पूज्य जगतः पतिम् /
पारिते दक्षिणान्दद्यात् स्त्रीपुंसोश्चारुवाससी //
text_mt: Having worshiped the Lord of the world under these conjunctions of asterisms, / upon completion one should give a priestly gift, two beautiful garments for a woman and a man,

sanskrit_iast:
chatropānatśvetayugaṃ sapta dhānyāni kāñcanam /
ghṛtapātraṃ ca matiman brāhmaṇāya nivedayet //
meaning:
छत्रोपानत्श्वेतयुगं सप्त धान्यानि काञ्चनम् /
घृतपात्रं च मतिमन् ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: An umbrella, a pair of white shoes, seven types of grain, gold, / and a vessel of ghee, O wise one, one should present to a Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
pratinakṣatrayogena pūjanīyā dvijātayaḥ /
nakṣatramaya evaiṣa puruṣaḥ śāśvato mataḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिनक्षत्रयोगेन पूजनीया द्विजातयः /
नक्षत्रमय एवैष पुरुषः शाश्वतो मतः //
text_mt: At every conjunction of an asterism, twice-born men should be honored; / this eternal Person is indeed considered to consist of the constellations.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrapuruṣākhyaṃ hi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam /
pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ hi bhṛguṇā sarvapātakanāśanam //
meaning:
नक्षत्रपुरुषाख्यं हि व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् /
पूर्वं कृतं हि भृगुणा सर्वपातकनाशनम् //
text_mt: The observance called Nakṣatrapuruṣa is indeed the best among observances; / it was performed of old by Bhṛgu, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgopāṅgāni devarṣe pūjayitvā jagadguroḥ /
surūpāmyabhijāyante pratyaṅgaṅgāni caiva hi //
meaning:
अङ्गोपाङ्गानि देवर्षे पूजयित्वा जगद्गुरोः /
सुरूपाम्यभिजायन्ते प्रत्यङ्गङ्गानि चैव हि //
text_mt: Having worshiped the major and minor limbs of the teacher of the world, O divine seer, / one's own limbs and parts become handsome indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kulasaṃgāgataṃ ca yat /
pitṛmātṛsamutthaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ hanti keśavaḥ //
meaning:
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं कुलसंगागतं च यत् /
पितृमातृसमुत्थं च तत्सर्वं हन्ति केशवः //
text_mt: Sin committed in seven births, sin resulting from association with [bad] family, / and that arising from father or mother—Keśava destroys all that.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṇi bhadrāṇyāpnoti śarīrārogyamuttamam /
anantāṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ rūpaṃ cātīva śobhanam //
meaning:
सर्वाणि भद्राण्याप्नोति शरीरारोग्यमुत्तमम् /
अनन्तां मनसः प्रीतिं रूपं चातीव शोभनम् //
text_mt: One attains all auspicious things, supreme bodily health, / endless joy of mind, and exceedingly charming beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
vāṅmādhuryaṃ tathā kānti yaccānyadabhivāñchitam /
dadāti nakṣatrapumān pūjitastu janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
वाङ्माधुर्यं तथा कान्ति यच्चान्यदभिवाञ्छितम् /
ददाति नक्षत्रपुमान् पूजितस्तु जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Sweetness of speech, radiance, and whatever else is desired— / Janārdana, the Nakṣatrapuruṣa, bestows when worshiped.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya samyageteṣu krameṇarkṣeṣu nārada /
arundhatī mahābhāgā khyātimagryāṃ jagāma ha //
meaning:
उपोष्य सम्यगेतेषु क्रमेणर्क्षेषु नारद /
अरुन्धती महाभागा ख्यातिमग्र्यां जगाम ह //
text_mt: Having fasted properly under these asterisms in succession, O Nārada, / the highly fortunate Arundhatī attained foremost renown.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityastanayārthāya nakṣatrāṅgaṃ janārdanam /
saṃpūjayitvā govindaṃ revantaṃ putramāptavān //
meaning:
आदित्यस्तनयार्थाय नक्षत्राङ्गं जनार्दनम् /
संपूजयित्वा गोविन्दं रेवन्तं पुत्रमाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Having worshiped Govinda, Janārdana whose body is the constellations, / for the sake of a son, the Sun obtained Revanta as his son.

sanskrit_iast:
rambhā rūpamavāpāgryaṃ vāṅmādhuryaṃ ca menakā /
kānti vidhuravāpāgryāṃ rājyaṃ rājā pūrūvāḥ //
meaning:
रम्भा रूपमवापाग्र्यं वाङ्माधुर्यं च मेनका /
कान्ति विधुरवापाग्र्यां राज्यं राजा पूरूवाः //
text_mt: Rambhā obtained foremost beauty, and Menakā sweetness of speech; / the Moon obtained foremost brilliance, and King Purūravas kingship.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vidhānato brahmannakṣatrāṅgo janārdanaḥ /
pūjito rūpadhārī yaistaiḥ prāptā tu sukāmitā //
meaning:
एवं विधानतो ब्रह्मन्नक्षत्राङ्गो जनार्दनः /
पूजितो रूपधारी यैस्तैः प्राप्ता तु सुकामिता //
text_mt: Thus, when Janārdana, whose body is the constellations and who assumes this form, / is worshiped according to rule, O Brahmin, by people, their fine desires are attained.

sanskrit_iast:
etat tavoktaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ śubharūpadāyi /
nakṣatrapuṃsaḥ paramaṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva puṇyāmiha tīrthayātrāma //
iti śrīvāmanapurāṇe catuṣpañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत् तवोक्तं परमं पवित्रं धन्यं यशस्यं शुभरूपदायि /
नक्षत्रपुंसः परमं विधानं शृणुष्व पुण्यामिह तीर्थयात्राम //
इति श्रीवामनपुराणे चतुष्पञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This supreme, purifying, auspicious, renowned ritual of Nakṣatrapuruṣa, / which grants an auspicious form, has been declared to you; now hear the sacred pilgrimage to holy tīrthas here.

Thus ends the fifty-fourth chapter in the glorious Vāmanapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca /
irāvatīmanuprāpya puṇyāṃ tāmṛṣikanyakām /
strātvā saṃpūjayāmāsa caitrāṣṭamyāṃ janārdanam //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच /
इरावतीमनुप्राप्य पुण्यां तामृषिकन्यकाम् /
स्त्रात्वा संपूजयामास चैत्राष्टम्यां जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Having reached the Irāvatī, that sacred daughter of the sages, / and having bathed, he worshiped Janārdana on the eighth day of Caitra.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ cīrtvā vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ śuciḥ /
jagāma sa kurukṣetraṃ prahlādo dānaveśvaraḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्रपुरुषं चीर्त्वा व्रतं पुण्यप्रदं शुचिः /
जगाम स कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रह्लादो दानवेश्वरः //
text_mt: Having performed the pure observance of Nakṣatrapuruṣa, which bestows merit, / Prahlāda, the lord of the Dānavas, purified, went to Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
airāvatena mantreṇa cakratīrthaṃ sudarśanam /
upāmantrya tataḥ sasnau vedoktavidhinā mune //
meaning:
ऐरावतेन मन्त्रेण चक्रतीर्थं सुदर्शनम् /
उपामन्त्र्य ततः सस्नौ वेदोक्तविधिना मुने //
text_mt: Having addressed Cakra-tīrtha, [named] Sudarśana, / with the mantra of Airāvata, he then bathed according to the rule declared in the Veda, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya kṣaṇadāṃ bhaktyā pūjiyatvā kurudhvajam /
kṛtaśaucau jagāmātha draṣṭuṃ puruṣakesarim //
meaning:
उपोष्य क्षणदां भक्त्या पूजियत्वा कुरुध्वजम् /
कृतशौचौ जगामाथ द्रष्टुं पुरुषकेसरिम् //
text_mt: Having fasted that night and devoutly worshiped the one whose emblem is Kuru [Viṣṇu], / and having performed purifications, he then went to behold the Man-Lion.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tu devikāyāṃ ca nṛsiṃhaṃ pratipūjya ca /
tatreṣya rajanomekāṃ gokarṇaṃ dānavo yayau //
meaning:
स्नात्वा तु देविकायां च नृसिंहं प्रतिपूज्य च /
तत्रेष्य रजनोमेकां गोकर्णं दानवो ययौ //
text_mt: Having bathed in the Devikā and reverenced Nṛsiṃha, / and having spent one night there, the Dānava went to Gokarṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin snātvā tathā prācīṃ pūjyeśaṃ viśvakarmiṇam /
prācīne cāpare daityo draṣṭuṃ kāmeśvaraṃ yayau //
meaning:
तस्मिन् स्नात्वा तथा प्राचीं पूज्येशं विश्वकर्मिणम् /
प्राचीने चापरे दैत्यो द्रष्टुं कामेश्वरं ययौ //
text_mt: Having bathed there and worshiped the lord Viśvakarman in the east, / the Daitya went further east to behold Kāmeśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca pūjayitvā ca śaṅkaram /
draṣṭuṃ yayau ca prahlādaḥ puṇḍarīkaṃ mahāmbhasi //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च दृष्ट्वा च पूजयित्वा च शङ्करम् /
द्रष्टुं ययौ च प्रह्लादः पुण्डरीकं महाम्भसि //
text_mt: Having bathed and beheld and worshiped Śaṅkara there, / Prahlāda went to behold Puṇḍarīka in the great waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ /
puṇḍarīkaṃ ca saṃpūjya uvāsa divasatrayam //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च दृष्ट्वा च संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः /
पुण्डरीकं च संपूज्य उवास दिवसत्रयम् //
text_mt: Having bathed and seen [it] there, and having made offerings to the ancestors and gods, / and having worshiped Puṇḍarīka, he resided for three days.

sanskrit_iast:
viśākhayūpe tadanu dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tathājitam /
snātvā tathā kṛṣṇatīrthe trirātraṃ nyavasacchuciḥ //
meaning:
विशाखयूपे तदनु दृष्ट्वा देवं तथाजितम् /
स्नात्वा तथा कृष्णतीर्थे त्रिरात्रं न्यवसच्छुचिः //
